ntnhcore.questtext.b6d6e7000efb90cf10616:
Structures generate throughout the world and are among the best sources of early-game resources. Raiding them before investing heavily in production can save significant time and materials.

#{00aa00}Exploration pays off early - check your surroundings before grinding for resources you might find for free.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.0e022d07945df3c5240c4:
With the #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Automatic Buzz Saw#{reset} one can automatically farm trees for their #{ffaa00}Wood#{reset}, aswell as other crops such as #{ffaa00}Hemp#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Wheat#{reset}.

#{00aaaa}Fans#{reset}, when powered by redstone, can be used to push the dropped items into hoppers or conveyors for storage. Use a #{ffaa00}Drill#{reset} on them to remove the diminishing behaviour of pushing force.
ntnhcore.questtext.e3f170b8bf37cf91ae96e: The #{ffaa00}Screwdriver#{reset} is used to rotate conveyor blocks as well as to create a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset}. It can also be used in combination with #{ffaa00}Bobby Pins#{reset} to unlock #{ffaa00}Safes#{reset} found in various structures.
ntnhcore.questtext.6aaf15a9edad202bda720:
There are many tools which will help you progress through the mod, the most important ones being:

#{ffaa00}Tungsten Reachers#{reset}, which reduce the radiation the player gets exposed to from items in their inventory, as well as allowing them to hold some very hot items.

The #{ffaa00}Crowbar#{reset}, which is used to open crates for loot such as food and ammunition found in various structures.
ntnhcore.questtext.a20456e614b94f2e345ac:
Tired of using buckets to give water to your machines? Try using water pumps or infinite water tanks!

Infinite Water Tank will give 50mb/t
Enhanced Infinite Water Tank will give 500mb/t
Pump will give 1000mb/t but requires steam to operate.
ntnhcore.questtext.901e14eb49e1520ac151d: #{ffaa00}Bauxide#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Cryolite#{reset} can be further processed to obtain #{ffaa00}Aluminium#{reset}, with additional byproducts of #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Titanium#{reset} and #{55ffff}Mercury#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.00bb391e2411273ac3da7: #{55ffff}Antimatter#{reset} is a dangerous substance which can be obtained from a #{00aaaa}Cyclotron#{reset} or a #{00aaaa}Particle Accelerator#{reset}. If dropped on the floor a violent explosion will occur. Antimatter cant be stored in normal tanks, and as such, a #{00aaaa}Magnetic Antimatter Container#{reset} is required.
ntnhcore.questtext.4e844adb33bb9bc52159c: The #{00aaaa}Auxiliary Cooling Tower#{reset} is a larger version of the Steam Condenser able to process up to 50 mb/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.d85055a576b1ee3a21b1b: #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset} is an alternative to Polymer and can be used for the same recipes. Since it doesnt require any #{ffaa00}Coal Powder#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Fluorite#{reset} to be made, it is easier and more convenient to automate than #{ffaa00}Polymer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.32c2398847c6b881b0ab7:
#{ffaa00}Balefire#{reset} is an extremely radioactive substance which can be used to make powerful fuels for the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, aswell as #{55ffff}BF Rocket Fuel#{reset} for power production. High radiation resistant equipment is needed to hold the item. #{ffaa00}Thermonuclear Ashes#{reset} can be produced sustainably as a byproduct from #{55ffff}Antimatter - BF Rocket Fuel#{reset}.

The High-Tech Bomb Defusing Device can extract balefire shards from duds.
ntnhcore.questtext.f4950ab62f1048dcee982:
Before #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} can be processed, it must be heated up in a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}.

The #{00aaaa}Oil Refinery#{reset} splits Hot Crude Oil(or later on #{55ffff}Cracked#{reset}) into four different fluid products and one solid byproduct.

After that, those fluids can be sent through a #{00aaaa}Fractioning Tower#{reset} to obtain different kinds of fuels, such as #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} and #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset}. A #{00aaaa}Fractioning Tower Seperator#{reset} can be used to stack fractioning towers ontop of eachother.
ntnhcore.questtext.c6e3ee1d1375daab44a57:
#{ffff55}Bedrock Ore Deposits#{reset} are an infinite source of resourses which can be obtained by using a #{00aaaa}Large Mining Drill#{reset} and a #{00aaaa}Bedrock Ore Processor#{reset}.

Operating the drill will consume#{ffff55} 200kHE/s#{reset}.

Before excavation can happen, the #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset} covering the bedrock ore deposit needs to be removed. An easy way of doing that is blowing up the rock with #{ffaa00}Mining Charges#{reset}.

The large mining drill is used to excavate #{ffaa00}Raw Bedrock Ores#{reset} from their deposits. The drill requires a #{ffaa00}Drillbit#{reset} to work#{reset}, which can be upgraded to increase the speed at which it operates at. #{ffff55}Fortune#{reset} on a drillbit affects the quality of mined bedrock ore, each level of fortune adds #{ffff55}10%#{reset} of the value to the item.

The bedrock ore processor takes #{ffaa00}#{reset}raw bedrock ore obtained from the drill and breaks it down into smaller pieces, each with different products that can be obtained from them. 
#{55ff55}#{55ffff}Ore Slop#{reset}, which is created when the machine is operating, can be processed into many useful products, especially when it is sent through an #{00aaaa}Electrolysis Machine#{reset}.

The #{ffaa00}Bedrock Ore Desity Scanner#{reset} shows information on the composition of Bedrock Ore deposits.

Bedrock ore processing can be both an energy and resourse expensive operation so it is recommended that it is explored after having good infrastructure.

#{00aa00}Consider adding a Power Saving Upgrade to the drill as it only reduces power without affecting the mining speed. Additionally, installing an Effectiveness Upgrade on the ore slopper will make it give out more resourses.#{reset}#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.8840cb59299db9189f5a1:
The #{00aaaa}Automatic Thresher#{reset} harvests crops such as #{ffaa00}Wheat#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Hemp#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Sugarcane#{reset}, ect in a 7x7 area when supplied with fuel. It will eject all items from the back.

[F1] for more information.
ntnhcore.questtext.8a1a1b8b94f37ecd2078c: The #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset} is a large oil processing multiblock machine which produces many fluids, such as #{55ffff}Aromatic Hydrocarbons#{reset} used for #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.2b74ceb3eebd11a006f4e:
The #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Centrifuge#{reset} allows for the seperation of ores, giving back more items than the usual mining method. It also seperates items into their respective items. Additionally, they are used in processing #{ffff55}#{ffaa00}Bedrock Ores#{reset}.

Operating the centrifuge will consume #{ffff55}4kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.bc42af496f3918e276e96:
The #{00aaaa}Coker Unit#{reset} is a machine that turns oil products into #{ffaa00}Petroleum Coke#{reset}, which is the same to the other kinds of coke, aswell as additional fluids as byproducts. The coker unit will require an external heat source in order to function, similar to the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

#{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}Alongside the #{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}Electric Arc Furnace, the coker unit is one of the most polluting machines of the mod. It spreads 20 soot per second, making it a dangerous machine to use next to a glyphid nest.
ntnhcore.questtext.b2aebdf97ff3be685633a: The #{00aaaa}Oil Derrick#{reset} extracts #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} and #{ffaa00}#{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} from #{ffff55}Oil Deposits#{reset} that are directly below them. When supplied with power, it will begin to drill downwards until it cannot drill further or reach an oil deposit. Upon reaching a deposit, it will continuously extract oil and gas from it until the deposit is entirely depleted.
ntnhcore.questtext.c429ad10168e94caf8d0e:
#{ffaa00}Desh#{reset} is an alloy made up of 9 rare earth metals to make its blend form, which is solidified and refined using #{55ffff}Mercury#{reset} and #{55ffff}Light oil#{reset} in the #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset}. Desh is an almost unbreakable material and as such its tools have infinite durability. 

#{55ff55}#{00aa00}Desh can also be made using DeshReady™ in a Rotary Furnace, or later on, in an Ore Acidizer.#{reset}

Mercury at this stage of the game can be obtained from centrifuging #{ffff55}Redstone Ore#{reset} or putting #{ffff55}Cinnabar#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}. Large cinnabar veins can be found as depth ore.

Later on, mercury can be obtained from processing #{55ffff}Ore Slop#{reset} or #{55ffff}Vitriol#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Electrolyzer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.7aa23e24a475758dd8867:
An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T3], which unlocks additional recipes.

Alternatively, the #{00aaaa}Desh Anvil#{reset} can be skipped by making a #{00aaaa}Ferrouranium Anvil#{reset}, [T4], from scavanged #{ffff55}#{reset}#{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} found in structures.
ntnhcore.questtext.d268c884641df88e49086: #{ffaa00}Desh Servos#{reset} are an armor modification which give incredibely strong buffs when used, such as increased strength, mining speed and jump boost.
ntnhcore.questtext.e3753dee6837508160cbd:
Exploration is an important part of the #{ff55ff}NTM#{reset} experience as salvaging abandoned structures is a viable strategy for early game. Large caverns also exist in this modpack, so dont hesistate going caving.

#{ff55ff}Backpacks#{reset} will be a massive help, as they can be used to carry around more loot. Crates can also be used to transport items, but backpacks also come packed with dedicated tool slots, a crafting table, a bed aswell as fluid tanks.

A #{ff55ff}Nature's Compass#{reset} can be used to easily locate biomes of interest.

A #{ffaa00}Hose#{reset} can be used to quickly input and output fluids stored in the backpack.
ntnhcore.questtext.2c48693f20dcf77f3b248:
The #{00aaaa}Electric Arc Furnace#{reset} is a large automated furnace multiblock machine that can fill the role of #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} and automated smelter, and is required for progression as it is the only machine that can produce #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} from various sources, such as #{ffaa00}Sand#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Flint#{reset}, #{ffaa00}fiberglass#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Asbestos#{reset}.

To operate this machine, it will require both electrical power and crafted #{aaaaaa}#{ffaa00}Electrodes#{reset}. In terms of electricity, the machine has a maximum storage capacity of #{ffff55}2.5MHE#{reset}, and consumes #{ffff55}20kHE/s#{reset} in operation, making it reasonably power hungry. In terms of the electrodes required for operation, there are four types available, and the machine must have three installed before it can operate.

This machine can operate in two different modes: Solid mode, which is the easiest to setup and use, great for initial crafting, and Liquid mode, which produces castable molten ores much like the crucible, with a small bonus to output, increasing efficiency of extraction from various ores.
ntnhcore.questtext.7b4fd78c4be5420e272f5: The #{00aaaa}Electric Groundpump#{reset} can be used to quickly generate #{55ffff}Water#{reset}, making it very useful later on for filling large #{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset} and reactors. The pump requires a 3x3 cube of dirt directly beneath it and must be below Y:70, otherwise it won't work.
ntnhcore.questtext.9a5ddb6410f48b79d461d:
The #{00aaaa}Electrolysis Machine#{reset} enables the separating of elements from fluids and the advanced processing of ores, making it an important machine in ore processing. Operating the machine consumes #{ffff55}200kHE/s#{reset}.

The electrolysis machine has 2 functions: one for the separation of fluids and one for ore processing.

In the first mode, the machine will take in a compatible fluid and separate it into 2 other fluids.

In the second mode, it will require #{55ffff}Nitric Acid#{reset} and will process any kind of ore-derived crystal, allowing the maximum yield of the ore. There are 2 outputs, for the molten main product the outlet marked green and the secondary the one marked red, plus a byproduct kept in its item form. The outlets follow the same mechanics as the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Consider installing a Power Saving upgrade above level 2 on the electrolysis machine as it will significantly reduce the power consumption with only a minimal speed penalty.
ntnhcore.questtext.c3344fc2a8d31c48fbe60: Sand in an #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} can be turned into #{ffaa00}Fiberglass#{reset}, which provides more than #{ffff55}4x#{reset} the amount of #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset}. Additionally, it provides a great recipe for insulators.
ntnhcore.questtext.48f658a0b16a84bcfe195:
The #{ffaa00}Geiger counter#{reset} is a device used to measure #{ffff55}RAD/s#{reset}, in order to inform the player of any eventual radiation. It is an upgrade to the #{ffaa00}Dosimeter#{reset}. It can measure three different types of radiation, those types being chunk radiation, environmental radiation and player contamination.

It can be used in one of two forms, either as a hand-held item or in its block form.

Holding it in the inventory will show a meter on the bottom left of the screen, and right clicking while holding it will send a message in chat showing the various doses of radiation.

It will also click whenever it reads any kind of radiation, a signature function of any dosimeter.
ntnhcore.questtext.2ad3833b1fd72ccd4c1ff:
The #{00aaaa}Hydraulic Fracking Tower#{reset} is used to extract infinite oil from a #{ffff55}Bedrock Oil Deposit#{reset}. To operate, the machine needs #{55ffff}Fracking Solution#{reset}. During its operation, the surrounding environment will sustain considerable damage. #{ffaa00}Oily Dirt#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Oily Sand#{reset} can be used to create #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset}, a substitute of #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset}.

Operating the hydraulic fracking tower will consume #{ffff55}100kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.bd31fcb888a465b348973:
The #{ffaa00}Impact Drill#{reset} is an electric pickaxe which has prebuilt enchantments and abilities on it. It is a very useful tool which will make mining way more efficient.

Similar electric tools exist for the axe and shovel.
ntnhcore.questtext.99facafab688dc4c06007: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Boiler#{reset} is an upgraded version of the Boiler which has a higher capacity of held liquid. Additionally, it doesnt explode.
ntnhcore.questtext.3fd261628e7bb84b5d603: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Liquification Machine#{reset} is a general use machine for the liquifying various items. It becomes very useful for cobblestone generation, and thus #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} automation.
ntnhcore.questtext.9fa2664dc5211bf7703a0: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Solidification Machine#{reset} is a general use machine for the solidification of various fluids. An important product of this machine is #{ffaa00}Tar#{reset}, which can be used to create #{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.9756b9f2c5cbb1de74679:
The #{00aaaa}Battery Socket#{reset} is used to hold #{ffaa00}Batteries#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Capacitors#{reset}.

Batteries have more energy storage, but a slower discharge time, meaning that only a small amount of stored power can be outputted to the grid.

Capacitors on the other hand, have less energy storage, but a faster discharge time.
ntnhcore.questtext.57e206685bdf51bd06bc1: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Steam Turbine#{reset} is a multiblock machine that is a much larger and more powerful version of the regular #{00aaaa}Steam Turbine#{reset}. It has an efficiency of #{ffff55}100%#{reset} and energy output slowly ramps up as #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} is supplied and slowly goes down as steam cuts out.
ntnhcore.questtext.7a05c16de820c6c806baf: The #{ffaa00}Integrated Circuit Board#{reset} is the first circuit board to use #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset}, being used extensively in mid game machines, automation devices, missiles, and various small tools such as the #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.ba4e240e5976989b96587: The #{ffaa00}Jetpack#{reset} can be used to travel upwards. It can be upgraded to unlock additional abilities, and can be equiped as an armor modification.
ntnhcore.questtext.e0c2e7ef6772c3a2f7b05:
The #{00aaaa}Launch Pad#{reset} is the main launch table for most missiles. Although it is the earliest available, missiles must first be erected before launch, resulting in a small delay.

The #{00aaaa}Silo Launch Pad#{reset} is a miniaturized version of the launch pad. It can launch every generic missile with a delay of only 5 seconds. A rusted variant can be found in the naturally-occurring silo structure, holding the damaged Doomsday Missile.
ntnhcore.questtext.a678272f8c5b9e0b2de96: The #{ffaa00}M1TTY Environment Suit#{reset} is a cheap electric armor set that comes with many abilities. It is an excellent armor set for exploring as it comes with very high speed buffs as well as fast swimming speed.
ntnhcore.questtext.17e8287db78418e4946a5: #{ffaa00}Microchips#{reset} are one of the most important components of future circuits and will be used in bulk throughout progression.
ntnhcore.questtext.5da35bec7144b157c8ecf: The #{ffaa00}Military Grade Circuit Board#{reset} is an advanced Circuit Board used in more complicated machines, such as the #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuge#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.fab3fecf14e69790d542d: The #{00aaaa}Mining Laser#{reset} is a laser drill which can be used to quickly dig large areas. It has a #{ffff55}100 MHE#{reset} internal power buffer and a 64,000mB internal #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} buffer. Its default radius is 3, which can be increased by the use of an effectiveness upgrade. It can also be equiped with various upgrades to unlock new functions such as shredding or voiding.
ntnhcore.questtext.aa23374927c6c15376ca4: The #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} is a useful machine, used for processing various items for utility, ore multiplication, and more. It is powered by electricity and requires various solvents depending on the item. The acidizer is quite the power hungry machine, consuming #{ffff55}20kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.2188fd57ff55348c0cce3:
The #{ffaa00}Chlorine Pinwheel#{reset} is a yellow propeller capable of producing chlorine indefinitely.
Acquisition

It cannot be crafted, but can be found in structures (e.g., in a starship).

The chlorine spinner is an endless source of #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset}; to use it, simply place it in a container slot (e.g., in a barrel). The item will produce chlorine indefinitely, although the production rate is low (1 mb/t or 20 mb/s).

The #{ffaa00}Oxygen Pinwheel#{reset} is analogous to the Chlorine Pinwheel, producing #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset} instead of #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.d291b1cd0e65d5fcb9829:
The #{00aaaa}Bricked Furnace#{reset} is almost the same as the vanilla furnace, but it can smelt construction materials faster, such as #{ffaa00}Sand#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Cobblestone#{reset} being smelted at double the speed. #{ffaa00}Clay#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Fire Clay#{reset} can be smelted at #{ffff55}#{reset}quadruple#{reset} the speed, which means that making a full brick block can be done within a vanilla furnace operation. It can also make #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset} at double the speed. It can also collect Ashes from burnt fuel.

The #{00aaaa}Iron Furnace#{reset} has the base smelting speed #{ffff55}20%#{reset} faster than the vanilla furnace, which means it can complete an operation within 8 seconds instead of 10 seconds. Besides being able to smelt faster, it consumes fuel only during operation, so the fuel is never wasted. It also has burn time bonuses for various kinds of fuel, ranging from #{ffff55}+25%#{reset} for lignite to #{ffff55}+100%#{reset} for solid fuel.

#{ff55ff}Et Futurum Requiem#{reset} also backports modern furnaces, such as the #{00aaaa}Smoker#{reset}, which cooks food faster, and the #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}, which smelts ores faster.
ntnhcore.questtext.f812964917027bf798a32: #{ffaa00}Polymer#{reset} is a basic plastic material needed for many recipes. Important uses of it are the #{00aaaa}Centrifuge#{reset}, the #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Electric Arc Furnace#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.02e9afff30d267e4968c3:
The #{ffaa00}Powered Drill#{reset} is a modular mining device which can make resourse gathering and excavation much faster than normal pickaxes. 

Various modifications can be attached in the #{00aaaa}Weapon Modification Table#{reset}, such as new drillbits for a larger mining radious or even new engines, which let it run on electricity.
ntnhcore.questtext.0ad4abb756d5ddb92c9e4:
The #{00aaaa}Precision Assembly Machine#{reset} is a machine which can produce #{ffaa00}Blueprints#{reset}. Due to the recipes having a low success rate, automation of the ingredient is recommended.

Pufferfish can be obtained from throwing #{ffaa00}Fishing Dynamite#{reset} in water.
ntnhcore.questtext.fbf66fa94c3ab830f9107:
The #{00aaaa}Pumpjack#{reset} is a more efficient #{00aaaa}Oil Derrick#{reset} which extracts 750mb of #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} and a random amount of #{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} between 50 and 250mb in a 1.25 second cycle. It depletes a single block of a deposit after extracting a random number of cycles of oil that is on average twice as large compared to the derrick.

In total, this means that the pumpjack is on average 3x as efficient at extracting oil and 3x as fast at doing so while producing the same amount of natural gas as the derrick.
ntnhcore.questtext.553a68f7137050821aaa8:
#{ffaa00}#{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Redstone-Over Radio#{reset} in combination with a #{00aaaa}Redstone Fluid Valve#{reset} can be used to detect when a tank is starting to fill up, and release the insides. This is useful for having buffers without having all the fluids being wasted.

#{00aa00}Here is an exmaple of a tank that will only output fluid once its full:#{reset}

Firstly, place a #{ffaa00}ROR Transmitter#{reset} on one port of the tank, provide an ID and enable Polling.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Fluid1.png[/img]

After that, place a #{ffaa00}ROR Logic Receiver#{reset} next to the fluid valve and input the desired settings. Make sure that your signal is >= of your desired buffer. One redstone level equals to 16k mb.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Fluid2.png[/img]

A #{00aaaa}Fluid Control Pump#{reset} can also be used to limit throughput of fluids and to also add priorities.
ntnhcore.questtext.bc10bbb22828344888e54:
Oil products can be combusted or burnt to produce massive amounts of energy.

The #{00aaaa}Industrial Combustion Engine#{reset} combusts fuels, such as #{55ffff}Heating Oil#{reset} or #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset} to produce power. Various piston sets exist, which are needed for the engine to work, each one giving its own efficiency bonuses to fuel grades.

The #{aa0000}#{00aaaa}Turbofan#{reset} is the best place to use aviation type fuels, such as #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset}, as it provides #{ffff55}100%#{reset} power efficiency. Be careful not to stand infront of it while its operational!

The #{00aaaa}Combined Cycle Gas Turbine#{reset} is the only generator that can burn gaseous fuels at #{ffff55}100%#{reset} efficiency. The CCGT uses #{00aaaa}#{55ffff}Engine Lubricant#{reset}, and produces #{55ffff}Dense Steam#{reset}.

The #{00aaaa}Flare Stack#{reset} is used for burning gasses such as #{55ffff}Unsaturated Hydrocarbons#{reset} for power, as well as dealing with excess fluids.

The #{00aaaa}Fluid Burner#{reset} is a much more efficient way of producing power from gases. Place a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset} ontop and run the #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} through a turbine to generate power.

Consider installing a #{ffaa00}Muffler#{reset} on some of these machines as they are very loud. Shift-Click on a machine while holding a Muffler to apply.
ntnhcore.questtext.a6b23d0860d654f0d4524:
#{ffaa00}Rubber#{reset} is an essential material used in many crafting recipes. It is created in a #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset} with #{55ffff}Unsaturated Hydrocarbons#{reset} obtained from a #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset}.

#{ffaa00}Latex#{reset} is a rubber alternative which can be used in some recipes instead of normal rubber. It can be created early on using a #{00aaaa}Burner Press#{reset} by processing dandelions or jungle wood.

#{00aa00}In NTM: Space cracked oil is required to obtain the first piece of rubber.
ntnhcore.questtext.7b9ae1d61f80b9a5ee4fd:
#{ffaa00}Semtex#{reset} is an explosive that is used in conjunction with C-4 in many crafts.

Semtex is used in many crafts of various ammunition and mines, such as the #{ffaa00}Stinger missile#{reset}, #{ffaa00}anti-personnel mines#{reset}, and so on. In all crafts that use Semtex (except, of course, the Semtex block and Semtex bar, as well as the explosive reactive armor plate), it can be replaced with a C-4 bar.

It is used to create the bomb of the same name.

#{00aa00}Semtex can be eaten, making you feel like a real American soldier.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.dcbc93528df2098e8fe14: #{ffaa00}Solid Fuel#{reset} is a compact solidified petroleum product with superior burn time and heat output compared to coal. Essential for advanced furnace operations and rocket propulsion systems.
ntnhcore.questtext.4eb184c53e8859fe77878: The #{ffaa00}Survey Scanner#{reset} is a handheld device that will point out underground resourse deposits, such as #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset} and #{ffff55}Bedrock Ores#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.331f3e244e9da045af8b7:
The #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset} is a solid fuel-powered furnace used to create different alloys out of two inputs. The main starter alloys are: #{ffaa00}Minecraft Grade Copper#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Steel#{reset}. Inserting #{55ffff}Hot Air Blast#{reset}, made by putting #{55ffff}Compressed Air#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}, grants all recipes a #{ffff55}3x#{reset} boost.
#{55ffff}Flue Gas#{reset} produced from operating the machine can be burnt for energy or vented into the atmosphere.

Steel tools come equiped with vein mining, making them an excellent early-game tool.

#{00aa00}For more advanced tools later on, pressing the ALT key will bring up a menu from which one can select multiple abilities at once.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.6b21d0ae8d805cf687ff7:
#{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Barrels#{reset} are useful storage devices that can hold various fluids in various amounts. Each tank and barrel supports holding different types of corrosive, hot, or exotic fluids, and knowing which ones can hold your desired fluids can be vital to your fluid processing and storage facilities.

Tanks can hold up to 256,000mb of fluids, while a Steel Barrel can hold 16,000.

#{aa0000}#{00aa00}Tanks cant hold highly Antimatter and Corrosive fluids and as such a Big-Ass Tank 9000 or a Magnetic Tank is needed respectively.
ntnhcore.questtext.df868dcf7b960cb7628ac:
The #{00aaaa}Teleporter#{reset} can be used to teleport players, and entities in general, to a specific location.

Right-click a block with the #{ffaa00}Telelinker#{reset} to set the desired exit position, then shift-click the teleporter with the telelinker to configure the teleporter.

#{00aa00}The teleporter is a one way trip so it is advised that multiple are made.

Interdimensional teleportation using teleporters requires a very expensive type of fuel, so it is recommended that other teleportations methods are used, such as AE2 Spatial.
ntnhcore.questtext.72329a158f13ffd9819d7: #{00aaaa}Transport Drones#{reset} are flying machines which will transport items and fluids between different containers. The drones require no power, and can transport both up and down. #{00aaaa}Waypoints#{reset} can be used to make a better path for the transport drones to move around.
ntnhcore.questtext.96bffda4fc898956e6766: #{ffaa00}Weapon steel#{reset} is a steel alloy made by further refining steel in a #{00aaaa}Rotary Furnace#{reset}. As its name implies, it is used in the crafting of weapons and ammunition. It is the next tier of weapons grade alloy after #{ffaa00}Gunmetal#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.8161a48600bac5d928a81:
#{ffaa00}Tantalium#{reset} is a material needed for the creation of some items, most importantly #{ffaa00}Capacitor Boards#{reset}. Tantalium Polycrystal production requires #{ffaa00}Coltan#{reset} which can be located by the use of a #{ffaa00}Coltass#{reset}. Coltan can also be obtained by using the mining drill in a #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore Coltan Deposit#{reset} located randomly on planet Dres. Tantalum can also be obtained via #{00aaaa}Watz Reactor#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Coltan Processing at its early stage can provide Niobium needed for Catalytic Cracking Towers.
ntnhcore.questtext.7bf2364580982417e07ca:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Coupler#{reset} turns outgoing plasma energy from a torus into usable #{ffff55}KyE#{reset} which can then be used to power another torus. Some fuel combinations require this, as the minimum #{ffff55}KyE#{reset} energy needed to ignite the plasma exceeds what four #{00aaaa}Klystrons#{reset} could deliver.

The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber#{reset} uses neutron flux from a torus to in order to process materials. It can perform any recipe from an #{00aaaa}RBMK irradiation channel#{reset}, with some additional recipes aswell. The neutron flux is not affected by port sharing rules, and the output level is the same on any side.

The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Collection Chamber#{reset} increases the byproduct production rate by #{ffff55}50%#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.ec301b6d849ce5eff9baf:
The #{00aaaa}Catalytic Reformer#{reset} is an optional late-game oil processing machine. It converts certain oil products into more valuable ones.

The #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset} is another optional late-game oil processing machine that allows for easier production of #{55ffff}Sour Gas#{reset}, which can also turn #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} into #{55ffff}Desulfurized crude Oil#{reset}. 

#{00aa00}The Hydrotreater requires pressurized Liquid Hydrogen in all its recipes, requiring the use of a Compressor.
ntnhcore.questtext.62b2ab17ccf9e8446a851: #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} is a substitute of #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset} which can be made from acidizing #{ffaa00}Oily Dirt#{reset}, found near #{ffff55}bedrock oil deposits#{reset} or from the environmental damage the #{00aaaa}Fracking Tower#{reset} does, with #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.5d995ef92a36a4dad96b8: The #{00aaaa}Big-Ass Tank#{reset} is the largest fluid storage container, capable of storing 2048000mB of fluids, aswell as being able to hold strongly corrosive fluids. It has to be placed on the solid surface, otherwise it is going to break.
ntnhcore.questtext.e008693bc38963b82a2b2:
#{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset} is an important material needed in many advanced crafting recipes. Bismuth can be obtained from either #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} fuel depletion and processing though a #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} and #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset}, or from bedrock ore processing using #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}. 

#{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} will require an additional #{55ffff}Ore Acidizer#{reset} aswell as access to high-performance solvent.

#{00aa00}Due to the lack of bismuth bedrock ore available on earth and the amount of time it takes to process RBMK fuels, it is recommended that some arsenic is used instead of bismuth.
ntnhcore.questtext.8010ce856bf18969c89ed: #{55ffff}BTX#{reset} is a high-grade powerful fuel which generates a lot of power when burnt. An important use of BTX is in the creation of #{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Hard Plastic Bars#{reset}. BTX can be obtained from a #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset}, but it is more efficient to use #{55ffff}Reformate#{reset} from a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.4c06944fab383b647ef03:
#{ffaa00}Cadmium#{reset} is a material needed to make #{ffaa00}Cadmium Stee#{reset}l, which is a substitute of #{ffaa00}Technetium Steel#{reset}.

Cadmium can be obtained by smelting cadmium powder, which can be obtained acidizing 10 #{ffaa00}Mustard Willow leaves#{reset} with 250mB of #{55ffff}High-Perfomance Solvent#{reset} in the #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset}.

The mustard willow is a plant that can be found near #{ffff55}Bedrock Oil Deposits#{reset}. When it's fully matured, the main item can be obtained, that being the mustard willow leaf.
ntnhcore.questtext.c9021518bc798564c76d3:
The #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset} is a modular breeding reactor with no GUI, built to transmute #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium#{reset} into plutonium isotopes through neutron bombardment. It must be operated manually or via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset}.

Build a rectangular prism of #{ffaa00}Chicago Pile Graphite Bricks#{reset}, at minimum 5*5*5 and at most 15*15*15. Once assembled, drill a non-edge block on one of its lateral faces with the #{ffaa00}Hand Drill#{reset} to establish the core and fix the reactor's channel orientation. Channels are straight lines drilled through the pile and may not intersect. Fuel channels share the core's face orientation and accept rods via a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Fuel Loader#{reset} on the input port; spent rods are ejected from the opposite side. Ventilation channels run perpendicular to the core and require a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Vent#{reset} supplied with #{55ffff}compressed air#{reset} at #{ffff55}1 PU#{reset} - each vent cools only the fuel channels within one block above or below it. Vertical control rod channels are optional and reduce reactivity between channels. 

Every reaction requires a neutron source. The #{ffaa00}Ra226Be Neutron Source#{reset} is the starter option; the more powerful #{ffaa00}Po210Be Neutron Source#{reset} can replace it later. #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Rods#{reset} breed into #{ffaa00}Plutonium-239 Rods#{reset}, which can be bred further into #{ffaa00}Reactor-Grade Plutonium Rods#{reset}. Leaving fuel beyond that point produces #{ffaa00}Nuclear Waste Rods#{reset}, which generate extreme heat and risk meltdown. To safely push out spent rods without fresh fuel, use #{ffaa00}Zirconium Rods#{reset} - they are inert and transparent to neutrons.

#{00aa00}Verify cooling is working before loading any fuel. The pile melts down at 800°C, causing an explosion and widespread fire.

The quest asks for a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset} of at least 5*5*5 with a core established, a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Fuel Loader#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Vent#{reset} attached, and a #{ffaa00}Ra226Be Neutron Source#{reset} loaded alongside at least one #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Rod#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.54e2c77d6e53539a850cc: #{ffaa00}Chlorophyte#{reset} is a product of fusion and is used in the #{00aaaa}DFC#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Digamma Particle#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.9b90a41bea96bd2f1c035: #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Poisonous Mud#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tunsten#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}. This alloy is used in endgame machinery, such as the #{00aaaa}ICF#{reset} and #{00aaaa}DFC#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.5ac9880d2ca987aa95605: The #{00aaaa}Cooling Tower#{reset} is a larger version of the #{00aaaa}Auxiliary Cooling Tower#{reset}#{reset}, able to process up to 500 mB/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.20be9344ca03fed1993b0:
#{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset} is an material which is primarely used in endgame machines, such as the #{00aaaa}ICF#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}FEnSU#{reset}.

#{00aa00}It is recommended that an Effectiveness 3 upgrade is installed on the Acidizer to increase the chance of not consuming the Fullerene, as fullerite can be expensive to produce large quantities.
ntnhcore.questtext.ffe0974845142e1f401f6:
The #{00aaaa}Depth-Resource Scanning Satellite#{reset} maps underground ore deposits across loaded chunks. It is operated via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} through a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset}.

The map lacks labels and detail on its own. Pairing the satellite with #{ffaa00}Neutrino Lenses#{reset} - an armor module linked to the same frequency via the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset} - overlays ores as glowing labeled outlines, making the data far more usable.
ntnhcore.questtext.ee230a5e0b539be6d9ee8: #{ffaa00}Desh Stamps#{reset} have infinite durability, perfect for automation.
ntnhcore.questtext.5636ff6875c9e1bdca0ac:
The #{00aaaa}Deuterium Extraction Tower#{reset} is a much larger version of the Deuterium Extractor, making it an easy and viable way of making cheap fuel for the #{55ffff}#{reset}#{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset}.

#{00aa00}A Ferrouranium Anvil is required.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.c4b0b4dbff0d35a033526: #{ffaa00}Bobmazon#{reset} is an in-game shop where players can spend #{ffaa00}Bottle Caps#{reset} to purchase various items such as building blocks, plants, resourses and many more. To purchase items, one must have unlocked the achievements listed below as "Ratings".
ntnhcore.questtext.0029e2c72373bcf8bc647:
The #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} or Free Electron Laser is a large multiblock utilized with the SILEX to produce various laser wavelengths needed for all SILEX recipes.

A single FEL can power up to 5 SILEX'es. In order to stop the laser any concrete block can be in the its path.

The lower the wavelength of the crystal, the faster recipes will be completed.

The #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset} is a machine that separates isotopes and elements from compounds or other materials via the SILEX (Separation of Isotopes by Laser Exitation) process. It allows for easier enrichment of #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Plutonium#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Australium#{reset}.

The SILEX can also process #{ffaa00}Lapis Lazuli#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Aluminium#{reset}, and most importantly #{ffaa00}Cobalt#{reset}. It can use #{55ffff}Hydrogen Peroxide#{reset} to liquify any material to be processed, the material may even be in a powder state. The processed items come out into the right side collection of slots.

The SILEX must be placed at least 2 blocks away from activated FEL laser, or else its going to melt.
ntnhcore.questtext.ae37921e0f254e8a17cda: #{ffaa00}Ferric Schrabidate#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Ionized Particles#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset}. It can also be used to create schrabidate capacitors, which are a great way of storing energy.
ntnhcore.questtext.81087e000e8dd1ea6092e: An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T4], which unlocks additional recipes.
ntnhcore.questtext.6fd6c934e123468e16851: With fissile materials obtained from either #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuges#{reset} or nuclear fuel processing, nuclear bombs are made available.
ntnhcore.questtext.8ae00ee26e1e8d6a5d17c:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Boiler#{reset} is simplest method of extracting power from a fusion reactor, outputting #{55ffff}Super Dense Steam#{reset} to be run through normal turbines.

Due to using plasma energy, both the MHDT and the boiler are affected by port sharing rules, meaning that having multiple connected MHTDs, or boilers, decreases the amount of energy each turbine gets, but overall increases the total amount of extracted from the torus.
ntnhcore.questtext.c7bea358fc57b2359ddc8:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} is a large, expensive, and advanced reactor type that runs by fusing various plasma types to generate heat.

The main part of the fusion reactor, the #{00aaaa}"Torus"#{reset}, features four connecting ports for external components. It requires electricity and #{55ffff}Perfluoromethyl#{reset} cooling to operate.

The #{00aaaa}Klystron#{reset} is the main power source of the fusion reactor, which uses electricity and compressed air, to generate input energy, #{ffff55}KyU#{reset}, for the connected torus. It will throttle if the buffered electricity or compressed air falls below #{ffff55}50%#{reset}, and if it falls below the torus' required input level, the plasma will extinguish.

The different plasma types also generate different useful byproducts and differing levels of neutron flux for breeding bulk quantities of materials, such as #{ffaa00}Lithium#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Tritium#{reset}.

Welding the coils will require a #{ffaa00}Blowtorch#{reset} or an #{ffaa00}Acetylene Welding Torch#{reset}.

#{00aa00}For the additional components and power generation methods, please check out the two quests below.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.d01a2a1bef583c0bf24d1:
The #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuge#{reset} is used to centrifuge #{55ffff}Uranium/Plutonium Hexafluoride#{reset} to obtain enriched fuel for bombs and reactor fuel.

Two gas centrifuges in a row will yield #{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Uranium Fuel#{reset} used in reactors. The uranium hexafluoride processing line does not consume the #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Fluorite#{reset}, so loops are recommended.

The #{ffaa00}Gas Centrifuge Overclocking Upgrade#{reset} is needed to obtain #{ffaa00}Uranium-235#{reset}. Four gas centrifuges will have to be placed in a row and the upgrade on the last of them to obtain uranium-235 nuggets.

[F1] For more information.
ntnhcore.questtext.86cb458502db020444a9b:
The #{ffaa00}Gravity Gun#{reset} is an advanced tool which can lift and throw blocks. It is particularly useful for moving highly hazardous blocks, such as corium from a reactor meltdown, or throwing explosives.

#{00aa00}The gravity gun can be supercharged in a Cyclotron using Ionized Particles, further increasing its range and power.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.questtext.7ce649c8e7aa9ff6c318a:
#{ffaa00}Hard Plastic/PVC Bars#{reset} are very durable plastics needed for many late game recipes. 

#{00aa00}Both can be used in the same recipes.
ntnhcore.questtext.52e5922ee2127d2da4048:
The #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}, when receiving heat from below, heats up fluids. Two important uses of the boiler are for #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} and #{55ffff}Oil#{reset} processing which will come later on. The Boiler can explode if its output is full.

Steam, when used by machines, such as reactors sending steam through #{00aaaa}Turbines#{reset} or #{00aaaa}Chemical Factories#{reset} produce #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}. The low-pressure steam can be recycled back to retrieve 100% of the water by using a #{00aaaa}Steam Condenser#{reset}. Closed water loops are recommended for reactors.
ntnhcore.questtext.ba0b66825d7f3f5cc2713: The #{aa0000}#{00aaaa}Heat Exchanging Heater#{reset} is used to cool down coolants used in reactors while also genearting #{ffff55}TU#{reset}. A #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset} can be placed ontop of it to heat up other fluids, such as #{55ffff}Steam#{reset}, to be used in #{00aaaa}Steam Turbines#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.fa1c93631b4694cddfb16: The #{00aaaa}Heavy Magnetic Storage Tank#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Magnetic Antimatter Container#{reset}. It will be particularly useful when making #{ffaa00}Gerald#{reset}, as he will need very large quantities of #{55ffff}Stellar Flux#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.335c873d528060a7b6887: #{55ffff}Helium-4#{reset} is a product of fusion and is mainly used in crafting #{ffaa00}Quantum Processing Units#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.3d8caa0c1801c16988cf5: The #{ffaa00}HEV Mark IV#{reset} is a strong electric armor set, with the intent of keeping the user safe primarely from dangerous hazards, such as high levels of radiation, fire, certain air particles and more. The suit comes equiped with an #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset} and custom hud.
ntnhcore.questtext.ab6c30d4845f6819c04e7:
#{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} is a solvent which is used in an #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} to further increase the products of bedrock ores, as well as other recipes. It can be created from #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset}, from a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset}, and #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset} or be obtained from an #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} Irradiation Channel.

To transport High-Performance Solvent by hand, a #{ffaa00}Hazardous Material Tank#{reset} is needed.

#{00aa00}High-Performance Solvent made from an RBMK irradiation channel requires an ore acidizer.
ntnhcore.questtext.95c1a67b48441f630803b:
#{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} is the best tier of solvent which can be used in bedrock ore processing, yielding many rare materials such as#{ffaa00} Bismuth#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Technetium-99#{reset}.

#{00aa00}These materials are not available from earth bedrock ores.
ntnhcore.questtext.358c7c1a3be62cb14e1e5: The #{00aaaa}High-Power Steam Condenser#{reset} is the a steam condenser which runs on electricity. It processes up to 60 mB/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.a67b816429eb90311ed04:
Satellites require dedicated infrastructure to launch, identify, and communicate with.

Before anything leaves the ground, every satellite must be assigned a unique frequency using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}. Place the satellite in its right slot to generate a random frequency, then use the left and center slots to copy that frequency onto #{ffaa00}Satellite ID Chips#{reset} or other linked devices such as designators. ID Chips are soldered, so prepare them in advance. The assigned frequency appears in the item's tooltip.

Satellites can be launching using a custom rocket or Soyuz-FG.

Once a satellite is in orbit, a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset} handles communication. It does not process #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} signals directly - it requires an external RoR receiver or transmitter. It connects to one satellite at a time, switched via the appropriate #{ffaa00}Satellite ID Chip#{reset} or an RoR command. RX reads data transmitted down from the satellite; TX sends commands up to it.

#{00aa00}The Ground Station's capabilities expand significantly when paired with an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset}#{00aa00}, enabling automated satellite tracking, data processing, and chained multi-satellite logic.
ntnhcore.questtext.246f48bda603982489418:
#{ffaa00}Ionized Particles#{reset} are the main product of the #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} and are used in making #{ffaa00}Ferric Scrabidate#{reset}, as well as some particle capsules needed in the #{00aaaa}Particle Accelerator#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Ionized Particles can be infinitely produced by utilizing Ionic Gel.
ntnhcore.questtext.45de16a4630447241df1f:
The #{00aaaa}Chemical Factory#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset}, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It has double the speed of the chemical plant but consumes twice as much power. Additionally, it consumes #{55ffff}Water#{reset} as a coolant, and produces #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}, so a closed water cycle is recommended.

The #{00aaaa}Assembly Factory#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset}, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It functions the same as the chemical factory.
ntnhcore.questtext.db5ea8defc9216e5f80fb:
The #{00aaaa}Presses#{reset} are machines that can be used to make #{ffaa00}Plates#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Wires#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Circuits#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Bullet Casings#{reset} as well as #{ffaa00}Compressing#{reset} non-smeltable powders back into their normal form. They require #{ffaa00}Stamps#{reset} to work, which can be made from the basic #{ffaa00}Flat Stamp#{reset} on the #{ffaa00}Iron Anvil#{reset}.

#{00aa00}A preheater can be placed next to the Burner Press to increase its speed.
ntnhcore.questtext.0806dddfc5f2d8bb482ff: The #{00aaaa}Leviathan Steam Turbine#{reset} is a massive turbine capable of processing gargantuan amounts of #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} at once, only hindered by the fluid system's transfer rate. It is significantly more powerful than even the #{00aaaa}Industrial Steam Turbine#{reset} in terms of raw steam processing power. This turbine runs on #{ffff55}85%#{reset} Efficiency, so it is recommended that only 1-2 are used for very large reactors.
ntnhcore.questtext.8dd49b6f0e0dda0bc6343: Incase of an #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} meltdown, #{ffaa00}Fuel Chunks#{reset} will be thrown near the reactor. The #{ffaa00}Liquidator Medal#{reset} is an armor modification which passively reduces radiation, making it very useful when handling radioactive items or venturing into irradiated areas.
ntnhcore.questtext.21194af4fd2937290bf57: #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tungsten#{reset} is the product of combining #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Tungsten#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}. It can also be rarely dropped by cybercrabs in #{ffff55}Meteorite Dungeons#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.578b35eba6c34fa966951:
The #{00aaaa}Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite#{reset} precisely locates specific high-energy events within a 250-meter radius of a target point. It is the high-precision counterpart to the #{00aaaa}Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite#{reset}, sensitive to: neutron radiation from nuclear reactors, high-energy particles from fusion reactors and particle accelerators, radar waves from ground radars, and radio waves from #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Stations#{reset} with an active TX signal.

All results are stored internally and accessed via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset}. "esurvey" performs the scan. "ecount" writes the result count to RX. "egetinfo" followed by an index writes the emission type to RX. "egetposition" followed by an index writes the X/Z coordinates - separated by a semicolon - to RX.

#{00aa00}Events are time-limited. Run repeated scans at short intervals to avoid missing short-lived emissions.
ntnhcore.questtext.093de08fe48bb1ee29ca6:
The #{ffaa00}Neutrino Lens#{reset} is an armor modification which can detect and highlight special blocks, such as #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore deposits#{reset}, the #{ffaa00}Pink Log#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Alexandrite#{reset}. 

For the lens to work, it must first be linked to a #{ffaa00}Depth-Resource Scanning Module Satellite#{reset} and then inserted into an armor piece using the #{00aaaa}Armor Modification Table#{reset}.

#{00aa00}The HUD key has to be activated for it to work.
ntnhcore.questtext.af04f69b23449d01ddddb:
With access to #{ffaa00}Tantalium#{reset} for #{ffaa00}Control Units#{reset} and fissile matterials, it is possible to assemble a nuclear bomb. To detonate the bomb one can use a detonator or a redstone signal.

A nuclear explosion will transform ores into more valuable ones, such as #{ffaa00}Coal#{reset} to #{ffaa00}Diamonds#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset} to #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset}. Be prepared with radiation resistant armor before venturing into the crater.

Make sure to stand behind some strong cover if you wish to see the explosion from close by.

#{00aa00}This quest serves as a list of components needed for various bombs. Some of these components can be mounted onto rockets that will carry the payload over large distances.
ntnhcore.questtext.722a46174225fb75e3c34: With the #{00aaaa}Spent Fuel Pool Drum#{reset} to cool down #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} or #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} depleted nuclear fuel and the #{00aaaa}PUREX#{reset} to further process them, many new materials are now available.
ntnhcore.questtext.0d100edb9a7f01e5b56de:
The #{00aaaa}Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum#{reset} is used to decay #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} nuclear waste. The decayed nuclear waste can then be used with a #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} and #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset} to obtain some rare elements, such as #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset}.

#{00aa00}The drum also emmits radiation when theres fuel inside it.
ntnhcore.questtext.bbabc3261b30b04c2e2a6:
The #{00aaaa}Orbital Death Ray#{reset} is a high-destruction orbital weapon. Before launch, link it to a #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}. With a standard designator, enter target coordinates manually; with a laser designator, aim and hold right-click on the target block.

Unlike the #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset}, it has no entity-tracking capability and cannot intercept rockets or hit fast-moving targets. The beam strikes the first surface in its path, so targets in deep cover are safe. Recharge time is #{ffff55}5 minutes#{reset}. RoR commands: "fire" fires at the current target position if the weapon is ready; "canfire" writes TRUE or FALSE to RX depending on whether it has finished recharging.
ntnhcore.questtext.5626c3359207f88af1278:
The #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset} is a solar-powered orbital weapon, a lighter alternative to the #{00aaaa}Orbital Death Ray#{reset}. It fires an instantaneous beam dealing massive damage to entities within a 5-block radius, though its explosive yield is only roughly equivalent to a single block of TNT. Recharge time between shots is #{ffff55}5 seconds#{reset}.

It can be aimed with a #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} or controlled via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} through a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset}. The "fire" command fires at the current target coordinates, or at a tracked entity if one has been set - entity target data is consumed after a single shot. The "canfire" command writes TRUE or FALSE to RX depending on whether the laser has finished recharging. The "setentitytarget" command accepts an entity ID from a #{00aaaa}Radar Satellite#{reset} for precision tracking.

#{00aa00}Entity target data is consumed after one shot, reverting back to coordinate targeting.
ntnhcore.questtext.919954ba8d8d2e1f48e86:
The #{ffaa00}Siphon#{reset} is a tool used to extract input fluids from a machine. Right-clicking a machine with content in it's input tanks will fill any fluid barrels, universal tanks or pipettes (if the fluid amount cannot fill any of the previous options).

#{ffaa00}Pipettes#{reset} can be used to input specific amounts of fluids. Right-clicking or Shift-Right-clicking will increase or decrease the fluid amount.
ntnhcore.questtext.d23f4f859b35a04b9beab:
The #{ffaa00}Cable Network Analysis Tool#{reset} is used to check the integrity of power grids and analyze their main functional components. To perform a test, right-click the analyzer on wires or mechanisms in the power grid. The device displays the following data:

#{ffff55}Links#{reset} - these include wires and mechanisms that can conduct energy (e.g., energy storage units, utility poles).

#{ff5555}Providers#{reset} - all mechanisms capable of producing energy and/or feeding it into the grid (energy storage units in "#{55ff55}green#{reset}" and "#{ffaa00}orange#{reset}" modes, turbines, etc.).

#{5555ff}Receivers#{reset} - everything that absorbs energy from the grid (energy storage units in "#{5555ff}blue#{reset}" mode, grinders, and other mechanisms).

#{00aa00}The analyzer not only displays the above components but also counts them. Each grid is assigned a unique code.

Particles only spawn in a 20 block radius!
ntnhcore.questtext.06ce6532f2308387dfbf6: The #{00aaaa}Plasma Forge#{reset} is a large and advanced assembler that requires a running fusion reactor to work. It can weld plates at twice the speed of a normal welder. It does not accept upgrades, however, it can use up otherwise useless fission fragments and unstable isotopes to gain a temporary #{ffff55}x4#{reset} speed bonus with no penalty.
ntnhcore.questtext.e2fe7d50e2d0bb3645441:
The #{00aaaa}PUREX#{reset} is a machine that can reprocess depleted nuclear fuel into various materials. Most recipes require both #{55ffff}Nitric Acid#{reset} and #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} to function.

#{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} can also be extracted from certain recipes, which require #{55ffff}Schrabidic Acid#{reset}. The schrabidium extracted yields double the schrabidium used to make the acid.
ntnhcore.questtext.d24928dc89c98ed50bd23:
The #{00aa00}#{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} is a modular fission reactor. It is more limited than the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} in terms of capability and fuel types but it is much safer and easier to use due to it melting down more gently and being far more stable in its operation.

Due to the complex and expansive nature of the PWR, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/PWR[/url]

#{00aa00}This quest demands the most essential parts of a PWR, and does not represent the amount needed for a functioning reactor. There are also many other types of PWR Components that can be used.

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.questtext.d4d7bddda77f1740e13b6: Instead of using the #{55ffff}Hot Coolant#{reset} for power, one can use it to make the #{00aaaa}Steel Furnace#{reset} go at ludicrous speeds.
ntnhcore.questtext.4590ffc7db54d1a6ef69c:
The #{00aaaa}Pyrolysis Oven#{reset} is a mid-to-late game oil processing machine that allows easier production pf #{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset}, which is needed in bulk for late-game machines onwards. 

It can process an item with an optional fluid to produce another item and/or fluid. Functionally, it works similar to the #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}, mostly in bedrock ore processing.
Its main use however is in production of #{ffaa00}Fullerene#{reset}, as it can turn #{ffaa00}Tar#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Fine Soot#{reset}, eliminating the RNG of a #{00aaaa}Smokestack#{reset}.

Operating the pyrolysis oven will consume #{ffff55}200kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.c686965ab4ee80ba4ebbe:
The #{00aaaa}Radar Survey Satellite#{reset} detects all radar-visible entities - players, rockets, and more - within a 1000-chunk radius of its target position. It compiles results into a searchable list with entity types and exact coordinates, and can filter results by class name without requiring a new scan.

RoR commands: "survey" scans the area and saves results to both a base list and a filtered list. "filter name" replaces the filtered list with only entries matching that class name - the original list is preserved, so this can be run multiple times for different types without rescanning. "count" writes the number of filtered results to RX. "gettargetid index" returns the unique entity ID for a given entry, which can be passed to other satellites for precise targeting. "getposition index" writes exact X/Y/Z coordinates - separated by semicolons - to RX. "getname index" writes the class name of the entry to RX.

#{00aa00}Pair this satellite with an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset} for automated missile interception.
ntnhcore.questtext.30012bd360f42145ea611:
The #{00aaaa}Radiation-Powered Engine#{reset} turns nuclear waste into decayed waste while also making energy in the process and giving guaranteed consistent decay times.

#{00aa00}Blueprints can be found in structures or purchased from Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.questtext.7e2e078347856fdf3987f:
The #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} is a modular boiling-water type nuclear fission reactor which consists entirely of concrete columns. Each of these columns is either blank or has a specific function that it performs such as holding fuel rods, moderating neutrons, or storing #{55ffff}Water#{reset} to be boiled into #{55ffff}Steam#{reset}. Each column will also exchange heat with the column next to it such that temperature differences between columns will gradually equalize within the reactor. If any column reaches #{ffff55}1500°C#{reset}, the reactor will explode incredibly violently, spraying scrap and immensely radioactive material in every direction.

Due to the complex and expansive nature of the RBMK, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/RBMK[/url]

#{00aa00}This quest provides an optional retrieval task for a cheap and safe RBMK design which can produce High-Performance Solvent#{reset} #{00aa00}without cooling. Simply Place the RBMK Irradiation Channel next to the RBMK Fuel Rod, apply the covers on the collumns and surround them with a solid block.

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.questtext.e3d46058bcc6d3c9cb998: With the #{00aaaa}Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum#{reset} to decay waste and a #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset}, #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} nuclear fuels can be processed into many new materials.
ntnhcore.questtext.b4c2e2bbda294f8712eb4:
#{55ffff}Reformate#{reset} is a product of #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} obtained via a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} or from processing #{55ffff}Naptha#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset}.

#{00aa00}This step can be skipped if making Jet Fuel and BTX using a Hydrotreater.
ntnhcore.questtext.95ee5795a71e85587c372:
#{ff5555}Painsaw.#{reset}

Although the #{ffaa00}Chainsaw#{reset} is similar in functionality to the #{ffaa00}axe#{reset}, its arsenal is much broader. By default, the saw simply mines blocks, but it also has two additional operating modes: #{ffff55}Silk Touch#{reset} and #{ffff55}Vein Miner (5)#{reset}.

It runs on many types of #{55ffff}liquid fuel#{reset} (see the item description for a list). Mining one block consumes 1 mB#{reset} of fuel.

Besides its primary purpose, the Chainsaw can also serve as a decent melee weapon, as it deals significant damage and has modifiers: #{ffff55}Painsaw#{reset} and #{ffff55}Decapitator#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.3ebd75ce84f029bcbd90d: #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset} is used in welding very durable materials, as well as used in making #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.b4346db6bbea2eea47c7f: #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} is a very durable, heat-resistant and corrosion-resistant alloy that is commonly used for making stronger gun parts. It is also used to make #{ffaa00}Starmetal#{reset} and is an important component of the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} reactor.
ntnhcore.questtext.97ff0ec313e501f55ac62:
#{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} is a dangerous material, but one which is needed for the creation of other items, such as #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tungsten#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Ferric Schrabidate#{reset}. It also makes for great reactor fuel. It can be created from exposing uranium ore to radiation using either a nuclear weapon or, more easily, by exploding radioactive barrels found in the abandoned nuclear powerplants in deserts.

#{00aa00}When holding Schrabidium, the player will receive the blindness effect, so it is recommended that a Suit which provides protection from both Bright Lights and Radiation is used.
ntnhcore.questtext.f1e72f27bbf715afb0eee: #{ffaa00}Poisonous Mud#{reset} is the byproduct of the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} operating. This is the solidified version of it which can be used in a #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} to create #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.fdddb1cc359d851ca0478:
The #{00aaaa}Soyuz-FG Rocket#{reset} is an immensely powerful Soviet rocket that is the primary launch vehicle for all satellites. The rocket must be launched from a suitably large mount - in this case, the #{00aaaa}Soyuz Launch Platform#{reset}.

It requires 128,000mB of #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} and #{55ffff}Liquid Oxygen#{reset} to be launched as well as #{ffff55}750kHE#{reset} of power. Pressing the launch button starts a 30 second countdown. After the countdown has completed, the Soyuz will launch.

The Soyuz can, alongside its primary ability to deliver any satellite to orbit, also be set to a cargo mode, in which it can deliver any provided cargo to a distant spot across the world. Obviously, this is an incredibly expensive way to transport goods, and currently doesn't provide much utility.

#{00aa00}Blueprints for the Soyuz can be found in structures or purchased through Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.questtext.a3bc2ace6499e4c86440c:
The #{00aaaa}Spent Fuel Pool Drum#{reset} is used to cool down hot nuclear fuel rods for the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} and #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset}. It has 12 slots.

The drum needs to have atleast one of its sides touching #{55ffff}Water#{reset} to work. The more sides that have water the faster the fuels inside will cool down.
ntnhcore.questtext.7a25b82ff54bd1dc977e9: #{ffaa00}Starmetal#{reset} is a unique alloy made from combining #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} with #{ffaa00}Meteorite Powder#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.b40084554765e5df1e263: The #{ffaa00}Starmetal Pickaxe#{reset} is used as a crafting component for the #{ffaa00}Molten#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Bismuth Pickaxes#{reset}, both being unbreakable and having a lot of abilities. Additionally, both can be used to mine #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.8ded5cb4d08b7a7c8e243: #{ffaa00}Technetium-99#{reset} is a common waste product from the fission of #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Plutonium#{reset}. It is mainly used in making #{ffaa00}Technetium Steel#{reset} and #{ff55ff}AE2 Storage Components#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.f93c1a9c256dac25d95b6: #{ffaa00}Technetium/Cadmium Steel#{reset} is a steel based alloy mixed with technetium-99/Cadmium which has extreme corrosion resistance. It is frequently used in the late-game and acts as one of the main material gates of the #{00aaaa}Fusion#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant.
ntnhcore.questtext.02beb2c8c35d6f60bc89c: #{ffaa00}Wood#{reset} obtained from a tree farm can be smelted or processed in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset} to produce #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset}, which has many uses, such as fuel for #{00aaaa}Furnaces#{reset} or even the #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Flux#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Carbon#{reset} in a Crucible for #{ffaa00}Steel#{reset} production, or even #{ffaa00}Gunpowder#{reset} for ammunition.
ntnhcore.questtext.ca8560b6955385f83b67d: #{ffaa00}Tungsten Carbide#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Tungsten#{reset} and #{55ffff}Syngas#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Pyrolysis Oven#{reset}. It is mainly used in crafting neutron reflectors for reactors and nukes.
ntnhcore.questtext.b4c5b48730e0c613e146a:
#{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} is the most common uranium isotope in the game. 

This material has many uses, some of which are: #{ffaa00}Ferrouranium#{reset}, MOX fuel, depleted uranium ammunition, absorber Pellets for the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant and can also be turned into #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} later on in the #{00aaaa}Exposure Chamber#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.2992236be34aa008a62cd:
The #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} is an oil refinery which processes #{55ffff}Pressurized/Desulfurized Crude Oil#{reset} into 4 liquid products. It is a good way to make #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} by using #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset} and #{55ffff}Chlorine Gas#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Compressors are needed for the oil to be inserted inside the Vacuum Refinery.
ntnhcore.questtext.23f0fe1c43cca98f139be: The #{ffaa00}Versatile Circuit Board#{reset} is the final tier of circuit board, requiring #{ffaa00}Bismuth/Arsenic#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Hard Plastic/PVC Bars#{reset}.  As well as this, it is by far the most expensive circuit board, requiring nearly 55 insulators to craft a single one. Used rarely but in small amounts in advanced machines like the #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} and in large amounts in components for the #{00aaaa}ICF Reactor#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.ff7fc286d2f1da2b2bd4a: The #{ffaa00}Versatile Integrated Circuit#{reset} is the first circuit to use #{ffaa00}Bismuth/Arsenic#{reset}. It is used in more advanced machines such as the #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} and is one of the main components of #{ffaa00}Versatile Circuit Boards#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.d957427e3ed18aa802241:
The #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant is a fission reactor which can produce #{55ffff}Poisonous Mud#{reset}, an important component of #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset}. Although the reactor is not really powerful in terms of energy output, it can be stacked ontop of eachother for increased mud and power production.

If the poisonous mud buffer reaches its maximum, the reactor will melt down and explode, irradiating a wide area around it and causing fallout to fall in a small area around it. As well as this, it will spew poisonous mud in a very wide area which will then corrode any blocks that it comes in contact with, similar to corium.
ntnhcore.questtext.a101da155b29dd1919699:
The #{ffaa00}Welded Technetium/Cadmium Steel Plate#{reset} is the welded varient of the cast technetium/cadmium steel plate and is used in some recipes that require strong materials. 

#{00aa00}Make sure to have good energy generation and storage infrastructure as each plate costs 1.2 Billion HE.
ntnhcore.questtext.6d442380f5f2fae43f97b:
The #{00aaaa}Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite#{reset} monitors the entire map for high-energy events with no range limit, returning only an approximate location. Use it as a first-pass detection layer - once a hit is found, follow up with the #{00aaaa}Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite#{reset} or #{00aaaa}Radar Satellite#{reset} to pinpoint the source.

Events are grouped by intensity. LOW covers mini-nuke detonations, accurate to within 10,000 m. MEDIUM covers active radars and particle accelerators, accurate to within 2,500 m. HIGH covers nuclear explosions, accurate to within 500 m. MEDIUM events persist for only half a second while others last up to a minute, so rapid repeated scans are recommended.

RoR commands: "esurvey" collects all active results; "ecount" writes the total to RX; "egettype" writes LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH for a given index; "egetposition" writes approximate X/Z coordinates for a given index.

#{00aa00}Route this satellite's output through an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset}#{00aa00} to automatically cue more precise instruments when a hit is detected.
ntnhcore.questtext.4aaf30567049ea748db5b:
The #{00aaaa}Xenium Resonator Satellite#{reset} provides unlimited on-demand teleportation with no cooldown. Before launch, its frequency must be linked to a #{ffaa00}Satellite Designator#{reset} using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}.

A standard #{ffaa00}Satellite Designator#{reset} requires coordinates to be entered manually. A #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} is simpler - aim the crosshair at a block and right-click.

#{00aa00}Interdimensional teleportation is not supported.
ntnhcore.questtext.f9c18d1447c4d5b0d783d:
The #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} is the first and cheapest nuclear reactor one can make. Unlike the #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} and #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, it is a fully assembled reactor which requires #{55ffff}Water#{reset} and #{55ffff}Carbon Dioxide#{reset} to operate.

Due to its modest steam output, the ZIRNOX can be paired with several #{00aaaa}Steam Engines#{reset}, though an #{00aaaa}Industrial Turbine#{reset} is recommended for its #{ffff55}100%#{reset} efficiency. A single #{00aaaa}Steam Condenser#{reset} handles the exhaust on lower power fuels. 24 #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Fuel Rods#{reset} using 14kmB of carbon dioxide will yield a power output of around #{ffff55}240kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.1796ad76e1e7ca2db03eb: The #{00aaaa}Charging Station#{reset} will charge electric tools aswell as electric suits when standing near it. Placing more next to eachother will increase the speed at which items are being recharged.
ntnhcore.questtext.60b0775b28d2d059c31ba: The #{ffaa00}Red Key#{reset} is able to open any container that requires a regular key, regardless of the pin configuration of the lock, and it is one of the only two keys capable of opening the keyhole found on strange stone, in order to open a #{ffff55}Red Room#{reset}. The key has no durability, and can be reused indefinitely.
ntnhcore.questtext.9b795cf8b410827b39f42: The #{00aaaa}Alkylation Unit#{reset} is designed to convert lighter hydrocarbons into useful heavier hydrocarbon products. From #{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} it can produce #{55ffff}Unsaturated#{reset} and #{55ffff}Aromatic hydrocarbons#{reset}, commonly used for #{ffaa00}Rubber#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset}, and even produce #{55ffff}BTX#{reset} via the use of #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}. As a utility, it can also alkylate #{55ffff}Petroleum Gas#{reset} into #{55ffff}Light Oil#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.f746a00b031ca7cf49661: The Air Liquefaction Tower is intended for obtaining liquid nitrogen from compressed air.
ntnhcore.questtext.44ba2cb8f3299932dca94: The #{00aaaa}Atmospheric Compressor#{reset} collects air from different planets. In combination with a #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset} it can produce many useful fluids and gasses.
ntnhcore.questtext.91dd129beff3d4d58f486: The #{ffaa00}Atmospheric Scanner#{reset} shows the atmospheric consistency of planets. Useful for when terraforming.
ntnhcore.questtext.dd0e53ce433cec6f46d8e: #{55ffff}Brine#{reset}, which is found in deposits similar to oil ones on earth, can be processed to obtain materials such as #{ffaa00}Nickel#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Copper#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset}, and fluids such as #{55ffff}Hydrogen#{reset} and #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.e914ba401af06953e98c2:
#{ffaa00}CMB Iserts#{reset} are an armor modification which will protect its user from the corrosive atmosphere of #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}. 

The #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester#{reset} will return back with #{55ffff}Jool Air#{reset}, to be processed by the #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.c1b7dc51ff58967ff0271: The #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset} can split atmospheric gases into 4 useful fractions, like for example, taking trace amounts of #{55ffff}Nitrogen#{reset} out of the Dunaian atmosphere to produce soil for planting crops.
ntnhcore.questtext.76ba029b3970aaeeee810: This planet has some of the most prized resources in the whole system, with even the primary fraction of bedrock ore consisting of incredibly valuable metals and materials. #{ffaa00}Niobium#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Coltan#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Lanthanium#{reset} ore is present here in vast quantities.
ntnhcore.questtext.2e30c1c8359d63e33a5af: The #{ffaa00}Charm of Protection#{reset} diverts meteorites away from the player and prevents them from destoying blocks. It is recommended that one is obtained as soon as possible as to prevent costly damages in the future.
ntnhcore.questtext.75751150b3bb8adf836a8: The #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 3#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Laythe#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.987fd8489110942f92ed8: The #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 2#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Dres#{reset} and #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.97b7874ae2c2b7e22bc73: #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 1#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Duna#{reset}, #{ffff55}Ike#{reset} and #{ffff55}Moho#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.74d5b01cc694540fd7d42:
With a #{00aaaa}Drop pod#{reset}, one can access their space station without needing to build new rockets. They can also be used to land on other planets once the station has reached them.

#{00aa00}Make sure to keep spare drives.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.635ae032ee868832206bb: The red planet, home to vast quantities of #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}. #{ffaa00}Molysite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Volcano Gems#{reset} can be found here in basaltic caves, found within basins where vast oceans were theorized to once exist.
ntnhcore.questtext.37459312eed4cd2b53f4c: While it is possible to travel here with only a tier 2 drive processor to exploit the incredibly powerful schrabidic resources that exist here, players will not last long without the appropriate armor inserts, due to the highly corrosive atmosphere melting any armor it comes into contact with.
ntnhcore.questtext.57d244faaee6ed4d53c0b: #{ffaa00}Gallium Arsenide#{reset} is made from mixing #{ffaa00}Gallium#{reset}, which can be procured by processing rich mineral deposits from #{ffff55}Moho#{reset} or #{ffff55}Ike#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} which is found on Ike in bedrock ore, or on #{ffff55}Earth#{reset} via dirt and stone that has been damaged by hydraulic fracking.
ntnhcore.questtext.aeede0643a24f441e95a1:
The #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester Station#{reset} is a device for collecting atmospheric air samples from gas giants.

The concept is quite simple: on a planet that is a satellite of the giant (for example, to fly to the green giant Jool, you need to go to Laythe), the station is set up. After refueling with #{55ffff}Liquid Oxygen#{reset} and #{55ffff}Hydrogen#{reset}, the #{00aaaa}harvester rocket#{reset} is sent for air. In one trip, it delivers 16,000 mB#{reset}. As you can understand, the harvester's#{reset} functionality is completely analogous to the operation of #{00aaaa}MiningModules#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.a0b50d80a30502ccb3792: #{ffaa00}Hafnium#{reset} is a rare light metal needed to produce the #{ffaa00}Hafnium chips#{reset}, which at this stage in progression can only be obtained by centrifuging niobium crystals, which must be created from niobium ore, only found on #{ffff55}Dres#{reset} and #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.f242078412ba8d57b88d7: #{55ffff}Hydrazine#{reset} is a powerful rocket fuel which is needed to operate a #{00aaaa}Drop Pod#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.db1f5005bed24c56cf916: The #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset} is a machine needed for several processes, turning fluids into other fluids, synthesis of different compounds, ect. Like the #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset}, recipes can be selected entirely within the GUI.
ntnhcore.questtext.c728dc2778f5bc9ef74e9: #{ffff55}Ike#{reset}, the sole moon of #{ffff55}Duna#{reset}, has hints of a past as a significant hazardous waste dump, with large spires and pyramids reminiscent of potential designs on Earth for warning future civilizations of great danger in relation to nuclear waste. #{ffff55}Meteor dungeons#{reset} spawn more frequently here, and pools of #{55ffff}Alkyl Bromide#{reset} can be found on the surface.
ntnhcore.questtext.d874ee86a80940fbb8a9a: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Greenhouse#{reset} converts #{55ffff}Carbon Dioxide#{reset} into #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset} via crop growth. The greenhouse can also be supplied with #{ffaa00}Fertilizer#{reset} for faster growing.
ntnhcore.questtext.682c20313d3ab8d5d5646: A beautiful water world, teeming with life, oceans lit up with fields of glowgrass. #{55ffff}Jool gas#{reset} can be harvested from here using a #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.f712690e088d1d546cba3:
Unlike its counterpart from the original mod, the Magma Drill does not literally drill into the depths. It is designed for extracting magma from Moho, which, as known, is abundant on this planet both on the surface and in caves. To start working, the mechanism must be installed directly on the surface of a lava lake so that the lava touches the drill head and reaches the edges of the recess. Supply power to the drill, and it will operate automatically.

Magma is output through casting channels into molds. Cooled magma forms Vulcanite, which should then be processed to obtain useful resources.

In addition to volcanite, the device extracts regular slag (much more than Vulcanite).
ntnhcore.questtext.fd486afd1ad6f07261fa3:
