ntnhcore.questtext.b14496c49a29cf858a1a0:
The formation of a volcano is driven by the #{00aaaa}volcanic core#{reset}, a block that continuously erupts #{55ffff}lava#{reset}, allowing the volcano to grow. The #{55ffff}lava#{reset} cools quickly, turning into #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{ffaa00}basaltic ore#{reset}.

The resulting volcano grows quite slowly, reaching about 60 blocks in height over 20-30 minutes.

#{55ffff}Volcanic lava#{reset} differs from #{55ffff}regular lava#{reset} not only in appearance. It "melts" any non-explosion-resistant blocks, so the volcano can extend underground.

#{ffaa00}Basaltic ores#{reset} (#{ffaa00}asbestos#{reset}, #{ffaa00}sulfur#{reset}, #{ffaa00}fluorite#{reset}, #{ffaa00}molysite#{reset}) form when the #{55ffff}lava#{reset} cools, each with a 0.5% chance.

#{ffaa00}Volcanic gem ore#{reset} spawns with a 5% chance if the following conditions are met:
- All 6 blocks around the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset} are #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{55ffff}lava#{reset};
- The block 10 blocks above the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset} is #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{55ffff}lava#{reset};
- There are fewer than 3 #{55ffff}lava#{reset} blocks around the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset}.

The #{ffaa00}ore#{reset} also forms after #{55ffff}volcanic lava#{reset} contacts #{ffaa00}diamond ore#{reset}.
This means #{ffaa00}volcanic gems#{reset} most often appear near the #{00aaaa}core#{reset} or #{00aaaa}crater#{reset} of the volcano.

#{00aaaa}Forming a Radioactive Volcano#{reset}
If the #{00aaaa}volcanic core#{reset} is exposed to radioactive fallout (e.g., after a nearby nuclear explosion) for some time, the #{00aaaa}core#{reset} will begin generating new #{55ffff}volcanic radioactive lava#{reset} (yellow in color), ultimately leading to the formation of a so-called #{00aaaa}radioactive volcano#{reset}. Such a volcano will consist not of #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} but of various types of #{ffaa00}quenched sellaphite blocks#{reset} and #{ffaa00}sellaphite ores#{reset}. The #{55ffff}lava#{reset} will convert #{ffaa00}diamond ores#{reset} into #{ffaa00}radioactive gem ore#{reset}.

ntnhcore.questtext.054a8674728dbf69f0708:
#{00aaaa}Conveyors#{reset} provide the simplest way of moving items around. There are multiple blocks that can interface with machines as well as items moving along conveyor belts.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Belts#{reset} are blocks used to transport items. They can pick up dropped items or items from conveyor ejectors. Conveyor inserters can take items from conveyor belts. If there are no conveyor inserters present, the item will be dropped at the end of the conveyor belt line.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Inserters#{reset} are blocks that take items from conveyor belts and outputs them into a storage space. Conveyor ejectors are the opposite, they take items from storage and place them onto conveyor belts. 

Inserters have an option to destroy surplus items if the input buffer has run full, otherwise the items that can neither be inserted in the target nor the inserter's buffer is simply dropped.

The ejector has a whitelist/blacklist system (the default mode is blacklist with no restrictions - this means that everything will go through). Right-clicking the white arrow will toggle between whitelist and blacklist. An item can be added to the blacklist/whitelist by "depositing" it into the blue inventory square - the item will not be consumed, however.

The #{00aaaa}Conveyor Splitter#{reset} is a type of conveyor belt that splits items evenly onto 2 lanes.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Sorters#{reset} are blocks that can sort various items to a specific conveyor belt. They do not have a buffer and simple move items to connected conveyor belts based on their filter options, therefore they can sort items as quickly as they receive them.
The sorter has six outputs with five slots each, making it able to route multiple items to one belt.
ntnhcore.questtext.737d6c74e57821fe24892:
The #{00aaaa}Dyson Anatmogenesis Terraformer#{reset} provides the most utility out of all the currently available #{00aaaa}Dyson converters#{reset}, accepting a beam from a receiver and providing a direct energy to mass conversion, producing planetary scale atmospheric gases, terraforming any planet or moon as a player sees fit.

By default it will release oxygen into an atmosphere, making it breathable once it crosses the 0.1atm threshold for breathing. A fluid identifier can be used to switch the gas emitted, and a screwdriver can switch it between emitting or extracting gases from the atmosphere.

If powered with #{ffff55}150THE/s#{reset} power from a swarm (equivalent to a swarm size of 1,024), it will take 8 hours to reach 0.1atm of pressure.
ntnhcore.questtext.a56edcb0dd220b7c2f29e:
#{00aaaa}Dyson Swarms#{reset} consist of thousands of swarm members encircling the parent star of a system, and energy production from the swarm scales based on the number of members in a swarm. These satellites do not last indefinitely however, they attenuate (decay) over time, with the chance of decay increasing as the number of swarm members increase.

#{ffaa00}Dyson Swarm Members#{reset} must be launched into solar orbit via the use of a huge centrifugal launch platform, known as the #{00aaaa}Spinlauncher#{reset}. The spinlauncher launches 4 swarm members at a time, consuming a large amount of electricity to do so.

The #{00aaaa}Dyson Receiver#{reset} is the main machine required for collecting energy from the swarm. It collimates the immense energy collected from the swarm into a immensely powerful beam. Setting up requires only a satellite ID chip that is matched to an existing swarm. The energy beam must be pointed towards a Dyson Power Converter.

The #{00aaaa}Satellite Dyson Relay#{reset} can be used to allow dyson swarms to provide power during night time.

ntnhcore.questtext.bd7cb5190e4f671e741a3:
The #{00aaaa}Diesel Generator#{reset} is a compact, single-block generator that burns liquid fuels to produce energy. Its small footprint and compatibility with common oil-processing byproducts make it a strong choice for early- and mid-game power.

It holds up to #{55ffff}4,000 mB#{reset} of fluid internally, consumed at a steady rate of #{ffff55}20 mB/s#{reset}. It also carries a #{ffff55}50 kHE#{reset} energy buffer - but combustion does not pause when the buffer is full, so any excess energy is wasted. To avoid this, ensure your machines are drawing power consistently.

Fuel can be supplied via fluid ducts or by placing barrels in the internal item slots. A #{ffaa00}Fluid Identifier#{reset} can be inserted to lock the accepted fuel type. Not all fuels are equal - effectiveness varies by grade: medium-grade fuels run at #{ffff55}50%%#{reset} efficiency, high-grade at #{ffff55}75%#{reset}, and aviation fuels at just #{ffff55}10%#{reset}. Low-grade and gaseous fuels are rejected entirely.

#{00aa00}Tip: High-grade fuels like diesel, gasoline, and biofuel get the best return - prioritize refining your oil into these where possible.#{reset}

ntnhcore.questtext.a0d5fde3080730af23bf5:
#{00aaaa}Barrels#{reset} are storage blocks that can hold both fluids and solid blocks. Wooden barrels will leak liquids over time and burn down if filled with lava, so use a stone barrel for those recipes.

Barrels placed under open sky will collect rainwater during downfall.

When filled with organic material, a barrel will begin composting once completely full. After roughly 100 seconds it produces a dirt block, ejected by right-clicking. Dirt left near mycelium will slowly convert into a mycelium block, no Silk Touch needed.

A wooden barrel filled with #{55ffff}Water#{reset} placed next to cobblestone will slowly convert it into mossy cobblestone, costing #{ffff55}100 mB#{reset} per block. The surrounding blocks must be unaffected by rain. Placing a barrel on mycelium converts its water into #{aa00aa}Witch Water#{reset}, though the barrel itself may disappear in the process. Water flowing above a barrel filled with lava transforms into obsidian.

Stone barrels can spawn creatures when tapped with a doll: a barrel of lava with an Angry Doll summons a Blaze, and a barrel of #{aa00aa}Witch Water#{reset} with a Creepy Doll summons an Enderman.

Barrels can convert items using fluids: #{aa00aa}Witch Water#{reset} turns sand into soul sand, lava turns redstone into netherrack or glowstone dust into end stone, and #{55ffff}Water#{reset} can turn dust into clay, milk into slime balls, or mushroom stew into #{aa00aa}Witch Water#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Hoppers can be used to insert and eject items from barrels, making composting easy to automate.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.e6a8f252b04207a19098a:
#{00aa00}This quest serves an a guide on how to order items using the ME system. The example item will be an Analog Circuit.#{reset}

With an #{00aaaa}ME Drive#{reset} providing item storage, a #{00aaaa}Crafting CPU#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Interfaces#{reset}, one can request any item to be crafted. The image below makes use of a #{00aaaa}Molecular Assembler#{reset}, a #{00aaaa}Soldering Station#{reset}, an #{00aaaa}Electric Press#{reset} aswell as two #{00aaaa}Import Buses#{reset} which serve as an output for the solderer and press.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_Auto1.png[/img]

The first step in automating crafting recipes is to encode #{ffaa00}ME Patterns#{reset}. There are two types of patterns, crafting and processing. The crafting pattern is created by having the #{00aaaa}Pattern Terminal#{reset} set to the crafting table. After placing the items in the terminal, press the arrow to finish encoding the recipe.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_Auto2.png[/img]

For recipes which arent made in a crafting table, such as the #{ffaa00}Wires#{reset} and the #{ffaa00}Analog Circuit#{reset} itself, the pattern terminal needs to be switched to the processing mode, which has a furnace icon.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_Auto3.png[/img]

After all the patterns have been created, insert them into their respective interfaces.
Make sure to enable blocking mode on the interfaces as not to have multiple different recipes enter the interface at once.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_Auto4.png[/img]

Finally, after everything has been set up, the option to order items will be shown in the ME terminal.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_Auto5.png[/img]
ntnhcore.questtext.aac52e85619d8a5a668ee:
#{ffce86}Modern AE2 with recipe adaptations#{reset}
Applied Energistics 2 for Minecraft 1.20.1 and compatible add-ons are installed. Selected recipes and legacy features are adapted through NTNHCore for HBM progression.

An old AE2 wiki is not an exact description of this pack. Check item, meteorite or machine availability in the current world and JEI. Some legacy add-on features remain unported; an entry in the book does not make them available.

ExtendedAE and Glodium support the adapted wireless branch. Check each device's quest and Known Issues for its limitations.
ntnhcore.questtext.ab8548ed0fca0a55b5eba:
The #{ffaa00}ME Glass Cable - Fluix#{reset} is a cable used to transmit data and energy between devices in an ME Network. It is capable of transmitting #{ffffff}#{ffff55}8 channels#{reset} simultaneously.

The #{ffaa00}Quartz Fiber#{reset} is used to transfer energy, but not channels.

#{ffaa00}Cable Anchors#{reset} can be used to seperate ME cable connections. They can also be used to make #{ffaa00}Facades#{reset} for the cables.
ntnhcore.questtext.a93bd189b09fae85b63cd: The #{00aaaa}Cell Workbench#{reset} allow to filter cells to accept specific items. It can prove useful for when making a subnet for #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore Processing#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.0808ecb971c15e8416720:
#{ffaa00}Certus Quartz#{reset} is an important material in AE2. It is dropped when mining or processing certus quartz ore at the rate of one to four, the yield is affected by a tool's Fortune enchantment. Certus Quartz is often interchangeable with vanilla #{ffaa00}Nether Quartz#{reset} in the recipes for basic tools, such as the #{ffaa00}Quartz Cutting Knife#{reset}. Certus quartz ore can be acidized or centrifuged for an increased yield.

#{00aa00}Certus quartz can later be made in a Chemical Plant using nether quartz.
ntnhcore.questtext.d66793aa2f5a9cf663bda: The #{00aaaa}Charger#{reset} is a machine which will charge #{ffaa00}Certus Quartz Crystals#{reset} into their charged form at the expense of power.
ntnhcore.questtext.c13cb80aeb4aecbf9cec7: The Crafting CPU is a multiblock structure composed of #{00aaaa}Crafting Co-Processing Units#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Crafting Storage#{reset}. When placed next to eachother they form one CPU which is used when placing orders via #{00aaaa}Interfaces#{reset}. The more crafting co-processing units the more tasks the CPU can do in parallel while more crafting storage allows for bigger orders to be made.
ntnhcore.questtext.4e659babeacd9afea56f3: The #{00aaaa}Crystal Growth Accelerator#{reset} is a machine that uses energy to accelerate the process of crystal purification. This process transforms crystal seeds into pure versions of their fully developed counterparts.
ntnhcore.questtext.b7c47644d9907b82aa1c4:
The#{00aaaa} Crystal Growth Chamber#{reset} is a machine in which crystals can grow at an increased speed, while also being in a block instead of being dropped in the ground.

ntnhcore.questtext.aa2cfab4ffb2a53e4d16a:
The #{ffaa00}Dense ME Fluix Cables#{reset} can be used to transmit #{ffff55}32 channels#{reset} from an #{00aaaa}ME Controller#{reset}.

One controller is capable of connecting up to 6 dense cables, in turn each can branch off to 4 smaller cable lines connecting up to 192 ME devices to the network.

The #{ffaa00}Smart Dense Cable#{reset} also displays the amount of channels that are been used, but is known to be less performance friendly than the dense covered cables.

In addition there are 16 colored cables made with the appropriate dye. The colored cables allow contact with other cables without sharing the signal or connecting to any other cable but the ones of the same colour.
ntnhcore.questtext.6228c27729e7b8499f070:
The #{ffaa00}Dosimeter#{reset} is an tool for detecting radiation and assessing radioactive contamination.

It is functionally similar to a #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset}, but it collects much less data - only the general radiation contamination of the environment. Only a handheld version of the dosimeter is available. To obtain radiation information, right-click while holding the dosimeter.

Like a counter, it makes a characteristic crackling sound when radiation is detected.

#{00aa00}The maximum radiation displayed is 3.6 RAD/S.

Not great, not terrible.

ntnhcore.questtext.fd4b4aa93603308f4eb4b:
#{ffff55}Subnetworks#{reset} are ME networks which can be accessed from a #{ffff55}Main Network#{reset}. In #{ff55ff}NTM#{reset}#{reset} they can be useful for storing items from passive processes without flooding the main storage network.

#{00aa00}This quest serves as a guide on how to set up a subnet, which can be used to store the resourses that Bedrock Ore Processing produces.#{reset}

In the image below are two ME networks, the #{ff5555}Red#{reset} one as the #{ff5555}Mainnet#{reset}, and the #{5555ff}Blue#{reset} one as the #{5555ff}Subnet#{reset}.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET1.png[/img]

For the purposes of this quest, the main network will store dirt blocks, while the subnet will store copper blocks.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET2.png[/img]

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET3.png[/img]

To make the contents of the subnet, the copper blocks, visible to the main net, one must make an #{00aaaa}Interface#{reset}-#{00aaaa}Storage Bus#{reset}#{reset} combo. The storage bus must be on the side of the main network.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET4.png[/img]

Make sure to filter the main network storage bus, and to also make it "Extract Only".

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET5.png[/img]

Now the main network has access to materials stored on the sub network, which can be used for crafting.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/BQ_NET6.png[/img]

ntnhcore.questtext.40904617598344465bd9d: The #{ffaa00}Overflow Void Card#{reset} acts as a voiding upgrade for AE2 #{ffaa00}Storage Cells#{reset}. It can be added to a storage cell using the #{00aaaa}Cell Workbench#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.ab9e03e4b42bfcebb2a5e:
#{ffaa00}P2P#{reset} Tunnel or "Point to Point Tunnels" are a versatile configurable system to move items / redstone / power / and fluids from one location to another though an existing ME Network without storage.

Tunnels are #{ffff55}1 input to N outputs#{reset}. This means you can output to as many points as you want, but only input at a single point per tunnel.

Networks can support any number of tunnels, of any different types, and they all function independently.

ME tunnels can be used to carry channels from one location to another, and can carry up to #{ffff55}32 channels#{reset}, same as a #{ffaa00}ME Dense Cable#{reset}, while only requiring a single channel per point, making tunnels a very powerful tool to expand me networks, especially over a distance. However with the great flex-ability they give you comes a limitation, the channel of a p2p tunnel cannot be carried by another p2p tunnel, meaning that you cannot nest them recursively.

To configure a P2P tunnel you must first attune the tunnel to carry what you want it to, then you need to configure the outputs to their input. You configure the connections by using the #{ffaa00}Memory Card#{reset}. First Shift+Right Click the input to save it on your memory card, then simply right click the different outputs to store the input onto the outputs. this also sets the type of the output to match the type of the input.

#{00aa00}An advanced version of the Memory Card can also be made, which interacts with the entire network.
ntnhcore.questtext.1a6f75b333c7604673065:
Parallelisation of processes can significantly cut down on waiting time and as such it is highly recommended that P2P Interfaces are used.

#{00aa00}This quest serves as a guide on how to use P2P Interfaces.#{reset}

As any P2P Connection goes, there needs to be one input, which in this case, holds the #{ffaa00}ME Patterns#{reset}.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_P2P_Interface1.png[/img]

After patterns are inserted in the first P2P interface, place down the rest of the output interfaces you want and link them together using a #{ffaa00}Memory Card#{reset}.

In the image below, the P2P interface highlighted in green stores the patterns, while the ones in blue, are the output ones which will connect machines to the ME system.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_P2P_Interface2.png[/img]

Make sure to have blocking mode enabled on all output P2P interfaces as to prevent clogging and having multiple recipes trying to be executed at once in the same machine.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_P2P_Interface3.png[/img]

Finally, place your desired machines at the output P2P interfaces and add a way of retrieving the items once the operation is done, in this case import buses.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_P2P_Interface4.png[/img]
ntnhcore.questtext.80e1de3f4e096fcaf7382:
#{00aaaa}P2P ME#{reset} can be used to transport massive amounts of channels without laying many cables.

#{00aa00}This quest serves as a guide on how to effectively use P2P ME.#{reset}

Once an #{00aaaa}Energy Acceptor#{reset} has been set up, it is highly recommended (and likely needed) that an #{00aaaa}Energy Cell#{reset} is placed next to it as to ensure that there is enough power going to the system, as more components increase the energy demands of the ME system.

After that, 2 #{00aaaa}ME Controllers#{reset} are required, one to provide the channels that machines will use, and another to transport the other's channels by the P2P connections. The top controller can be made bigger by attaching more controllers next to it.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Controller1.png[/img]

After the controllers are placed, on the top controller, a P2P Tunnel - ME needs to be placed on any side. The #{5555ff}Blue Cable#{reset} will serve as the cable that connects the P2P connections, and as such, it needs to be connected to the bottom controller.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Controller2.png[/img]

By linking the P2P connections together using a #{ffaa00}Memory Card#{reset}, the 32 channels from one side of the top controller will only use 1 channel from the bottom controller to be transported to any destination. The #{ff5555}Red Cable#{reset} now has access to 32 channels.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Controller3.png[/img]

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Controller4.png[/img]

By expanding on the previous example, more connections can be added to fully utilize all channels.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Controller5.png[/img]

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_controller6.png[/img]

ntnhcore.questtext.b80a61d54c348208bae4f:
A #{00aaaa}Quantum Network Bridge#{reset} is a multiblock structure that connects 2 potentially distant, or even in different dimensions, network fragments together. Created by crafting 8 #{00aaaa}ME Quantum Ring#{reset} and a #{00aaaa}ME Quantum Link Chamber#{reset} and placing the ME quantum link chamber in the center, and sourrounding it in the 8 ME quantum rings.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Qring1.png[/img]

Each quantum network bridge requires power to function. This power must be provided from the network fragment it is attached to until the bridge is linked; at which time power from either side will be available. However if power is lost, connectivity will fail and power will be drained from the side the bridge is on in attempt to restore connection.

To establish a link between 2 quantum network bridges, you must create a pair of #{ffaa00}Quantum Entangled Singularities#{reset}. One of each will be placed inside of a particular connection. Each Bridge may only connect to one other bridge.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Qring2.png[/img]

AE2 Singularities are created by dumping 256k of any block inside a #{00aaaa}Matter Condenser#{reset}. Singularities can become quantum entangled by dropping a singularity and ender dust and then exploding them together.
ntnhcore.questtext.98418f622037d661dc0be:
#{00aaaa}Spatial IO#{reset} is a way to cut-and-paste physical volumes of space in your world. It works by swapping the defined volume with an identically-sized volume in the spatial storage dimension, sending whatever's in the pylon array to the spatial storage dimension, and whatever's in the dimension to the pylon array.

Spatial IO requires a specific arrangement of its components in order to function, and define the volume to be cut-and-pasted. All of the components must be on the same network in order to function, and you can have only one spatial IO setup on a network. Thus, a subnetwork is recommended.

The #{00aaaa}Spatial IO Port#{reset} controls the spatial IO operation. It shows stats on the multiblock setup, and holds the spatial cells

To perform a spatial IO operation, place a #{ffaa00}Spatial Storage Cell#{reset} in the input slot and give the spatial IO port a redstone pulse. It will then swap the volume in the pylons with the volume in the spatial storage dimension. This means that if you send some set of blocks to the spatial storage dimension, then put another set of blocks in the pylons, put the cell back in the input slot, and trigger the IO port again, the 2nd set of blocks will disappear and the 1st set of blcks will reappear.

Any entity in the defined volume, including you, will be carried along, and if you have no way of getting out, you will be trapped in the spatial storage dimension.

#{00aaaa}Spatial Pylons#{reset} are the main part of a spatial IO setup, and define the volume to be affected. The volume is defined by the bounding box of the outside of the pylons, contracted in by 1 block in all directions.

The #{00aaaa}Flare Stack#{reset} is a generator that produces energy by burning flammable liquids and gases. Any fluid tagged as Flammable can serve as fuel - supply it through pipes or directly via containers.

Operation uses three steps. First, fill the internal buffer (capacity: #{ffff55}64,000 mB#{reset}) with fuel. Second, open the #{ffaa00}Flow Valve#{reset} at the top of the middle section to release fuel from the buffer into the combustion system. Third, enable the #{ffaa00}Ignition#{reset} switch at the bottom of the middle section to ignite the fuel and begin power generation.

Efficiency is low: gases burn at #{ffff55}50%#{reset} and liquids at only #{ffff55}10%#{reset}. Output also varies by fuel type.

Two upgrades are available: the #{ffaa00}Speed Upgrade#{reset} increases throughput, and the #{ffaa00}Effectiveness Upgrade#{reset} improves fuel efficiency.

ntnhcore.questtext.9be12e0ced8169d92f60e:
Fluids are measured in #{ffff55}mB#{reset} (#{ffff55}milli-Buckets#{reset}) and #{ffff55}B#{reset} (#{ffff55}Buckets#{reset}).

1 bucket = 1000mB.

There are two fluid systems that are currently barely incompatible between each other - #{ffaa00}Forge Fluids#{reset}, which is the system that most of the mods are using, and #{ffaa00}NTM Fluids#{reset}, which is the fluid system that is exclusive to NTM.

The #{ffaa00}Multi Fluid Identifier#{reset} is used to select the type of NTM fluid one needs. Shift-Click while holding it to select a fluid.

Those two systems are not compatible directly, however there is a solution called #{00aaaa}Bob Fluid Translator#{reset}. This machine allows to convert NTM Fluids into Forge Fluids. Simply put an universal identifier at the top slot of the machine and then input the desired fluid.

AE2 is only compatible with Forge Fluids.

ntnhcore.questtext.458c06b61529d30cad921:
This system is highly WIP (including this very quest), so do not expect it to be perfect.

This is the simplest method of prospecting, based on visual examination of surrounding material. Right-click on any #{ffaa00}Stone#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Gravel#{reset} block with a #{ffaa00}Prospector's Eyeglass#{reset} and it will tell you if there is a substantial amount of any interesting ore nearby. Three levels of indication are reported, "Faint signs", "Signs" and "Strong signs", allowing you to home in on the source.

Taking and analyzing geological samples, on the other hand, provides similar information to the Eyeglass but in much more detail. First you will need to make a #{ffaa00}Prospecting Pick#{reset}. To take a sample, right-click on any piece of Stone or Gravel with the Prospecting Pick. A Geological Sample item will be dropped.

To analyse the sample, you will need a #{00aaaa}Geological Sample Analysis Kit#{reset} and a supply of #{ffaa00}Litmus Paper#{reset}. To use the kit, place it down somewhere and right-click it to open its GUI. Place the sample you want to analyse in the sample slot and some litmus paper in the slot beside it. Analysis will begin automatically and should finish in a few seconds, after which a report will appear below.

The report shows the place where the sample was taken and the amounts of any interesting mineral traces it contains. You can expect indications of ores within 16 blocks of the sample location, horizontally and vertically, to show up. Ores closer to the sample location will show up more strongly than ones further away.

#{00aa00}To save the analysis report for future reference, place a Writeable Book in the book slot and press the + button.

If you lose the report, you can analyse the sample again to get it back. However, a little of the sample is used up each time you analyse it, and a given sample can only be analysed 16 times before there is nothing left.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.questtext.d46cde860d65324651d44:
This system is highly WIP (including this very quest), so do not expect it to be perfect.

This is an advanced mineral exploration technique for professional miners, providing very detailed information. The #{00aaaa}Geological Surveyor#{reset} machine uses a controlled explosion to send seismic waves into the ground, and by analysing the echoes that come back, builds a map of underground ore densities.

As well as the Geological Surveyor itself, you will also need the following:

1. At least 3 #{00aaaa}Geophones#{reset} placed in a suitable arrangement around the Geological Surveyor. The geophones must be within 16 blocks of the Surveyor, but no closer than 8 blocks to the Surveyor or to each other.
2. Supplies of #{ffaa00}Paper#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Ink#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Gunpowder#{reset} in the appropriate slots of the Surveyor.
3. A #{ffaa00}Button#{reset} or other means of supplying a redstone signal to the Surveyor.

The Surveyor can operate in either #{ffff55}monochrome#{reset} or #{ffff55}colour#{reset} mode, selected using the button beside the ink slots. Colour mode provides more information about types of ores, but is more expensive. #{00aa00}Monochrome mode requires only black ink, whereas colour mode requires all four colours of ink.#{reset}

When all the necessary conditions are satisfied, the Surveyor wil show "#{ffaa00}Ready#{reset}" in the GUI, and a single green light on the outside of the machine. The Surveyor is trigged by a redstone signal. The easiest way to deliver this is to put a button on the side of the machine.

Be prepared for a loud noise.#{reset} Do not be alarmed; the explosion is well contained and should not cause any damage.

Analysing the results and printing the map will take several seconds, during which time the machine will show a flashing #{55ff55}green light#{reset}. When finished, two steady green lights will appear. The map can then be collected from the output slot of the GUI.

A #{ff5555}red light#{reset} indicates an error condition; open the GUI to find out more information.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.questtext.9760d8844b0f6ee97b1b4: #{ffaa00}Graphite#{reset} is a crystalline carbon allotrope, consisting of stacked layers of graphene. Graphite is the most stable form of carbon, and is useful in many environments. It's ability to moderate neutrons makes it indispensable for #{00aaaa}nuclear reactors#{reset} that rely on thermal neutrons to maintain criticality. It's ability to withstand high temperatures and electrical conductivity make it useful as electrodes in the #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Arc Welder#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.008e3a6c4566faab8a8c8:
This mod adds several environmental hazards that will kill you if ignored.

#{ffaa00}Radiation#{reset} is measured in RAD. Effects begin at #{ffff55}200 RAD#{reset} and worsen steadily - instant death occurs at #{ff5555}1000 RAD#{reset}. Use a #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset} to monitor your dose. Radiation-resistant armor and #{ffaa00}Rad-X#{reset} reduce incoming RAD; a #{00aaaa}Player Decontaminator#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Antirads#{reset} remove accumulated dose.

Mesothelioma#{reset} develops from asbestos exposure. Items tagged #{ff5555}[Contains Asbestos]#{reset} and certain blocks like Chrysotile release asbestos particles. Progresses to death if untreated.

Black Lung#{reset} develops from coal dust exposure. Mining coal ore and carrying items tagged #{ff5555}[Coal Dust]#{reset} are the main sources. Also fatal.

A gas mask protects against both mesothelioma and black lung simultaneously. Both diseases are cured by #{ffaa00}SIOX Cancer Medication#{reset} or, early-game, #{ffaa00}Herbal Paste#{reset} - the latter being weaker and carrying side effects.
ntnhcore.questtext.4576c4d3e129779aef94b:

ntnhcore.questtext.19c61d69657354dd14db1:
The #{00aaaa}Firebox#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Heating Oven#{reset} are machines capable of producing heat from solid fuels for any machines that require heat to operate.

Heat is measured in #{ffff55}TU#{reset} (#{ffff55}Thermal Units#{reset}).

Both machines are similar in operation. In order for them to transfer heat, another machine for receiving the heat must be placed on top, such that the copper heat plate on the receiving machine sits on top of the copper heat plate of the heat producing machine.

Once constructed, these machines can be filled with solid fuel, which will burn until either the fuel runs out, or the heat buffer is filled. No fuel will be consumed if its buffer is full - as such, both machines are fairly efficient at conserving fuel.

The primary difference in these two machines lie in their speed: the firebox burns fuel much slower at full efficiency, whilst the heating oven produces five time the heat (but eight times faster). Despite its inefficiency, the heating oven is often preferred for its much higher heat outputs and heat capacity. However, it cannot heat a stirling engine, as its base output (500 TU/t) will automatically over-speed the engine; the heavy stirling engine does not have this issue.

Additionally, the heating oven can receive heat from other heat producing machines placed underneath it: multiple can be stacked for heat-hungry machines like the crucible. The heat received, however, is halved when transferring to the machine above.

ntnhcore.questtext.4a7d5ee135e968ea519fd:
The #{00aaaa}Mining Charge#{reset} is an explosive made with the express purpose of mining, as such it's commonly used to mine depth ores, since it doesn't destroy drops, before getting a pickaxe that can do the same. Mining Charges are a great way of obtaining #{ffaa00}Zirconium#{reset} from depth ores for nuclear fuel rods.

It has an explosion radius of about 3 blocks and explodes instantly upon being powered by redstone, while exploding it does no damage to entities.

There are two other variants of this, being the #{00aaaa}Timed Mining Charge#{reset} and the #{55ffff}#{00aaaa}Semtex Mining Charge#{reset}, they are both timed explosives with the semtex one being stronger than the regular one and having #{ffff55}Fortune 3#{reset}, meanwhile the timed mining charge does not seem to have enhanced capabilities, other than being timed and thus more convinient to use.
ntnhcore.questtext.9bf825f8868e34b7b3da1:
The #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} is a tool from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} used to crush blocks down into finer forms. Its primary role is producing the materials needed for the #{00aaaa}Sieve#{reset}: cobblestone is crushed into gravel, gravel into sand, and sand into dust, each of which can be sieved for different resources.

To use it, simply break a target block with the #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} as you would with a pickaxe. Hammers come in the standard tool tiers -
wood through diamond - and differ only in durability. They can be enchanted, though the available enchantments differ from those on a pickaxe.

Ores can also be hammered down through a multi-step crushing chain. Each step has a small chance to yield bonus
material, making the #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} a basic form of ore multiplication before dedicated processing machines are available.

#{00aa00}Hammering can be automated with machines that simulate block breaking, such as the Auto Hammer from #{ff55ff}Ex Compressum#{reset}#{00aa00}.
#{00aa00}Check JEI for the full crushing chain of any block.

ntnhcore.questtext.9b0391ff592df6b1c239f:
#{ffce86}Use version-specific information#{reset}
Second Dawn uses installed mods' generation with selected adaptations of HBM ores and legacy progression. Exact legacy vein geometry and full planetary equivalence with NTNH 1.7.10 are not claimed.

Legacy Custom Ore Generation is not installed, so disabling it is not an applicable instruction. Do not randomly edit hbm.cfg from an old table. Mining heights and tables for 1.7.10 cannot automatically be applied to 1.20.1.

For suspicious floating platforms, clipped structures or square ore masses, record dimension, coordinates, seed, pack version and a screenshot. Test fixes on a world copy; generation updates do not automatically rewrite old chunks.
ntnhcore.questtext.b64146dc21efa747f98ed: The #{ffaa00}Packing Tape#{reset} allows one to break and move drawers without all the items falling on the floor.

A #{ffaa00}Screwdriver#{reset} is needed to create a connection, and right clicking on the connection with a fluid id will set the gasseous fluid it will use.
ntnhcore.questtext.f688b90fc63425472f83f:
#{ffaa00}Pollution#{reset} is a mechanic affecting several machines related to industrialization. It must be properly mitigated, lest suffer the consequences of a polluted world. There are 3 subtypes of pollution - soot, poison and heavy metal.

#{ffaa00}Soot#{reset} is most common, produced by fossil fuel burning and some other sources. It increases generic mob health and strength. At high enough levels, it becomes visible as smog.

#{ffaa00}Poison#{reset} harms unprotected entities at high enough levels, and is produced exclusively as the consequence from spilling fluids such as CO2 or various oil products.

#{ffaa00}Heavy metal#{reset} comes from the combustion of leaded fuels. It also increases mob strength, but also harms them at high enough levels.

It can also be harmful to entities and players if they aren't wearing gas protection.

Compatible machines can be connected to special exhaust pipes, which are effectively specialized box-ducts, to output to a #{ffaa00}Smokestack#{reset} to reduce the amount of pollution.

The #{00aaaa}Smokestack#{reset} is used to reduce pollution made from machines. #{00aaaa}Exhaust Pipes#{reset}, made in anvils, can be used to transport the fumes to the Smokestack. The #{00aaaa}Industrial Smokestack#{reset} is needed to produce #{ffaa00}Fine Soot#{reset}, required for making #{ffaa00}Fullerite#{reset} in the late game.

An #{00aaaa}Ashpit#{reset} can be installed beneath the Smokestack which will collect #{ffaa00}Ash#{reset}, that can be used as a cheap black dye alternative as well as in the creation of #{ffaa00}Industrial Fertilizer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.8c0f7ea6c0e6e84bbc2be: The #{ffaa00}Pollution Detector#{reset} will monitor and show the levels of pollution present in the environment. High levels of pollution will decrease the visibility, give debuffs to the player and buff mobs, including skeletons spawning with firearms.
ntnhcore.questtext.ca6890259d3c58bb133df: #{00aaaa}Anvils#{reset} are a tiered crafting station that allows for the creation of various machines, structures, and items in some cases. ntnhcore.questtext.3c8488b5b110672a11205:
The #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} is a block from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} used to melt solid blocks down into fluids. It is crafted first as an #{ffaa00}Unfired Crucible#{reset} from #{ffaa00}Porcelain Clay#{reset}, then fired in a furnace to produce a usable #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

To operate it, place the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} above a heat source and right-click it with an eligible block to load it. The block will slowly melt into fluid over time. The speed of melting depends entirely on the heat source below - stronger heat sources melt faster. Burning #{ffaa00}Netherrack#{reset} is among the most efficient vanilla options.

The primary output is #{55ffff}lava#{reset}, produced by melting cobblestone, stone, and similar blocks. The #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} can hold fluids indefinitely, making it a cheap fluid storage vessel in a pinch. Drain it using fluid pipes connected to its side or bottom.

#{00aa00}A bank of Crucibles over burning Netherrack is a reliable early lava farm.
ntnhcore.questtext.28f1b26950bd21c756717:
The #{00aaaa}Radial Performance Engine#{reset} is a combustion generator that converts liquid fuels into electrical power. It requires a minimum of #{ffff55}3#{reset} #{ffaa00}Combustion Engine Pistons#{reset} to run, with up to #{ffff55}9#{reset} installed in its piston slots. Additional pistons increase both power output and fuel consumption linearly.

The engine accepts fuels of varying grades at different efficiency rates. #{55ffff}Heating Oil#{reset} and #{55ffff}Industrial Oil#{reset} burn at #{ffff55}75%#{reset} efficiency, #{55ffff}Petroil#{reset} at #{ffff55}50%#{reset}, and #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset} and #{55ffff}Gasoline#{reset} at #{ffff55}25%#{reset}. Aviation fuels and gaseous fuels are not compatible. Power is output from the bottom face, and the engine stores up to #{ffff55}250 kHE#{reset} internally, or #{ffff55}2.5 MHE#{reset} when running #{55ffff}NITAN#{reset}.

However, the engine is most efficient with the heaviest, least-refined feedstocks. Lighter refined fuels produce less power per mB despite their higher grade.

#{00aa00}The listed efficiency is a multiplier on each fuel's base combustion energy. Higher-grade fuels may have higher base energy, so check the HE/t display in the GUI before settling on a fuel.
ntnhcore.questtext.bd4e91cb13093855aae3c: Now, as you have a better anvil, you can start #{ffff55}recycling#{reset} some stuff you may found in dungeons.
ntnhcore.questtext.c5529191e70a4a64cf792: The #{00aaaa}Rotary Furnace#{reset} is a large furnace which is powered by both #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} and #{ffaa00}#{reset}solid fuel. #{reset}It outputs molten material which can be cast similarly to the outputs of the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset}. The Rotary Furnace is the only machine that can produce #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Weapon Steel#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.b09c580d3f536aee9235f: The #{ffaa00}Settings Tool#{reset} is used to copy settings of machines. It is especially useful when making large refineries.
ntnhcore.questtext.a6419335cbe94f0daabf6:
The #{00aaaa}Shredder#{reset} is a machine that shreds resourses into their powder form, or in many cases, their crafting materials. It can also be used to double ores.

#{00aa00}Shredder blades are required in order for the machine to work.
ntnhcore.questtext.36911cdf64d0b3376261a:
The #{00aaaa}Sieve#{reset} filters gravel, dirt, stone, and other blocks to yield useful material fragments - including iron, copper, lead, and more.

Use #{00aaaa}Heavy Sieve#{reset} with #{ffaa00}Compressed Blocks#{reset} to get more fragments.

#{00aa00}Use JEI to list all possible drops.
ntnhcore.questtext.77fb245a1ac4509c063c7:
#{ffaa00}Silkworms#{reset} are items from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} and the primary way to produce #{ffaa00}String#{reset} on resource-limited maps. They cannot be crafted - the only way to obtain one is as a rare drop when breaking leaves with a #{ffaa00}Crook#{reset}.

To use a #{ffaa00}Silkworm#{reset}, right-click it onto any leaves block. The leaves will slowly become infested, turning white over time, and the infestation will spread on its own to adjacent leaves. Fully white leaves produce more #{ffaa00}String#{reset} than partially infested ones, so it is worth waiting.

Once the leaves are fully infested, break them with a #{ffaa00}Crook#{reset} or your fist to collect #{ffaa00}String#{reset} and additional #{ffaa00}Silkworms#{reset}, keeping the process renewable. Note that infested leaves do not drop saplings or apples, so keep spare saplings set aside before
infesting a tree.

#{00aa00}Silkworms can also be composted in a Barrel if you have a surplus.
ntnhcore.questtext.9b26c0b7854ed43654ece:
The #{00aaaa}Solar Tower Boiler#{reset} is an earlygame machine that can use sunlight from heliostat mirrors to boil water and therefore turn it into steam.

The Solar Tower Boiler gets heat from heliostat mirrors pointed at it. Aiming a mirror at the boiler can be done using the mirror adjustment tool, right-click on the boiler will save its position to the tool, and subsequently clicking on mirrors will aim them at the linked boiler. The maximum range for mirrors is 25 blocks, mirror efficiency does not degrade with range. A boiler consumes 1mB of water for every 12.5 mirrors each tick at full sunlight level, and 100mB of steam per mB of water consumed. However, the water consumption rate is rounded down to the millibucket. Thus it takes 13 mirrors to raise your first 100mB/t of steam, 12 mirrors for the next hundred, then 13, 12, and so on.

As the heat provided by each mirror is based on sunlight, mirrors with solid blocks above them will not work, and the amount of heat diminishes with the amount of light in the evening until it produces no heat at night.

The solar tower boiler can only produce regular steam, and thus the liquid type cannot be changed using fluid identifiers.
ntnhcore.questtext.f1f7cd1d52e1b7c6d737b: The #{00aaaa}Soldering Station#{reset} is the machine in which #{ffaa00}#{reset}circuit components#{reset} can be combined#{ffaa00}#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Circuits#{reset} and where #{ffaa00}Machine Upgrades#{reset} can be created.
ntnhcore.questtext.668e1e7efc343136bf6d5: The #{00aaaa}Arc Welder#{reset} is a machine needed for the creation of many components, such as #{ffaa00}Welded Plates#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Missile Parts#{reset} and more. Some Recipes will require a fluid inserted into the welder to work.
ntnhcore.questtext.e5d70de896a50e1b19c34:
The #{00aaaa}Steam Engine#{reset} is an early game method of turning #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} into energy. It requires an external source to provide steam and a way to dump or reprocess the #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset} it produces. 

The Steam Engine has an energy efficiency of #{ffff55}85%#{reset}, making it better than the #{00aaaa}Stirling Engine#{reset}. However, it still has a throughput limit as it can only hold up to 2000 mB of steam. Its maximum processing rate is 2000 mB/t, producing a considerable #{ffff55}3400 HE/t#{reset} or #{ffff55}68 kHE/s#{reset}. It is therefore the best generator available before #{00aaaa}Steam Turbines#{reset}.

A boiler being heated up by a heating oven using coal will produce #{ffff55}17kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.362178cd7ef835835aaf4: An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T2], which unlocks additional recipes.
ntnhcore.questtext.c6093323f6a3d0e0c9a44: The #{00aaaa}Steel Furnace#{reset}, unlike the other furnaces, runs off of #{ffff55}TU#{reset}. It can also process up to 3 items at a time, but each slot consumes more TU, which makes it slow without a strong heat source. It also has a bonus output for ores and wood, where every smelted item gives #{ffff55}25%#{reset} to the bonus output meter, which means every 4 items give an extra 5th item for free (#{ffff55}+15 items from a single stack#{reset}).
ntnhcore.questtext.16c8248b8793f3db89e86:
The #{00aaaa}Stirling Engine#{reset} uses heat from a #{00aaaa}Heating Oven#{reset} or a #{00aaaa}#{reset}#{00aaaa}Firebox#{reset} to produce power. If a Heating Oven is used to heat a Stirling engine, it will likely over-speed and damage it, sending the main gear flying. The heavy Stirling engine does not have this issue.

A firebox running on coal with a stirling engine produces #{ffff55}2kHE/s#{reset}, while a heating oven with a heavy stirling engine produces #{ffff55}10kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.7310ce85a4df2993fa0c6: The #{00aaaa}Stirling Sawmill#{reset} uses heat to cut wooden related items, producing #{ffaa00}Sawdust#{reset} in the process. Sawdust can be used to obtain #{ffaa00}Paper#{reset}, and if further processed, can be turned into #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}.
ntnhcore.questtext.ae91afa3d511b395b83aa:
#{ff55ff}Storage Drawer Keys#{reset} can be used to modify Drawers in many ways.

The #{ff55ff}Drawer Key locks drawers#{reset}, so no new item types can be inserted into the drawer when its empty.

The #{ff55ff}Concealment Key#{reset} hides the item icon of drawers.

The #{ff55ff}Quantify Key#{reset} shows the item quantities of drawers.

The #{ff55ff}Personal Key#{reset} protects drawers from other players (outside of claims).
ntnhcore.questtext.59f7b84096a2adb06f540:
Storage Drawers#{reset} are an easy and cheap way of storing large amounts of items. They can be further upgraded to increase storage capacity as well as other abilities, such as voiding. They can also be #{ff55ff}Chiseled#{reset} to change their wood type.

#{00aa00}Many drawers may cause lag.
ntnhcore.questtext.5a2f8ac221cc8a350c727: The #{00aaaa}Strand Caster#{reset} is a large basin that can cast items in batches of 9. It also requires #{55ffff}Water#{reset} in order to cast, where it makes #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset} that can be turned back into water.
ntnhcore.questtext.fa5d08c83465a3c76964b: Imagine using the same chemical plant for sulfuric acid AND strawberry ice cream production...
ntnhcore.questtext.bc6ef5296508809f4eb54:
The #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset} is used in every stage of the game, with it being used to manufacture practically every other complex machine. Recipes for it can be chosen inside the GUI.

#{00aa00}Some unique recipes require blueprints, that can be found in dungeons and/or bought from Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.questtext.d52d04c3c5f71b3522d64:
The #{ffaa00}Trench Mask#{reset} is a basic mask that will protect the user from some dangerous airborne particles while mining. To craft one you must first obtain #{ffaa00}Cloth#{reset} and then piss on it by right clicking while holding it.

#{00aa00}String can be easily obtained by harvesting Hemp, found in the wild.

#{reset}I hate to say it, but you are basically sniffing your own piss...
ntnhcore.questtext.10932d20e127a4fd42dac:
The #{00aaaa}Wood-Burning Generator#{reset} is basic method of producing energy by burning wood. It can run on any burnable items but provides burn time bonuses to logs and wood. It can also run on any flammable fuel by clicking on the arrow below the on/off switch, but it is considerably more inefficient than other fluid burning generators.

Burning logs in the generator produces #{ffff55}2kHE/s.#{reset}
ntnhcore.questtext.fa743d7b5411bb1fe1b83:
Congratulations. You have done it. You have actually done it.

While the rest of the world clung desperately to their beef and their bread, you - yes, YOU - reached into your inventory, pulled out a #{ffaa00}Silkworm#{reset}, and thought: "yes. This is food now." Klaus is proud. Klaus is, in fact, emotional. Somewhere in a Swiss
chalet, a single tear rolls down his turtleneck. You will own nothing. You will have no hunger bar. Und you will be happy.
ntnhcore.questtext.70fc6af4713829a791eb4: The #{00aaaa}Armor Modification Table#{reset} allows for armor modifications to be inserted in armor, giving either buffs, new abilities or extra resistance.
ntnhcore.questtext.35eff16ecfbfb2ffc544c: The #{00aaaa}Compressor#{reset} is a specialized multiblock machine for compressing fluids. It can perform this operation on any fluid to increase its pressure, for use in other machines. Some of these fluids are compressed into different fluids entirely as special recipes for this machine.
ntnhcore.questtext.234ad31512c9a940115fb:
#{ffaa00}Glyphids#{reset} are large insects that have many different types. They primarily spawn with naturally generated #{ffaa00}#{reset}hives#{reset} structures. All of the types are armored and they take less damage than against normal mobs. Glyphids are normally attracted to pollution created by the player, and usually have to be dealt with by the player.

#{ffaa00}#{reset}#{ffaa00}Hives#{reset} can spawn naturally in all non-ocean biomes and can also be created by glyphid scouts. They contain several glyphid egg blocks and some low-tier loot inside, lying on top of eggs. glyphid egg blocks spawn glyphids and drop glyphid eggs upon destruction.

Glyphids now periodically retarget the closest player every 5 seconds if their current target is farther. 1/3 of glyphids do not have this behavior to prevent infinite trapping.

#{00aa00}It is recommended that all hives are destroyed as soon as possible as to prevent their spread later on.
ntnhcore.questtext.fec3319db120c509e3fd0: An introduction to HBM Nuclear Tech: basic mechanics, early machines and useful progression tips.
ntnhcore.questtext.4b1050cd71a19e4521cdc: Monitor and control complex machines. Legacy OpenComputers programs still need adaptation.
ntnhcore.questtext.75d1c365ef16ad6e7d71f: Useful tips, hints and reference information.
ntnhcore.questtext.86cab92099908a22dd2f5: Oil processing and bedrock ore mining. Produce plastics, advanced circuits and strong materials.
ntnhcore.questtext.183739b8f4912dd717090: Growing production needs power. Build nuclear reactors and complex machines to obtain new materials.
ntnhcore.questtext.5129990355d6fd877f5c7: Explore space and settle other planets with NTM: Space.
ntnhcore.questtext.d6e77844671b76ffdb149: Impossible physics, quantum computing, magic and the most advanced machines. Reach the final goals of the mod.
ntnhcore.questtext.477f1f71fbf184ef4ce00: Build and decorate your base with the available pack mods.
ntnhcore.quest.257.name: Abandoned Structures
ntnhcore.quest.257.desc:
Structures generate throughout the world and are among the best sources of early-game resources. Raiding them before investing heavily in production can save significant time and materials.

#{00aa00}Exploration pays off early - check your surroundings before grinding for resources you might find for free.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.2561.name: Automatic Buzz Saw
ntnhcore.quest.2561.desc:
With the #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Automatic Buzz Saw#{reset} one can automatically farm trees for their #{ffaa00}Wood#{reset}, aswell as other crops such as #{ffaa00}Hemp#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Wheat#{reset}.

#{00aaaa}Fans#{reset}, when powered by redstone, can be used to push the dropped items into hoppers or conveyors for storage. Use a #{ffaa00}Drill#{reset} on them to remove the diminishing behaviour of pushing force.
ntnhcore.quest.25601.name: Safes and lockpicking
ntnhcore.quest.25601.desc: The #{ffaa00}Screwdriver#{reset} is used to rotate conveyor blocks as well as to create a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset}. It can also be used in combination with #{ffaa00}Bobby Pins#{reset} to unlock #{ffaa00}Safes#{reset} found in various structures.
ntnhcore.quest.25857.name: Useful Tools
ntnhcore.quest.25857.desc:
There are many tools which will help you progress through the mod, the most important ones being:

#{ffaa00}Tungsten Reachers#{reset}, which reduce the radiation the player gets exposed to from items in their inventory, as well as allowing them to hold some very hot items.

The #{ffaa00}Crowbar#{reset}, which is used to open crates for loot such as food and ammunition found in various structures.
ntnhcore.quest.26113.name: Infinite Water Sources
ntnhcore.quest.26113.desc:
Tired of using buckets to give water to your machines? Try using water pumps or infinite water tanks!

Infinite Water Tank will give 50mb/t
Enhanced Infinite Water Tank will give 500mb/t
Pump will give 1000mb/t but requires steam to operate.
ntnhcore.quest.26369.name: Aluminium Processing
ntnhcore.quest.26369.desc: #{ffaa00}Bauxide#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Cryolite#{reset} can be further processed to obtain #{ffaa00}Aluminium#{reset}, with additional byproducts of #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Titanium#{reset} and #{55ffff}Mercury#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.26625.name: Antimatter
ntnhcore.quest.26625.desc: #{55ffff}Antimatter#{reset} is a dangerous substance which can be obtained from a #{00aaaa}Cyclotron#{reset} or a #{00aaaa}Particle Accelerator#{reset}. If dropped on the floor a violent explosion will occur. Antimatter cant be stored in normal tanks, and as such, a #{00aaaa}Magnetic Antimatter Container#{reset} is required.
ntnhcore.quest.26881.name: Auxilary Cooling Tower
ntnhcore.quest.26881.desc: The #{00aaaa}Auxiliary Cooling Tower#{reset} is a larger version of the Steam Condenser able to process up to 50 mb/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.27137.name: Bakelite
ntnhcore.quest.27137.desc: #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset} is an alternative to Polymer and can be used for the same recipes. Since it doesnt require any #{ffaa00}Coal Powder#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Fluorite#{reset} to be made, it is easier and more convenient to automate than #{ffaa00}Polymer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.27393.name: Balefire
ntnhcore.quest.27393.desc:
#{ffaa00}Balefire#{reset} is an extremely radioactive substance which can be used to make powerful fuels for the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, aswell as #{55ffff}BF Rocket Fuel#{reset} for power production. High radiation resistant equipment is needed to hold the item. #{ffaa00}Thermonuclear Ashes#{reset} can be produced sustainably as a byproduct from #{55ffff}Antimatter - BF Rocket Fuel#{reset}.

The High-Tech Bomb Defusing Device can extract balefire shards from duds.
ntnhcore.quest.27649.name: Basic Oil Processing
ntnhcore.quest.27649.desc:
Before #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} can be processed, it must be heated up in a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}.

The #{00aaaa}Oil Refinery#{reset} splits Hot Crude Oil(or later on #{55ffff}Cracked#{reset}) into four different fluid products and one solid byproduct.

After that, those fluids can be sent through a #{00aaaa}Fractioning Tower#{reset} to obtain different kinds of fuels, such as #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} and #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset}. A #{00aaaa}Fractioning Tower Seperator#{reset} can be used to stack fractioning towers ontop of eachother.
ntnhcore.quest.27905.name: Bedrock Ore Processing
ntnhcore.quest.27905.desc:
#{ffff55}Bedrock Ore Deposits#{reset} are an infinite source of resourses which can be obtained by using a #{00aaaa}Large Mining Drill#{reset} and a #{00aaaa}Bedrock Ore Processor#{reset}.

Operating the drill will consume#{ffff55} 200kHE/s#{reset}.

Before excavation can happen, the #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset} covering the bedrock ore deposit needs to be removed. An easy way of doing that is blowing up the rock with #{ffaa00}Mining Charges#{reset}.

The large mining drill is used to excavate #{ffaa00}Raw Bedrock Ores#{reset} from their deposits. The drill requires a #{ffaa00}Drillbit#{reset} to work#{reset}, which can be upgraded to increase the speed at which it operates at. #{ffff55}Fortune#{reset} on a drillbit affects the quality of mined bedrock ore, each level of fortune adds #{ffff55}10%#{reset} of the value to the item.

The bedrock ore processor takes #{ffaa00}#{reset}raw bedrock ore obtained from the drill and breaks it down into smaller pieces, each with different products that can be obtained from them. 
#{55ff55}#{55ffff}Ore Slop#{reset}, which is created when the machine is operating, can be processed into many useful products, especially when it is sent through an #{00aaaa}Electrolysis Machine#{reset}.

The #{ffaa00}Bedrock Ore Desity Scanner#{reset} shows information on the composition of Bedrock Ore deposits.

Bedrock ore processing can be both an energy and resourse expensive operation so it is recommended that it is explored after having good infrastructure.

#{00aa00}Consider adding a Power Saving Upgrade to the drill as it only reduces power without affecting the mining speed. Additionally, installing an Effectiveness Upgrade on the ore slopper will make it give out more resourses.#{reset}#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.2817.name: Automatic Thresher
ntnhcore.quest.2817.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Automatic Thresher#{reset} harvests crops such as #{ffaa00}Wheat#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Hemp#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Sugarcane#{reset}, ect in a 7x7 area when supplied with fuel. It will eject all items from the back.

[F1] for more information.
ntnhcore.quest.28161.name: Catalytic Cracking Tower
ntnhcore.quest.28161.desc: The #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset} is a large oil processing multiblock machine which produces many fluids, such as #{55ffff}Aromatic Hydrocarbons#{reset} used for #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.28417.name: Centrifuge
ntnhcore.quest.28417.desc:
The #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Centrifuge#{reset} allows for the seperation of ores, giving back more items than the usual mining method. It also seperates items into their respective items. Additionally, they are used in processing #{ffff55}#{ffaa00}Bedrock Ores#{reset}.

Operating the centrifuge will consume #{ffff55}4kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.28673.name: Coker Unit
ntnhcore.quest.28673.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Coker Unit#{reset} is a machine that turns oil products into #{ffaa00}Petroleum Coke#{reset}, which is the same to the other kinds of coke, aswell as additional fluids as byproducts. The coker unit will require an external heat source in order to function, similar to the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

#{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}Alongside the #{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}#{reset}#{00aa00}Electric Arc Furnace, the coker unit is one of the most polluting machines of the mod. It spreads 20 soot per second, making it a dangerous machine to use next to a glyphid nest.
ntnhcore.quest.28929.name: Cyclotron
ntnhcore.quest.29185.name: Delinquent
ntnhcore.quest.29441.name: Delinquent 2: Delinquent Harder
ntnhcore.quest.29697.name: Derrick
ntnhcore.quest.29697.desc: The #{00aaaa}Oil Derrick#{reset} extracts #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} and #{ffaa00}#{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} from #{ffff55}Oil Deposits#{reset} that are directly below them. When supplied with power, it will begin to drill downwards until it cannot drill further or reach an oil deposit. Upon reaching a deposit, it will continuously extract oil and gas from it until the deposit is entirely depleted.
ntnhcore.quest.29953.name: Desh
ntnhcore.quest.29953.desc:
#{ffaa00}Desh#{reset} is an alloy made up of 9 rare earth metals to make its blend form, which is solidified and refined using #{55ffff}Mercury#{reset} and #{55ffff}Light oil#{reset} in the #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset}. Desh is an almost unbreakable material and as such its tools have infinite durability. 

#{55ff55}#{00aa00}Desh can also be made using DeshReady™ in a Rotary Furnace, or later on, in an Ore Acidizer.#{reset}

Mercury at this stage of the game can be obtained from centrifuging #{ffff55}Redstone Ore#{reset} or putting #{ffff55}Cinnabar#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}. Large cinnabar veins can be found as depth ore.

Later on, mercury can be obtained from processing #{55ffff}Ore Slop#{reset} or #{55ffff}Vitriol#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Electrolyzer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.30209.name: Desh Anvil
ntnhcore.quest.30209.desc:
An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T3], which unlocks additional recipes.

Alternatively, the #{00aaaa}Desh Anvil#{reset} can be skipped by making a #{00aaaa}Ferrouranium Anvil#{reset}, [T4], from scavanged #{ffff55}#{reset}#{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} found in structures.
ntnhcore.quest.30465.name: Desh Servo Set
ntnhcore.quest.30465.desc: #{ffaa00}Desh Servos#{reset} are an armor modification which give incredibely strong buffs when used, such as increased strength, mining speed and jump boost.
ntnhcore.quest.3073.name: Backpacks and Exploration
ntnhcore.quest.3073.desc:
Exploration is an important part of the #{ff55ff}NTM#{reset} experience as salvaging abandoned structures is a viable strategy for early game. Large caverns also exist in this modpack, so dont hesistate going caving.

#{ff55ff}Backpacks#{reset} will be a massive help, as they can be used to carry around more loot. Crates can also be used to transport items, but backpacks also come packed with dedicated tool slots, a crafting table, a bed aswell as fluid tanks.

A #{ff55ff}Nature's Compass#{reset} can be used to easily locate biomes of interest.

A #{ffaa00}Hose#{reset} can be used to quickly input and output fluids stored in the backpack.
ntnhcore.quest.30721.name: Electric Arc Furnace
ntnhcore.quest.30721.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Electric Arc Furnace#{reset} is a large automated furnace multiblock machine that can fill the role of #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} and automated smelter, and is required for progression as it is the only machine that can produce #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} from various sources, such as #{ffaa00}Sand#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Flint#{reset}, #{ffaa00}fiberglass#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Asbestos#{reset}.

To operate this machine, it will require both electrical power and crafted #{aaaaaa}#{ffaa00}Electrodes#{reset}. In terms of electricity, the machine has a maximum storage capacity of #{ffff55}2.5MHE#{reset}, and consumes #{ffff55}20kHE/s#{reset} in operation, making it reasonably power hungry. In terms of the electrodes required for operation, there are four types available, and the machine must have three installed before it can operate.

This machine can operate in two different modes: Solid mode, which is the easiest to setup and use, great for initial crafting, and Liquid mode, which produces castable molten ores much like the crucible, with a small bonus to output, increasing efficiency of extraction from various ores.
ntnhcore.quest.30977.name: Electric Groundwater Pump
ntnhcore.quest.30977.desc: The #{00aaaa}Electric Groundpump#{reset} can be used to quickly generate #{55ffff}Water#{reset}, making it very useful later on for filling large #{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset} and reactors. The pump requires a 3x3 cube of dirt directly beneath it and must be below Y:70, otherwise it won't work.
ntnhcore.quest.31233.name: Electrolysis Machine
ntnhcore.quest.31233.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Electrolysis Machine#{reset} enables the separating of elements from fluids and the advanced processing of ores, making it an important machine in ore processing. Operating the machine consumes #{ffff55}200kHE/s#{reset}.

The electrolysis machine has 2 functions: one for the separation of fluids and one for ore processing.

In the first mode, the machine will take in a compatible fluid and separate it into 2 other fluids.

In the second mode, it will require #{55ffff}Nitric Acid#{reset} and will process any kind of ore-derived crystal, allowing the maximum yield of the ore. There are 2 outputs, for the molten main product the outlet marked green and the secondary the one marked red, plus a byproduct kept in its item form. The outlets follow the same mechanics as the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Consider installing a Power Saving upgrade above level 2 on the electrolysis machine as it will significantly reduce the power consumption with only a minimal speed penalty.
ntnhcore.quest.31489.name: Fiberglass
ntnhcore.quest.31489.desc: Sand in an #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} can be turned into #{ffaa00}Fiberglass#{reset}, which provides more than #{ffff55}4x#{reset} the amount of #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset}. Additionally, it provides a great recipe for insulators.
ntnhcore.quest.31745.name: Geiger Counter
ntnhcore.quest.31745.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Geiger counter#{reset} is a device used to measure #{ffff55}RAD/s#{reset}, in order to inform the player of any eventual radiation. It is an upgrade to the #{ffaa00}Dosimeter#{reset}. It can measure three different types of radiation, those types being chunk radiation, environmental radiation and player contamination.

It can be used in one of two forms, either as a hand-held item or in its block form.

Holding it in the inventory will show a meter on the bottom left of the screen, and right clicking while holding it will send a message in chat showing the various doses of radiation.

It will also click whenever it reads any kind of radiation, a signature function of any dosimeter.
ntnhcore.quest.32001.name: Hydraulic Fracking Tower
ntnhcore.quest.32001.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Hydraulic Fracking Tower#{reset} is used to extract infinite oil from a #{ffff55}Bedrock Oil Deposit#{reset}. To operate, the machine needs #{55ffff}Fracking Solution#{reset}. During its operation, the surrounding environment will sustain considerable damage. #{ffaa00}Oily Dirt#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Oily Sand#{reset} can be used to create #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset}, a substitute of #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset}.

Operating the hydraulic fracking tower will consume #{ffff55}100kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.32257.name: Impact Drill
ntnhcore.quest.32257.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Impact Drill#{reset} is an electric pickaxe which has prebuilt enchantments and abilities on it. It is a very useful tool which will make mining way more efficient.

Similar electric tools exist for the axe and shovel.
ntnhcore.quest.32513.name: Industrial Boiler
ntnhcore.quest.32513.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Boiler#{reset} is an upgraded version of the Boiler which has a higher capacity of held liquid. Additionally, it doesnt explode.
ntnhcore.quest.32769.name: Industrial Liquification Machine
ntnhcore.quest.32769.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Liquification Machine#{reset} is a general use machine for the liquifying various items. It becomes very useful for cobblestone generation, and thus #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} automation.
ntnhcore.quest.33025.name: Industrial Solidification Machine
ntnhcore.quest.33025.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Solidification Machine#{reset} is a general use machine for the solidification of various fluids. An important product of this machine is #{ffaa00}Tar#{reset}, which can be used to create #{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.3329.name: Batteries
ntnhcore.quest.3329.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Battery Socket#{reset} is used to hold #{ffaa00}Batteries#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Capacitors#{reset}.

Batteries have more energy storage, but a slower discharge time, meaning that only a small amount of stored power can be outputted to the grid.

Capacitors on the other hand, have less energy storage, but a faster discharge time.
ntnhcore.quest.33281.name: Industrial Steam Turbine
ntnhcore.quest.33281.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Steam Turbine#{reset} is a multiblock machine that is a much larger and more powerful version of the regular #{00aaaa}Steam Turbine#{reset}. It has an efficiency of #{ffff55}100%#{reset} and energy output slowly ramps up as #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} is supplied and slowly goes down as steam cuts out.
ntnhcore.quest.33537.name: Integrated Circuit Board
ntnhcore.quest.33537.desc: The #{ffaa00}Integrated Circuit Board#{reset} is the first circuit board to use #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset}, being used extensively in mid game machines, automation devices, missiles, and various small tools such as the #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.33793.name: Jetpack
ntnhcore.quest.33793.desc: The #{ffaa00}Jetpack#{reset} can be used to travel upwards. It can be upgraded to unlock additional abilities, and can be equiped as an armor modification.
ntnhcore.quest.34049.name: Launch Pad
ntnhcore.quest.34049.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Launch Pad#{reset} is the main launch table for most missiles. Although it is the earliest available, missiles must first be erected before launch, resulting in a small delay.

The #{00aaaa}Silo Launch Pad#{reset} is a miniaturized version of the launch pad. It can launch every generic missile with a delay of only 5 seconds. A rusted variant can be found in the naturally-occurring silo structure, holding the damaged Doomsday Missile.
ntnhcore.quest.34305.name: M1TTY Environment Suit
ntnhcore.quest.34305.desc: The #{ffaa00}M1TTY Environment Suit#{reset} is a cheap electric armor set that comes with many abilities. It is an excellent armor set for exploring as it comes with very high speed buffs as well as fast swimming speed.
ntnhcore.quest.34561.name: Microchip
ntnhcore.quest.34561.desc: #{ffaa00}Microchips#{reset} are one of the most important components of future circuits and will be used in bulk throughout progression.
ntnhcore.quest.34817.name: Military Grade Circuit Board
ntnhcore.quest.34817.desc: The #{ffaa00}Military Grade Circuit Board#{reset} is an advanced Circuit Board used in more complicated machines, such as the #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuge#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.35073.name: Mining Laser
ntnhcore.quest.35073.desc: The #{00aaaa}Mining Laser#{reset} is a laser drill which can be used to quickly dig large areas. It has a #{ffff55}100 MHE#{reset} internal power buffer and a 64,000mB internal #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} buffer. Its default radius is 3, which can be increased by the use of an effectiveness upgrade. It can also be equiped with various upgrades to unlock new functions such as shredding or voiding.
ntnhcore.quest.35329.name: Ore Acidizer
ntnhcore.quest.35329.desc: The #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} is a useful machine, used for processing various items for utility, ore multiplication, and more. It is powered by electricity and requires various solvents depending on the item. The acidizer is quite the power hungry machine, consuming #{ffff55}20kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.35585.name: Pinwheels
ntnhcore.quest.35585.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Chlorine Pinwheel#{reset} is a yellow propeller capable of producing chlorine indefinitely.
Acquisition

It cannot be crafted, but can be found in structures (e.g., in a starship).

The chlorine spinner is an endless source of #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset}; to use it, simply place it in a container slot (e.g., in a barrel). The item will produce chlorine indefinitely, although the production rate is low (1 mb/t or 20 mb/s).

The #{ffaa00}Oxygen Pinwheel#{reset} is analogous to the Chlorine Pinwheel, producing #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset} instead of #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.3585.name: Better Furnaces
ntnhcore.quest.3585.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Bricked Furnace#{reset} is almost the same as the vanilla furnace, but it can smelt construction materials faster, such as #{ffaa00}Sand#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Cobblestone#{reset} being smelted at double the speed. #{ffaa00}Clay#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Fire Clay#{reset} can be smelted at #{ffff55}#{reset}quadruple#{reset} the speed, which means that making a full brick block can be done within a vanilla furnace operation. It can also make #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset} at double the speed. It can also collect Ashes from burnt fuel.

The #{00aaaa}Iron Furnace#{reset} has the base smelting speed #{ffff55}20%#{reset} faster than the vanilla furnace, which means it can complete an operation within 8 seconds instead of 10 seconds. Besides being able to smelt faster, it consumes fuel only during operation, so the fuel is never wasted. It also has burn time bonuses for various kinds of fuel, ranging from #{ffff55}+25%#{reset} for lignite to #{ffff55}+100%#{reset} for solid fuel.

#{ff55ff}Et Futurum Requiem#{reset} also backports modern furnaces, such as the #{00aaaa}Smoker#{reset}, which cooks food faster, and the #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}, which smelts ores faster.
ntnhcore.quest.35841.name: Polymer
ntnhcore.quest.35841.desc: #{ffaa00}Polymer#{reset} is a basic plastic material needed for many recipes. Important uses of it are the #{00aaaa}Centrifuge#{reset}, the #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Electric Arc Furnace#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.36097.name: Powered Drill
ntnhcore.quest.36097.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Powered Drill#{reset} is a modular mining device which can make resourse gathering and excavation much faster than normal pickaxes. 

Various modifications can be attached in the #{00aaaa}Weapon Modification Table#{reset}, such as new drillbits for a larger mining radious or even new engines, which let it run on electricity.
ntnhcore.quest.36353.name: Precision Assembly Machine
ntnhcore.quest.36353.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Precision Assembly Machine#{reset} is a machine which can produce #{ffaa00}Blueprints#{reset}. Due to the recipes having a low success rate, automation of the ingredient is recommended.

Pufferfish can be obtained from throwing #{ffaa00}Fishing Dynamite#{reset} in water.
ntnhcore.quest.36609.name: Pumpjack
ntnhcore.quest.36609.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Pumpjack#{reset} is a more efficient #{00aaaa}Oil Derrick#{reset} which extracts 750mb of #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} and a random amount of #{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} between 50 and 250mb in a 1.25 second cycle. It depletes a single block of a deposit after extracting a random number of cycles of oil that is on average twice as large compared to the derrick.

In total, this means that the pumpjack is on average 3x as efficient at extracting oil and 3x as fast at doing so while producing the same amount of natural gas as the derrick.
ntnhcore.quest.36865.name: Redstone Fluid Overflow
ntnhcore.quest.36865.desc:
#{ffaa00}#{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}Redstone-Over Radio#{reset} in combination with a #{00aaaa}Redstone Fluid Valve#{reset} can be used to detect when a tank is starting to fill up, and release the insides. This is useful for having buffers without having all the fluids being wasted.

#{00aa00}Here is an exmaple of a tank that will only output fluid once its full:#{reset}

Firstly, place a #{ffaa00}ROR Transmitter#{reset} on one port of the tank, provide an ID and enable Polling.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Fluid1.png[/img]

After that, place a #{ffaa00}ROR Logic Receiver#{reset} next to the fluid valve and input the desired settings. Make sure that your signal is >= of your desired buffer. One redstone level equals to 16k mb.

[img height=1000]betterquesting:textures/QB_Fluid2.png[/img]

A #{00aaaa}Fluid Control Pump#{reset} can also be used to limit throughput of fluids and to also add priorities.
ntnhcore.quest.37121.name: Refinery Power
ntnhcore.quest.37121.desc:
Oil products can be combusted or burnt to produce massive amounts of energy.

The #{00aaaa}Industrial Combustion Engine#{reset} combusts fuels, such as #{55ffff}Heating Oil#{reset} or #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset} to produce power. Various piston sets exist, which are needed for the engine to work, each one giving its own efficiency bonuses to fuel grades.

The #{aa0000}#{00aaaa}Turbofan#{reset} is the best place to use aviation type fuels, such as #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset}, as it provides #{ffff55}100%#{reset} power efficiency. Be careful not to stand infront of it while its operational!

The #{00aaaa}Combined Cycle Gas Turbine#{reset} is the only generator that can burn gaseous fuels at #{ffff55}100%#{reset} efficiency. The CCGT uses #{00aaaa}#{55ffff}Engine Lubricant#{reset}, and produces #{55ffff}Dense Steam#{reset}.

The #{00aaaa}Flare Stack#{reset} is used for burning gasses such as #{55ffff}Unsaturated Hydrocarbons#{reset} for power, as well as dealing with excess fluids.

The #{00aaaa}Fluid Burner#{reset} is a much more efficient way of producing power from gases. Place a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset} ontop and run the #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} through a turbine to generate power.

Consider installing a #{ffaa00}Muffler#{reset} on some of these machines as they are very loud. Shift-Click on a machine while holding a Muffler to apply.
ntnhcore.quest.37377.name: Rubber
ntnhcore.quest.37377.desc:
#{ffaa00}Rubber#{reset} is an essential material used in many crafting recipes. It is created in a #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset} with #{55ffff}Unsaturated Hydrocarbons#{reset} obtained from a #{00aaaa}Catalytic Cracking Tower#{reset}.

#{ffaa00}Latex#{reset} is a rubber alternative which can be used in some recipes instead of normal rubber. It can be created early on using a #{00aaaa}Burner Press#{reset} by processing dandelions or jungle wood.

#{00aa00}In NTM: Space cracked oil is required to obtain the first piece of rubber.
ntnhcore.quest.37633.name: Semtex
ntnhcore.quest.37633.desc:
#{ffaa00}Semtex#{reset} is an explosive that is used in conjunction with C-4 in many crafts.

Semtex is used in many crafts of various ammunition and mines, such as the #{ffaa00}Stinger missile#{reset}, #{ffaa00}anti-personnel mines#{reset}, and so on. In all crafts that use Semtex (except, of course, the Semtex block and Semtex bar, as well as the explosive reactive armor plate), it can be replaced with a C-4 bar.

It is used to create the bomb of the same name.

#{00aa00}Semtex can be eaten, making you feel like a real American soldier.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.37889.name: Solid Fuel
