ntnhcore.quest.37889.desc: #{ffaa00}Solid Fuel#{reset} is a compact solidified petroleum product with superior burn time and heat output compared to coal. Essential for advanced furnace operations and rocket propulsion systems.
ntnhcore.quest.38145.name: Survey Scanner
ntnhcore.quest.38145.desc: The #{ffaa00}Survey Scanner#{reset} is a handheld device that will point out underground resourse deposits, such as #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset} and #{ffff55}Bedrock Ores#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.3841.name: Blast Furnace
ntnhcore.quest.3841.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset} is a solid fuel-powered furnace used to create different alloys out of two inputs. The main starter alloys are: #{ffaa00}Minecraft Grade Copper#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Steel#{reset}. Inserting #{55ffff}Hot Air Blast#{reset}, made by putting #{55ffff}Compressed Air#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}, grants all recipes a #{ffff55}3x#{reset} boost.
#{55ffff}Flue Gas#{reset} produced from operating the machine can be burnt for energy or vented into the atmosphere.

Steel tools come equiped with vein mining, making them an excellent early-game tool.

#{00aa00}For more advanced tools later on, pressing the ALT key will bring up a menu from which one can select multiple abilities at once.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.38401.name: Tank
ntnhcore.quest.38401.desc:
#{00aaaa}Tanks#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Barrels#{reset} are useful storage devices that can hold various fluids in various amounts. Each tank and barrel supports holding different types of corrosive, hot, or exotic fluids, and knowing which ones can hold your desired fluids can be vital to your fluid processing and storage facilities.

Tanks can hold up to 256,000mb of fluids, while a Steel Barrel can hold 16,000.

#{aa0000}#{00aa00}Tanks cant hold highly Antimatter and Corrosive fluids and as such a Big-Ass Tank 9000 or a Magnetic Tank is needed respectively.
ntnhcore.quest.38657.name: Teleporter
ntnhcore.quest.38657.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Teleporter#{reset} can be used to teleport players, and entities in general, to a specific location.

Right-click a block with the #{ffaa00}Telelinker#{reset} to set the desired exit position, then shift-click the teleporter with the telelinker to configure the teleporter.

#{00aa00}The teleporter is a one way trip so it is advised that multiple are made.

Interdimensional teleportation using teleporters requires a very expensive type of fuel, so it is recommended that other teleportations methods are used, such as AE2 Spatial.
ntnhcore.quest.38913.name: Transport Drones
ntnhcore.quest.38913.desc: #{00aaaa}Transport Drones#{reset} are flying machines which will transport items and fluids between different containers. The drones require no power, and can transport both up and down. #{00aaaa}Waypoints#{reset} can be used to make a better path for the transport drones to move around.
ntnhcore.quest.39169.name: Weapon Steel
ntnhcore.quest.39169.desc: #{ffaa00}Weapon steel#{reset} is a steel alloy made by further refining steel in a #{00aaaa}Rotary Furnace#{reset}. As its name implies, it is used in the crafting of weapons and ammunition. It is the next tier of weapons grade alloy after #{ffaa00}Gunmetal#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.39425.name: Tantalium
ntnhcore.quest.39425.desc:
#{ffaa00}Tantalium#{reset} is a material needed for the creation of some items, most importantly #{ffaa00}Capacitor Boards#{reset}. Tantalium Polycrystal production requires #{ffaa00}Coltan#{reset} which can be located by the use of a #{ffaa00}Coltass#{reset}. Coltan can also be obtained by using the mining drill in a #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore Coltan Deposit#{reset} located randomly on planet Dres. Tantalum can also be obtained via #{00aaaa}Watz Reactor#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Coltan Processing at its early stage can provide Niobium needed for Catalytic Cracking Towers.
ntnhcore.quest.39681.name: Additional Fusion Attachments
ntnhcore.quest.39681.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Coupler#{reset} turns outgoing plasma energy from a torus into usable #{ffff55}KyE#{reset} which can then be used to power another torus. Some fuel combinations require this, as the minimum #{ffff55}KyE#{reset} energy needed to ignite the plasma exceeds what four #{00aaaa}Klystrons#{reset} could deliver.

The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber#{reset} uses neutron flux from a torus to in order to process materials. It can perform any recipe from an #{00aaaa}RBMK irradiation channel#{reset}, with some additional recipes aswell. The neutron flux is not affected by port sharing rules, and the output level is the same on any side.

The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Collection Chamber#{reset} increases the byproduct production rate by #{ffff55}50%#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.39937.name: Advanced Oil Processing
ntnhcore.quest.39937.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Catalytic Reformer#{reset} is an optional late-game oil processing machine. It converts certain oil products into more valuable ones.

The #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset} is another optional late-game oil processing machine that allows for easier production of #{55ffff}Sour Gas#{reset}, which can also turn #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} into #{55ffff}Desulfurized crude Oil#{reset}. 

#{00aa00}The Hydrotreater requires pressurized Liquid Hydrogen in all its recipes, requiring the use of a Compressor.
ntnhcore.quest.40193.name: Arsenic
ntnhcore.quest.40193.desc: #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} is a substitute of #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset} which can be made from acidizing #{ffaa00}Oily Dirt#{reset}, found near #{ffff55}bedrock oil deposits#{reset} or from the environmental damage the #{00aaaa}Fracking Tower#{reset} does, with #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.40449.name: Big-Ass Tank
ntnhcore.quest.40449.desc: The #{00aaaa}Big-Ass Tank#{reset} is the largest fluid storage container, capable of storing 2048000mB of fluids, aswell as being able to hold strongly corrosive fluids. It has to be placed on the solid surface, otherwise it is going to break.
ntnhcore.quest.40705.name: Bismuth
ntnhcore.quest.40705.desc:
#{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset} is an important material needed in many advanced crafting recipes. Bismuth can be obtained from either #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} fuel depletion and processing though a #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} and #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset}, or from bedrock ore processing using #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}. 

#{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} will require an additional #{55ffff}Ore Acidizer#{reset} aswell as access to high-performance solvent.

#{00aa00}Due to the lack of bismuth bedrock ore available on earth and the amount of time it takes to process RBMK fuels, it is recommended that some arsenic is used instead of bismuth.
ntnhcore.quest.4097.name: Blood Moon: legacy reference
ntnhcore.quest.40961.name: BTX
ntnhcore.quest.40961.desc: #{55ffff}BTX#{reset} is a high-grade powerful fuel which generates a lot of power when burnt. An important use of BTX is in the creation of #{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Hard Plastic Bars#{reset}. BTX can be obtained from a #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset}, but it is more efficient to use #{55ffff}Reformate#{reset} from a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.41217.name: Cadmium
ntnhcore.quest.41217.desc:
#{ffaa00}Cadmium#{reset} is a material needed to make #{ffaa00}Cadmium Stee#{reset}l, which is a substitute of #{ffaa00}Technetium Steel#{reset}.

Cadmium can be obtained by smelting cadmium powder, which can be obtained acidizing 10 #{ffaa00}Mustard Willow leaves#{reset} with 250mB of #{55ffff}High-Perfomance Solvent#{reset} in the #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset}.

The mustard willow is a plant that can be found near #{ffff55}Bedrock Oil Deposits#{reset}. When it's fully matured, the main item can be obtained, that being the mustard willow leaf.
ntnhcore.quest.41473.name: Chicago Pile
ntnhcore.quest.41473.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset} is a modular breeding reactor with no GUI, built to transmute #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium#{reset} into plutonium isotopes through neutron bombardment. It must be operated manually or via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset}.

Build a rectangular prism of #{ffaa00}Chicago Pile Graphite Bricks#{reset}, at minimum 5*5*5 and at most 15*15*15. Once assembled, drill a non-edge block on one of its lateral faces with the #{ffaa00}Hand Drill#{reset} to establish the core and fix the reactor's channel orientation. Channels are straight lines drilled through the pile and may not intersect. Fuel channels share the core's face orientation and accept rods via a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Fuel Loader#{reset} on the input port; spent rods are ejected from the opposite side. Ventilation channels run perpendicular to the core and require a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Vent#{reset} supplied with #{55ffff}compressed air#{reset} at #{ffff55}1 PU#{reset} - each vent cools only the fuel channels within one block above or below it. Vertical control rod channels are optional and reduce reactivity between channels. 

Every reaction requires a neutron source. The #{ffaa00}Ra226Be Neutron Source#{reset} is the starter option; the more powerful #{ffaa00}Po210Be Neutron Source#{reset} can replace it later. #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Rods#{reset} breed into #{ffaa00}Plutonium-239 Rods#{reset}, which can be bred further into #{ffaa00}Reactor-Grade Plutonium Rods#{reset}. Leaving fuel beyond that point produces #{ffaa00}Nuclear Waste Rods#{reset}, which generate extreme heat and risk meltdown. To safely push out spent rods without fresh fuel, use #{ffaa00}Zirconium Rods#{reset} - they are inert and transparent to neutrons.

#{00aa00}Verify cooling is working before loading any fuel. The pile melts down at 800°C, causing an explosion and widespread fire.

The quest asks for a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile#{reset} of at least 5*5*5 with a core established, a #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Fuel Loader#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Chicago Pile Vent#{reset} attached, and a #{ffaa00}Ra226Be Neutron Source#{reset} loaded alongside at least one #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Rod#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.41729.name: Chlorophyte
ntnhcore.quest.41729.desc: #{ffaa00}Chlorophyte#{reset} is a product of fusion and is used in the #{00aaaa}DFC#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Digamma Particle#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.41985.name: CMB Steel
ntnhcore.quest.41985.desc: #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Poisonous Mud#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tunsten#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}. This alloy is used in endgame machinery, such as the #{00aaaa}ICF#{reset} and #{00aaaa}DFC#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.42241.name: Cooling Tower
ntnhcore.quest.42241.desc: The #{00aaaa}Cooling Tower#{reset} is a larger version of the #{00aaaa}Auxiliary Cooling Tower#{reset}#{reset}, able to process up to 500 mB/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.42497.name: Crystalline Fullerite
ntnhcore.quest.42497.desc:
#{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset} is an material which is primarely used in endgame machines, such as the #{00aaaa}ICF#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}FEnSU#{reset}.

#{00aa00}It is recommended that an Effectiveness 3 upgrade is installed on the Acidizer to increase the chance of not consuming the Fullerene, as fullerite can be expensive to produce large quantities.
ntnhcore.quest.42753.name: Depth-Resource Scanning Satellite
ntnhcore.quest.42753.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Depth-Resource Scanning Satellite#{reset} maps underground ore deposits across loaded chunks. It is operated via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} through a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset}.

The map lacks labels and detail on its own. Pairing the satellite with #{ffaa00}Neutrino Lenses#{reset} - an armor module linked to the same frequency via the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset} - overlays ores as glowing labeled outlines, making the data far more usable.
ntnhcore.quest.43009.name: Desh Stamps
ntnhcore.quest.43009.desc: #{ffaa00}Desh Stamps#{reset} have infinite durability, perfect for automation.
ntnhcore.quest.43265.name: Deuterium Extraction Tower
ntnhcore.quest.43265.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Deuterium Extraction Tower#{reset} is a much larger version of the Deuterium Extractor, making it an easy and viable way of making cheap fuel for the #{55ffff}#{reset}#{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset}.

#{00aa00}A Ferrouranium Anvil is required.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.4353.name: Bobmazon
ntnhcore.quest.4353.desc: #{ffaa00}Bobmazon#{reset} is an in-game shop where players can spend #{ffaa00}Bottle Caps#{reset} to purchase various items such as building blocks, plants, resourses and many more. To purchase items, one must have unlocked the achievements listed below as "Ratings".
ntnhcore.quest.43521.name: FEL and SILEX
ntnhcore.quest.43521.desc:
The #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} or Free Electron Laser is a large multiblock utilized with the SILEX to produce various laser wavelengths needed for all SILEX recipes.

A single FEL can power up to 5 SILEX'es. In order to stop the laser any concrete block can be in the its path.

The lower the wavelength of the crystal, the faster recipes will be completed.

The #{ffaa00}#{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset} is a machine that separates isotopes and elements from compounds or other materials via the SILEX (Separation of Isotopes by Laser Exitation) process. It allows for easier enrichment of #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Plutonium#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Australium#{reset}.

The SILEX can also process #{ffaa00}Lapis Lazuli#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Aluminium#{reset}, and most importantly #{ffaa00}Cobalt#{reset}. It can use #{55ffff}Hydrogen Peroxide#{reset} to liquify any material to be processed, the material may even be in a powder state. The processed items come out into the right side collection of slots.

The SILEX must be placed at least 2 blocks away from activated FEL laser, or else its going to melt.
ntnhcore.quest.43777.name: Ferric Schrabidate
ntnhcore.quest.43777.desc: #{ffaa00}Ferric Schrabidate#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Ionized Particles#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset}. It can also be used to create schrabidate capacitors, which are a great way of storing energy.
ntnhcore.quest.44033.name: Ferrouranium
ntnhcore.quest.44289.name: Ferrouranium Anvil
ntnhcore.quest.44289.desc: An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T4], which unlocks additional recipes.
ntnhcore.quest.44545.name: Fissile Materials
ntnhcore.quest.44545.desc: With fissile materials obtained from either #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuges#{reset} or nuclear fuel processing, nuclear bombs are made available.
ntnhcore.quest.44801.name: Fusion Power
ntnhcore.quest.44801.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor Boiler#{reset} is simplest method of extracting power from a fusion reactor, outputting #{55ffff}Super Dense Steam#{reset} to be run through normal turbines.

Due to using plasma energy, both the MHDT and the boiler are affected by port sharing rules, meaning that having multiple connected MHTDs, or boilers, decreases the amount of energy each turbine gets, but overall increases the total amount of extracted from the torus.
ntnhcore.quest.45057.name: Fusion Reactor
ntnhcore.quest.45057.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} is a large, expensive, and advanced reactor type that runs by fusing various plasma types to generate heat.

The main part of the fusion reactor, the #{00aaaa}"Torus"#{reset}, features four connecting ports for external components. It requires electricity and #{55ffff}Perfluoromethyl#{reset} cooling to operate.

The #{00aaaa}Klystron#{reset} is the main power source of the fusion reactor, which uses electricity and compressed air, to generate input energy, #{ffff55}KyU#{reset}, for the connected torus. It will throttle if the buffered electricity or compressed air falls below #{ffff55}50%#{reset}, and if it falls below the torus' required input level, the plasma will extinguish.

The different plasma types also generate different useful byproducts and differing levels of neutron flux for breeding bulk quantities of materials, such as #{ffaa00}Lithium#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Tritium#{reset}.

Welding the coils will require a #{ffaa00}Blowtorch#{reset} or an #{ffaa00}Acetylene Welding Torch#{reset}.

#{00aa00}For the additional components and power generation methods, please check out the two quests below.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.45313.name: Gas Centrifuge
ntnhcore.quest.45313.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Gas Centrifuge#{reset} is used to centrifuge #{55ffff}Uranium/Plutonium Hexafluoride#{reset} to obtain enriched fuel for bombs and reactor fuel.

Two gas centrifuges in a row will yield #{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Uranium Fuel#{reset} used in reactors. The uranium hexafluoride processing line does not consume the #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Fluorite#{reset}, so loops are recommended.

The #{ffaa00}Gas Centrifuge Overclocking Upgrade#{reset} is needed to obtain #{ffaa00}Uranium-235#{reset}. Four gas centrifuges will have to be placed in a row and the upgrade on the last of them to obtain uranium-235 nuggets.

[F1] For more information.
ntnhcore.quest.45569.name: Gravity Gun
ntnhcore.quest.45569.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Gravity Gun#{reset} is an advanced tool which can lift and throw blocks. It is particularly useful for moving highly hazardous blocks, such as corium from a reactor meltdown, or throwing explosives.

#{00aa00}The gravity gun can be supercharged in a Cyclotron using Ionized Particles, further increasing its range and power.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.quest.45825.name: Hard Plastic/PVC Bars
ntnhcore.quest.45825.desc:
#{ffaa00}Hard Plastic/PVC Bars#{reset} are very durable plastics needed for many late game recipes. 

#{00aa00}Both can be used in the same recipes.
ntnhcore.quest.4609.name: Boiler and Steam Condenser
ntnhcore.quest.4609.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset}, when receiving heat from below, heats up fluids. Two important uses of the boiler are for #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} and #{55ffff}Oil#{reset} processing which will come later on. The Boiler can explode if its output is full.

Steam, when used by machines, such as reactors sending steam through #{00aaaa}Turbines#{reset} or #{00aaaa}Chemical Factories#{reset} produce #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}. The low-pressure steam can be recycled back to retrieve 100% of the water by using a #{00aaaa}Steam Condenser#{reset}. Closed water loops are recommended for reactors.
ntnhcore.quest.46081.name: Heat Exchanging Heater
ntnhcore.quest.46081.desc: The #{aa0000}#{00aaaa}Heat Exchanging Heater#{reset} is used to cool down coolants used in reactors while also genearting #{ffff55}TU#{reset}. A #{00aaaa}Boiler#{reset} can be placed ontop of it to heat up other fluids, such as #{55ffff}Steam#{reset}, to be used in #{00aaaa}Steam Turbines#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.46337.name: Heavy Magnetic Storage Tank
ntnhcore.quest.46337.desc: The #{00aaaa}Heavy Magnetic Storage Tank#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Magnetic Antimatter Container#{reset}. It will be particularly useful when making #{ffaa00}Gerald#{reset}, as he will need very large quantities of #{55ffff}Stellar Flux#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.46593.name: Helium-4
ntnhcore.quest.46593.desc: #{55ffff}Helium-4#{reset} is a product of fusion and is mainly used in crafting #{ffaa00}Quantum Processing Units#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.46849.name: HEV Mark IV
ntnhcore.quest.46849.desc: The #{ffaa00}HEV Mark IV#{reset} is a strong electric armor set, with the intent of keeping the user safe primarely from dangerous hazards, such as high levels of radiation, fire, certain air particles and more. The suit comes equiped with an #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset} and custom hud.
ntnhcore.quest.47105.name: High-Performance Solvent
ntnhcore.quest.47105.desc:
#{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} is a solvent which is used in an #{00aaaa}Ore Acidizer#{reset} to further increase the products of bedrock ores, as well as other recipes. It can be created from #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset}, from a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset}, and #{55ffff}Chlorine#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset} or be obtained from an #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} Irradiation Channel.

To transport High-Performance Solvent by hand, a #{ffaa00}Hazardous Material Tank#{reset} is needed.

#{00aa00}High-Performance Solvent made from an RBMK irradiation channel requires an ore acidizer.
ntnhcore.quest.47361.name: High-Performance Solvent Bedrock Ore Processing
ntnhcore.quest.47361.desc:
#{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} is the best tier of solvent which can be used in bedrock ore processing, yielding many rare materials such as#{ffaa00} Bismuth#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Technetium-99#{reset}.

#{00aa00}These materials are not available from earth bedrock ores.
ntnhcore.quest.47617.name: High-Power Steam Condenser
ntnhcore.quest.47617.desc: The #{00aaaa}High-Power Steam Condenser#{reset} is the a steam condenser which runs on electricity. It processes up to 60 mB/t of #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.47873.name: Houston, We Have a Signal
ntnhcore.quest.47873.desc:
Satellites require dedicated infrastructure to launch, identify, and communicate with.

Before anything leaves the ground, every satellite must be assigned a unique frequency using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}. Place the satellite in its right slot to generate a random frequency, then use the left and center slots to copy that frequency onto #{ffaa00}Satellite ID Chips#{reset} or other linked devices such as designators. ID Chips are soldered, so prepare them in advance. The assigned frequency appears in the item's tooltip.

Satellites can be launching using a custom rocket or Soyuz-FG.

Once a satellite is in orbit, a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset} handles communication. It does not process #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} signals directly - it requires an external RoR receiver or transmitter. It connects to one satellite at a time, switched via the appropriate #{ffaa00}Satellite ID Chip#{reset} or an RoR command. RX reads data transmitted down from the satellite; TX sends commands up to it.

#{00aa00}The Ground Station's capabilities expand significantly when paired with an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset}#{00aa00}, enabling automated satellite tracking, data processing, and chained multi-satellite logic.
ntnhcore.quest.48129.name: Ionized Particles
ntnhcore.quest.48129.desc:
#{ffaa00}Ionized Particles#{reset} are the main product of the #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} and are used in making #{ffaa00}Ferric Scrabidate#{reset}, as well as some particle capsules needed in the #{00aaaa}Particle Accelerator#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Ionized Particles can be infinitely produced by utilizing Ionic Gel.
ntnhcore.quest.48385.name: Large Factory Multiblocks
ntnhcore.quest.48385.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Chemical Factory#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset}, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It has double the speed of the chemical plant but consumes twice as much power. Additionally, it consumes #{55ffff}Water#{reset} as a coolant, and produces #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset}, so a closed water cycle is recommended.

The #{00aaaa}Assembly Factory#{reset} is a large version of the #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset}, capable of performing 4 recipes in parallel. It functions the same as the chemical factory.
ntnhcore.quest.4865.name: Burner Press
ntnhcore.quest.4865.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Presses#{reset} are machines that can be used to make #{ffaa00}Plates#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Wires#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Circuits#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Bullet Casings#{reset} as well as #{ffaa00}Compressing#{reset} non-smeltable powders back into their normal form. They require #{ffaa00}Stamps#{reset} to work, which can be made from the basic #{ffaa00}Flat Stamp#{reset} on the #{ffaa00}Iron Anvil#{reset}.

#{00aa00}A preheater can be placed next to the Burner Press to increase its speed.
ntnhcore.quest.48641.name: Leviathan Steam Turbine
ntnhcore.quest.48641.desc: The #{00aaaa}Leviathan Steam Turbine#{reset} is a massive turbine capable of processing gargantuan amounts of #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} at once, only hindered by the fluid system's transfer rate. It is significantly more powerful than even the #{00aaaa}Industrial Steam Turbine#{reset} in terms of raw steam processing power. This turbine runs on #{ffff55}85%#{reset} Efficiency, so it is recommended that only 1-2 are used for very large reactors.
ntnhcore.quest.48897.name: Liquidator Medal
ntnhcore.quest.48897.desc: Incase of an #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} meltdown, #{ffaa00}Fuel Chunks#{reset} will be thrown near the reactor. The #{ffaa00}Liquidator Medal#{reset} is an armor modification which passively reduces radiation, making it very useful when handling radioactive items or venturing into irradiated areas.
ntnhcore.quest.49153.name: Magnetized Tungsten
ntnhcore.quest.49153.desc: #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tungsten#{reset} is the product of combining #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Tungsten#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}. It can also be rarely dropped by cybercrabs in #{ffff55}Meteorite Dungeons#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.49409.name: Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite
ntnhcore.quest.49409.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite#{reset} precisely locates specific high-energy events within a 250-meter radius of a target point. It is the high-precision counterpart to the #{00aaaa}Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite#{reset}, sensitive to: neutron radiation from nuclear reactors, high-energy particles from fusion reactors and particle accelerators, radar waves from ground radars, and radio waves from #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Stations#{reset} with an active TX signal.

All results are stored internally and accessed via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset}. "esurvey" performs the scan. "ecount" writes the result count to RX. "egetinfo" followed by an index writes the emission type to RX. "egetposition" followed by an index writes the X/Z coordinates - separated by a semicolon - to RX.

#{00aa00}Events are time-limited. Run repeated scans at short intervals to avoid missing short-lived emissions.
ntnhcore.quest.49665.name: Neutrino Lens
ntnhcore.quest.49665.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Neutrino Lens#{reset} is an armor modification which can detect and highlight special blocks, such as #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore deposits#{reset}, the #{ffaa00}Pink Log#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Alexandrite#{reset}. 

For the lens to work, it must first be linked to a #{ffaa00}Depth-Resource Scanning Module Satellite#{reset} and then inserted into an armor piece using the #{00aaaa}Armor Modification Table#{reset}.

#{00aa00}The HUD key has to be activated for it to work.
ntnhcore.quest.49921.name: Nuclear Bombs
ntnhcore.quest.49921.desc:
With access to #{ffaa00}Tantalium#{reset} for #{ffaa00}Control Units#{reset} and fissile matterials, it is possible to assemble a nuclear bomb. To detonate the bomb one can use a detonator or a redstone signal.

A nuclear explosion will transform ores into more valuable ones, such as #{ffaa00}Coal#{reset} to #{ffaa00}Diamonds#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset} to #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset}. Be prepared with radiation resistant armor before venturing into the crater.

Make sure to stand behind some strong cover if you wish to see the explosion from close by.

#{00aa00}This quest serves as a list of components needed for various bombs. Some of these components can be mounted onto rockets that will carry the payload over large distances.
ntnhcore.quest.50177.name: Nuclear Fuel Processing
ntnhcore.quest.50177.desc: With the #{00aaaa}Spent Fuel Pool Drum#{reset} to cool down #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} or #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} depleted nuclear fuel and the #{00aaaa}PUREX#{reset} to further process them, many new materials are now available.
ntnhcore.quest.50433.name: Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum
ntnhcore.quest.50433.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum#{reset} is used to decay #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} nuclear waste. The decayed nuclear waste can then be used with a #{00aaaa}FEL#{reset} and #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset} to obtain some rare elements, such as #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset}.

#{00aa00}The drum also emmits radiation when theres fuel inside it.
ntnhcore.quest.50689.name: Orbital Death Ray
ntnhcore.quest.50689.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Orbital Death Ray#{reset} is a high-destruction orbital weapon. Before launch, link it to a #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}. With a standard designator, enter target coordinates manually; with a laser designator, aim and hold right-click on the target block.

Unlike the #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset}, it has no entity-tracking capability and cannot intercept rockets or hit fast-moving targets. The beam strikes the first surface in its path, so targets in deep cover are safe. Recharge time is #{ffff55}5 minutes#{reset}. RoR commands: "fire" fires at the current target position if the weapon is ready; "canfire" writes TRUE or FALSE to RX depending on whether it has finished recharging.
ntnhcore.quest.50945.name: Orbital Precision Laser
ntnhcore.quest.50945.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset} is a solar-powered orbital weapon, a lighter alternative to the #{00aaaa}Orbital Death Ray#{reset}. It fires an instantaneous beam dealing massive damage to entities within a 5-block radius, though its explosive yield is only roughly equivalent to a single block of TNT. Recharge time between shots is #{ffff55}5 seconds#{reset}.

It can be aimed with a #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} or controlled via #{ff55ff}Redstone-over-Radio#{reset} through a #{00aaaa}Satellite Ground Station#{reset}. The "fire" command fires at the current target coordinates, or at a tracked entity if one has been set - entity target data is consumed after a single shot. The "canfire" command writes TRUE or FALSE to RX depending on whether the laser has finished recharging. The "setentitytarget" command accepts an entity ID from a #{00aaaa}Radar Satellite#{reset} for precision tracking.

#{00aa00}Entity target data is consumed after one shot, reverting back to coordinate targeting.
ntnhcore.quest.513.name: Additional Fluid Tools
ntnhcore.quest.513.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Siphon#{reset} is a tool used to extract input fluids from a machine. Right-clicking a machine with content in it's input tanks will fill any fluid barrels, universal tanks or pipettes (if the fluid amount cannot fill any of the previous options).

#{ffaa00}Pipettes#{reset} can be used to input specific amounts of fluids. Right-clicking or Shift-Right-clicking will increase or decrease the fluid amount.
ntnhcore.quest.5121.name: Cable Network Analysis Tool
ntnhcore.quest.5121.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Cable Network Analysis Tool#{reset} is used to check the integrity of power grids and analyze their main functional components. To perform a test, right-click the analyzer on wires or mechanisms in the power grid. The device displays the following data:

#{ffff55}Links#{reset} - these include wires and mechanisms that can conduct energy (e.g., energy storage units, utility poles).

#{ff5555}Providers#{reset} - all mechanisms capable of producing energy and/or feeding it into the grid (energy storage units in "#{55ff55}green#{reset}" and "#{ffaa00}orange#{reset}" modes, turbines, etc.).

#{5555ff}Receivers#{reset} - everything that absorbs energy from the grid (energy storage units in "#{5555ff}blue#{reset}" mode, grinders, and other mechanisms).

#{00aa00}The analyzer not only displays the above components but also counts them. Each grid is assigned a unique code.

Particles only spawn in a 20 block radius!
ntnhcore.quest.51201.name: Plasma Forge
ntnhcore.quest.51201.desc: The #{00aaaa}Plasma Forge#{reset} is a large and advanced assembler that requires a running fusion reactor to work. It can weld plates at twice the speed of a normal welder. It does not accept upgrades, however, it can use up otherwise useless fission fragments and unstable isotopes to gain a temporary #{ffff55}x4#{reset} speed bonus with no penalty.
ntnhcore.quest.51457.name: PUREX
ntnhcore.quest.51457.desc:
The #{00aaaa}PUREX#{reset} is a machine that can reprocess depleted nuclear fuel into various materials. Most recipes require both #{55ffff}Nitric Acid#{reset} and #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} to function.

#{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} can also be extracted from certain recipes, which require #{55ffff}Schrabidic Acid#{reset}. The schrabidium extracted yields double the schrabidium used to make the acid.
ntnhcore.quest.51713.name: PWR
ntnhcore.quest.51713.desc:
The #{00aa00}#{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} is a modular fission reactor. It is more limited than the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} in terms of capability and fuel types but it is much safer and easier to use due to it melting down more gently and being far more stable in its operation.

Due to the complex and expansive nature of the PWR, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/PWR[/url]

#{00aa00}This quest demands the most essential parts of a PWR, and does not represent the amount needed for a functioning reactor. There are also many other types of PWR Components that can be used.

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.quest.51969.name: PWR powered Steel Furnace
ntnhcore.quest.51969.desc: Instead of using the #{55ffff}Hot Coolant#{reset} for power, one can use it to make the #{00aaaa}Steel Furnace#{reset} go at ludicrous speeds.
ntnhcore.quest.52225.name: Pyrolysis Oven
ntnhcore.quest.52225.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Pyrolysis Oven#{reset} is a mid-to-late game oil processing machine that allows easier production pf #{ffaa00}Crystalline Fullerite#{reset}, which is needed in bulk for late-game machines onwards. 

It can process an item with an optional fluid to produce another item and/or fluid. Functionally, it works similar to the #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}, mostly in bedrock ore processing.
Its main use however is in production of #{ffaa00}Fullerene#{reset}, as it can turn #{ffaa00}Tar#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Fine Soot#{reset}, eliminating the RNG of a #{00aaaa}Smokestack#{reset}.

Operating the pyrolysis oven will consume #{ffff55}200kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.52481.name: Radar Survey Satellite
ntnhcore.quest.52481.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Radar Survey Satellite#{reset} detects all radar-visible entities - players, rockets, and more - within a 1000-chunk radius of its target position. It compiles results into a searchable list with entity types and exact coordinates, and can filter results by class name without requiring a new scan.

RoR commands: "survey" scans the area and saves results to both a base list and a filtered list. "filter name" replaces the filtered list with only entries matching that class name - the original list is preserved, so this can be run multiple times for different types without rescanning. "count" writes the number of filtered results to RX. "gettargetid index" returns the unique entity ID for a given entry, which can be passed to other satellites for precise targeting. "getposition index" writes exact X/Y/Z coordinates - separated by semicolons - to RX. "getname index" writes the class name of the entry to RX.

#{00aa00}Pair this satellite with an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Orbital Precision Laser#{reset} for automated missile interception.
ntnhcore.quest.52737.name: Radiation-Powered Engine
ntnhcore.quest.52737.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Radiation-Powered Engine#{reset} turns nuclear waste into decayed waste while also making energy in the process and giving guaranteed consistent decay times.

#{00aa00}Blueprints can be found in structures or purchased from Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.quest.52993.name: RBMK
ntnhcore.quest.52993.desc:
The #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} is a modular boiling-water type nuclear fission reactor which consists entirely of concrete columns. Each of these columns is either blank or has a specific function that it performs such as holding fuel rods, moderating neutrons, or storing #{55ffff}Water#{reset} to be boiled into #{55ffff}Steam#{reset}. Each column will also exchange heat with the column next to it such that temperature differences between columns will gradually equalize within the reactor. If any column reaches #{ffff55}1500°C#{reset}, the reactor will explode incredibly violently, spraying scrap and immensely radioactive material in every direction.

Due to the complex and expansive nature of the RBMK, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/RBMK[/url]

#{00aa00}This quest provides an optional retrieval task for a cheap and safe RBMK design which can produce High-Performance Solvent#{reset} #{00aa00}without cooling. Simply Place the RBMK Irradiation Channel next to the RBMK Fuel Rod, apply the covers on the collumns and surround them with a solid block.

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.quest.53249.name: RBMK Fuel Processing
ntnhcore.quest.53249.desc: With the #{00aaaa}Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum#{reset} to decay waste and a #{00aaaa}SILEX#{reset}, #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset} nuclear fuels can be processed into many new materials.
ntnhcore.quest.53505.name: Reformate
ntnhcore.quest.53505.desc:
#{55ffff}Reformate#{reset} is a product of #{55ffff}Crude Oil#{reset} obtained via a #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} or from processing #{55ffff}Naptha#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Hydrotreater#{reset}.

#{00aa00}This step can be skipped if making Jet Fuel and BTX using a Hydrotreater.
ntnhcore.quest.5377.name: Chainsaw
ntnhcore.quest.5377.desc:
#{ff5555}Painsaw.#{reset}

Although the #{ffaa00}Chainsaw#{reset} is similar in functionality to the #{ffaa00}axe#{reset}, its arsenal is much broader. By default, the saw simply mines blocks, but it also has two additional operating modes: #{ffff55}Silk Touch#{reset} and #{ffff55}Vein Miner (5)#{reset}.

It runs on many types of #{55ffff}liquid fuel#{reset} (see the item description for a list). Mining one block consumes 1 mB#{reset} of fuel.

Besides its primary purpose, the Chainsaw can also serve as a decent melee weapon, as it deals significant damage and has modifiers: #{ffff55}Painsaw#{reset} and #{ffff55}Decapitator#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.53761.name: Reformate Gas
ntnhcore.quest.53761.desc: #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset} is used in welding very durable materials, as well as used in making #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.54017.name: Saturnite
ntnhcore.quest.54017.desc: #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} is a very durable, heat-resistant and corrosion-resistant alloy that is commonly used for making stronger gun parts. It is also used to make #{ffaa00}Starmetal#{reset} and is an important component of the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} reactor.
ntnhcore.quest.54273.name: Schrabidium
ntnhcore.quest.54273.desc:
#{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} is a dangerous material, but one which is needed for the creation of other items, such as #{ffaa00}Magnetized Tungsten#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Ferric Schrabidate#{reset}. It also makes for great reactor fuel. It can be created from exposing uranium ore to radiation using either a nuclear weapon or, more easily, by exploding radioactive barrels found in the abandoned nuclear powerplants in deserts.

#{00aa00}When holding Schrabidium, the player will receive the blindness effect, so it is recommended that a Suit which provides protection from both Bright Lights and Radiation is used.
ntnhcore.quest.54529.name: Solid Mud Brick
ntnhcore.quest.54529.desc: #{ffaa00}Poisonous Mud#{reset} is the byproduct of the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} operating. This is the solidified version of it which can be used in a #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} to create #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.54785.name: Soyuz-FG
ntnhcore.quest.54785.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Soyuz-FG Rocket#{reset} is an immensely powerful Soviet rocket that is the primary launch vehicle for all satellites. The rocket must be launched from a suitably large mount - in this case, the #{00aaaa}Soyuz Launch Platform#{reset}.

It requires 128,000mB of #{55ffff}Kerosene#{reset} and #{55ffff}Liquid Oxygen#{reset} to be launched as well as #{ffff55}750kHE#{reset} of power. Pressing the launch button starts a 30 second countdown. After the countdown has completed, the Soyuz will launch.

The Soyuz can, alongside its primary ability to deliver any satellite to orbit, also be set to a cargo mode, in which it can deliver any provided cargo to a distant spot across the world. Obviously, this is an incredibly expensive way to transport goods, and currently doesn't provide much utility.

#{00aa00}Blueprints for the Soyuz can be found in structures or purchased through Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.quest.55041.name: Spent Fuel Pool Drum
ntnhcore.quest.55041.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Spent Fuel Pool Drum#{reset} is used to cool down hot nuclear fuel rods for the #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} and #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset}. It has 12 slots.

The drum needs to have atleast one of its sides touching #{55ffff}Water#{reset} to work. The more sides that have water the faster the fuels inside will cool down.
ntnhcore.quest.55297.name: Starmetal
ntnhcore.quest.55297.desc: #{ffaa00}Starmetal#{reset} is a unique alloy made from combining #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} with #{ffaa00}Meteorite Powder#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.55553.name: Starmetal Pickaxe
ntnhcore.quest.55553.desc: The #{ffaa00}Starmetal Pickaxe#{reset} is used as a crafting component for the #{ffaa00}Molten#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Bismuth Pickaxes#{reset}, both being unbreakable and having a lot of abilities. Additionally, both can be used to mine #{ffff55}Depth Rock#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.55809.name: Technetium-99
ntnhcore.quest.55809.desc: #{ffaa00}Technetium-99#{reset} is a common waste product from the fission of #{ffaa00}Uranium#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Plutonium#{reset}. It is mainly used in making #{ffaa00}Technetium Steel#{reset} and #{ff55ff}AE2 Storage Components#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.56065.name: Technetium/Cadmium Steel
ntnhcore.quest.56065.desc: #{ffaa00}Technetium/Cadmium Steel#{reset} is a steel based alloy mixed with technetium-99/Cadmium which has extreme corrosion resistance. It is frequently used in the late-game and acts as one of the main material gates of the #{00aaaa}Fusion#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant.
ntnhcore.quest.5633.name: Charcoal Automation
ntnhcore.quest.5633.desc: #{ffaa00}Wood#{reset} obtained from a tree farm can be smelted or processed in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset} to produce #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset}, which has many uses, such as fuel for #{00aaaa}Furnaces#{reset} or even the #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Flux#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Carbon#{reset} in a Crucible for #{ffaa00}Steel#{reset} production, or even #{ffaa00}Gunpowder#{reset} for ammunition.
ntnhcore.quest.56321.name: Tungsten Carbide
ntnhcore.quest.56321.desc: #{ffaa00}Tungsten Carbide#{reset} is an alloy made from #{ffaa00}Tungsten#{reset} and #{55ffff}Syngas#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Pyrolysis Oven#{reset}. It is mainly used in crafting neutron reflectors for reactors and nukes.
ntnhcore.quest.56577.name: Uranium-238
ntnhcore.quest.56577.desc:
#{ffaa00}Uranium-238#{reset} is the most common uranium isotope in the game. 

This material has many uses, some of which are: #{ffaa00}Ferrouranium#{reset}, MOX fuel, depleted uranium ammunition, absorber Pellets for the #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant and can also be turned into #{ffaa00}Schrabidium#{reset} later on in the #{00aaaa}Exposure Chamber#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.56833.name: Vacuum Refinery
ntnhcore.quest.56833.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} is an oil refinery which processes #{55ffff}Pressurized/Desulfurized Crude Oil#{reset} into 4 liquid products. It is a good way to make #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset} by using #{55ffff}Reformate Gas#{reset} and #{55ffff}Chlorine Gas#{reset} in an #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset}.

#{00aa00}Compressors are needed for the oil to be inserted inside the Vacuum Refinery.
ntnhcore.quest.57089.name: Versatile Circuit Board
ntnhcore.quest.57089.desc: The #{ffaa00}Versatile Circuit Board#{reset} is the final tier of circuit board, requiring #{ffaa00}Bismuth/Arsenic#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Hard Plastic/PVC Bars#{reset}.  As well as this, it is by far the most expensive circuit board, requiring nearly 55 insulators to craft a single one. Used rarely but in small amounts in advanced machines like the #{00aaaa}Fusion Reactor#{reset} and in large amounts in components for the #{00aaaa}ICF Reactor#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.57345.name: Versatile Integrated Circuit
ntnhcore.quest.57345.desc: The #{ffaa00}Versatile Integrated Circuit#{reset} is the first circuit to use #{ffaa00}Bismuth/Arsenic#{reset}. It is used in more advanced machines such as the #{00aaaa}Vacuum Refinery#{reset} and is one of the main components of #{ffaa00}Versatile Circuit Boards#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.57601.name: Watz Powerplant
ntnhcore.quest.57601.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Watz#{reset} powerplant is a fission reactor which can produce #{55ffff}Poisonous Mud#{reset}, an important component of #{ffaa00}CMB Steel#{reset}. Although the reactor is not really powerful in terms of energy output, it can be stacked ontop of eachother for increased mud and power production.

If the poisonous mud buffer reaches its maximum, the reactor will melt down and explode, irradiating a wide area around it and causing fallout to fall in a small area around it. As well as this, it will spew poisonous mud in a very wide area which will then corrode any blocks that it comes in contact with, similar to corium.
ntnhcore.quest.57857.name: Welded Technetium/Cadmium Steel Plate
ntnhcore.quest.57857.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Welded Technetium/Cadmium Steel Plate#{reset} is the welded varient of the cast technetium/cadmium steel plate and is used in some recipes that require strong materials. 

#{00aa00}Make sure to have good energy generation and storage infrastructure as each plate costs 1.2 Billion HE.
ntnhcore.quest.58113.name: Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite
ntnhcore.quest.58113.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Wideband Radio Emission Detector Satellite#{reset} monitors the entire map for high-energy events with no range limit, returning only an approximate location. Use it as a first-pass detection layer - once a hit is found, follow up with the #{00aaaa}Narrowband Emission Scanning Satellite#{reset} or #{00aaaa}Radar Satellite#{reset} to pinpoint the source.

Events are grouped by intensity. LOW covers mini-nuke detonations, accurate to within 10,000 m. MEDIUM covers active radars and particle accelerators, accurate to within 2,500 m. HIGH covers nuclear explosions, accurate to within 500 m. MEDIUM events persist for only half a second while others last up to a minute, so rapid repeated scans are recommended.

RoR commands: "esurvey" collects all active results; "ecount" writes the total to RX; "egettype" writes LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH for a given index; "egetposition" writes approximate X/Z coordinates for a given index.

#{00aa00}Route this satellite's output through an #{00aaaa}AUTOCAL#{reset}#{00aa00} to automatically cue more precise instruments when a hit is detected.
ntnhcore.quest.58369.name: Xenium Resonator Satellite
ntnhcore.quest.58369.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Xenium Resonator Satellite#{reset} provides unlimited on-demand teleportation with no cooldown. Before launch, its frequency must be linked to a #{ffaa00}Satellite Designator#{reset} using the #{00aaaa}Satellite ID Manager#{reset}.

A standard #{ffaa00}Satellite Designator#{reset} requires coordinates to be entered manually. A #{ffaa00}Satellite (Laser) Designator#{reset} is simpler - aim the crosshair at a block and right-click.

#{00aa00}Interdimensional teleportation is not supported.
ntnhcore.quest.58625.name: ZIRNOX
ntnhcore.quest.58625.desc:
The #{00aaaa}ZIRNOX#{reset} is the first and cheapest nuclear reactor one can make. Unlike the #{00aaaa}PWR#{reset} and #{00aaaa}RBMK#{reset}, it is a fully assembled reactor which requires #{55ffff}Water#{reset} and #{55ffff}Carbon Dioxide#{reset} to operate.

Due to its modest steam output, the ZIRNOX can be paired with several #{00aaaa}Steam Engines#{reset}, though an #{00aaaa}Industrial Turbine#{reset} is recommended for its #{ffff55}100%#{reset} efficiency. A single #{00aaaa}Steam Condenser#{reset} handles the exhaust on lower power fuels. 24 #{ffaa00}Natural Uranium Fuel Rods#{reset} using 14kmB of carbon dioxide will yield a power output of around #{ffff55}240kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.5889.name: Charging Station
ntnhcore.quest.5889.desc: The #{00aaaa}Charging Station#{reset} will charge electric tools aswell as electric suits when standing near it. Placing more next to eachother will increase the speed at which items are being recharged.
ntnhcore.quest.58881.name: Red Key
ntnhcore.quest.58881.desc: The #{ffaa00}Red Key#{reset} is able to open any container that requires a regular key, regardless of the pin configuration of the lock, and it is one of the only two keys capable of opening the keyhole found on strange stone, in order to open a #{ffff55}Red Room#{reset}. The key has no durability, and can be reused indefinitely.
ntnhcore.quest.59137.name: Alkylation Unit
ntnhcore.quest.59137.desc: The #{00aaaa}Alkylation Unit#{reset} is designed to convert lighter hydrocarbons into useful heavier hydrocarbon products. From #{55ffff}Natural Gas#{reset} it can produce #{55ffff}Unsaturated#{reset} and #{55ffff}Aromatic hydrocarbons#{reset}, commonly used for #{ffaa00}Rubber#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Bakelite#{reset}, and even produce #{55ffff}BTX#{reset} via the use of #{55ffff}High-Performance Solvent#{reset}. As a utility, it can also alkylate #{55ffff}Petroleum Gas#{reset} into #{55ffff}Light Oil#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.59393.name: Armospheric Liquefaction Tower
ntnhcore.quest.59393.desc: The Air Liquefaction Tower is intended for obtaining liquid nitrogen from compressed air.
ntnhcore.quest.59649.name: Atmospheric Compressor
ntnhcore.quest.59649.desc: The #{00aaaa}Atmospheric Compressor#{reset} collects air from different planets. In combination with a #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset} it can produce many useful fluids and gasses.
ntnhcore.quest.59905.name: Atmospheric Scanner
ntnhcore.quest.59905.desc: The #{ffaa00}Atmospheric Scanner#{reset} shows the atmospheric consistency of planets. Useful for when terraforming.
ntnhcore.quest.60161.name: Brine Processing
ntnhcore.quest.60161.desc: #{55ffff}Brine#{reset}, which is found in deposits similar to oil ones on earth, can be processed to obtain materials such as #{ffaa00}Nickel#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Copper#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset}, and fluids such as #{55ffff}Hydrogen#{reset} and #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.60417.name: CMB Insert
ntnhcore.quest.60417.desc:
#{ffaa00}CMB Iserts#{reset} are an armor modification which will protect its user from the corrosive atmosphere of #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}. 

The #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester#{reset} will return back with #{55ffff}Jool Air#{reset}, to be processed by the #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.60673.name: CO2 Scrubber
ntnhcore.quest.60929.name: Cryogenic Distillation Machine
ntnhcore.quest.60929.desc: The #{00aaaa}Cryogenic Distillation Machine#{reset} can split atmospheric gases into 4 useful fractions, like for example, taking trace amounts of #{55ffff}Nitrogen#{reset} out of the Dunaian atmosphere to produce soil for planting crops.
ntnhcore.quest.61185.name: Dres
ntnhcore.quest.61185.desc: This planet has some of the most prized resources in the whole system, with even the primary fraction of bedrock ore consisting of incredibly valuable metals and materials. #{ffaa00}Niobium#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Coltan#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Lanthanium#{reset} ore is present here in vast quantities.
ntnhcore.quest.6145.name: Charm of Protection
ntnhcore.quest.6145.desc: The #{ffaa00}Charm of Protection#{reset} diverts meteorites away from the player and prevents them from destoying blocks. It is recommended that one is obtained as soon as possible as to prevent costly damages in the future.
ntnhcore.quest.61441.name: Drive Processor Tier 3
ntnhcore.quest.61441.desc: The #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 3#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Laythe#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.61697.name: Drive Processor Tier 2
ntnhcore.quest.61697.desc: The #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 2#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Dres#{reset} and #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.61953.name: Drive Processor Tier 1
ntnhcore.quest.61953.desc: #{00aaaa}Drive Processor Tier 1#{reset} allows for travel to #{ffff55}Duna#{reset}, #{ffff55}Ike#{reset} and #{ffff55}Moho#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.62209.name: Drop Pod
ntnhcore.quest.62209.desc:
With a #{00aaaa}Drop pod#{reset}, one can access their space station without needing to build new rockets. They can also be used to land on other planets once the station has reached them.

#{00aa00}Make sure to keep spare drives.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.62465.name: Duna
ntnhcore.quest.62465.desc: The red planet, home to vast quantities of #{ffaa00}Iron#{reset}. #{ffaa00}Molysite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Volcano Gems#{reset} can be found here in basaltic caves, found within basins where vast oceans were theorized to once exist.
ntnhcore.quest.62721.name: Eve
ntnhcore.quest.62721.desc: While it is possible to travel here with only a tier 2 drive processor to exploit the incredibly powerful schrabidic resources that exist here, players will not last long without the appropriate armor inserts, due to the highly corrosive atmosphere melting any armor it comes into contact with.
ntnhcore.quest.62977.name: Gallium Arsenide
ntnhcore.quest.62977.desc: #{ffaa00}Gallium Arsenide#{reset} is made from mixing #{ffaa00}Gallium#{reset}, which can be procured by processing rich mineral deposits from #{ffff55}Moho#{reset} or #{ffff55}Ike#{reset}, and #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} which is found on Ike in bedrock ore, or on #{ffff55}Earth#{reset} via dirt and stone that has been damaged by hydraulic fracking.
ntnhcore.quest.63233.name: Gas Giant Harvester
ntnhcore.quest.63233.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester Station#{reset} is a device for collecting atmospheric air samples from gas giants.

The concept is quite simple: on a planet that is a satellite of the giant (for example, to fly to the green giant Jool, you need to go to Laythe), the station is set up. After refueling with #{55ffff}Liquid Oxygen#{reset} and #{55ffff}Hydrogen#{reset}, the #{00aaaa}harvester rocket#{reset} is sent for air. In one trip, it delivers 16,000 mB#{reset}. As you can understand, the harvester's#{reset} functionality is completely analogous to the operation of #{00aaaa}MiningModules#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.63489.name: Hafnium
ntnhcore.quest.63489.desc: #{ffaa00}Hafnium#{reset} is a rare light metal needed to produce the #{ffaa00}Hafnium chips#{reset}, which at this stage in progression can only be obtained by centrifuging niobium crystals, which must be created from niobium ore, only found on #{ffff55}Dres#{reset} and #{ffff55}Eve#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.63745.name: Hydrazine
ntnhcore.quest.63745.desc: #{55ffff}Hydrazine#{reset} is a powerful rocket fuel which is needed to operate a #{00aaaa}Drop Pod#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.6401.name: Chemical Plant
ntnhcore.quest.6401.desc: The #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset} is a machine needed for several processes, turning fluids into other fluids, synthesis of different compounds, ect. Like the #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset}, recipes can be selected entirely within the GUI.
ntnhcore.quest.64001.name: Ike
ntnhcore.quest.64001.desc: #{ffff55}Ike#{reset}, the sole moon of #{ffff55}Duna#{reset}, has hints of a past as a significant hazardous waste dump, with large spires and pyramids reminiscent of potential designs on Earth for warning future civilizations of great danger in relation to nuclear waste. #{ffff55}Meteor dungeons#{reset} spawn more frequently here, and pools of #{55ffff}Alkyl Bromide#{reset} can be found on the surface.
ntnhcore.quest.64257.name: Industrial Greenhouse
ntnhcore.quest.64257.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Greenhouse#{reset} converts #{55ffff}Carbon Dioxide#{reset} into #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset} via crop growth. The greenhouse can also be supplied with #{ffaa00}Fertilizer#{reset} for faster growing.
ntnhcore.quest.64513.name: Jool
ntnhcore.quest.64769.name: Laythe
ntnhcore.quest.64769.desc: A beautiful water world, teeming with life, oceans lit up with fields of glowgrass. #{55ffff}Jool gas#{reset} can be harvested from here using a #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvester#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.65025.name: Magma Drill
ntnhcore.quest.65025.desc:
Unlike its counterpart from the original mod, the Magma Drill does not literally drill into the depths. It is designed for extracting magma from Moho, which, as known, is abundant on this planet both on the surface and in caves. To start working, the mechanism must be installed directly on the surface of a lava lake so that the lava touches the drill head and reaches the edges of the recess. Supply power to the drill, and it will operate automatically.

Magma is output through casting channels into molds. Cooled magma forms Vulcanite, which should then be processed to obtain useful resources.

In addition to volcanite, the device extracts regular slag (much more than Vulcanite).
ntnhcore.quest.65281.name: Microgravity Algae Film
ntnhcore.quest.65281.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Microgravity Algae Film#{reset} is a machine is made of specialized layers of laythe plants that will convert #{55ffff}Carbon Dioxide#{reset} directly into #{55ffff}Liquid Oxygen#{reset}. They however only function when in orbit.

The #{00aaaa}CO2 Scrubber#{reset} allows you to recover carbon dioxide from a pressurized room. This is occasionally useful when building space stations.
ntnhcore.quest.65537.name: Mobile Orbital Station
ntnhcore.quest.65537.desc: By having an orbital station have an #{00aaaa}Orbital Station Computer#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Drop Pods#{reset}, one can move their station to any destination they wish, massively cutting down on material costs needed to make new rockets.
ntnhcore.quest.65793.name: Moho
ntnhcore.quest.65793.desc: A fair-dinkum planet, hot as hell, and full of rare resources generally only found in the Nether. #{ffaa00}Australium#{reset} is only found here, in vast quantities deep under the surface. Some of the largest caves ever generated within Minecraft can be found here.
ntnhcore.quest.66049.name: Mun Cow?!
ntnhcore.quest.66049.desc: This is something new; don't ask questions like how a cow survives on the Mun without food or where it got a PLSS module. The fact is, they feel quite well on the Mun, and due to the vacuum, the milk inside them has curdled.
ntnhcore.quest.66305.name: Mun/Minmus
ntnhcore.quest.66305.desc:
Your first destination! Absolutely chock full of #{ffaa00}Lithium#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Quartz#{reset} and most importantly your first source of #{ffaa00}Nickel#{reset} to start producing #{ffaa00}Stainless Steel#{reset} for space-grade machinery. The #{ffff55}Mun#{reset} is the first atmosphere-less body available in a regular playthrough, necessary for making the first tier of #{ffaa00}Drive Processors#{reset} in the #{00aaaa}Vacuum Solderer#{reset}.

The B-Side destination alternative to the Mun, #{ffff55}Minmus#{reset} is characterized by a distinctive mint-choc-chip ice-cream aesthetic. #{00aaaa}Pumps#{reset} function here, but instead of producing #{55ffff}Water#{reset}, this moon bizarrely produces #{55ffff}Milk#{reset}, allowing for full automation of #{ffaa00}Butter#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Milkshakes#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Ice-Cream#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.6657.name: Cladding
ntnhcore.quest.6657.desc: #{ffaa00}Cladding#{reset} is one of the most important armor modifications which reduce radiation intake. It can be inserted to all armor pieces.
ntnhcore.quest.66561.name: My First Volcano!
ntnhcore.quest.66561.desc:
The formation of a volcano is driven by the #{00aaaa}volcanic core#{reset}, a block that continuously erupts #{55ffff}lava#{reset}, allowing the volcano to grow. The #{55ffff}lava#{reset} cools quickly, turning into #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{ffaa00}basaltic ore#{reset}.

The resulting volcano grows quite slowly, reaching about 60 blocks in height over 20-30 minutes.

#{55ffff}Volcanic lava#{reset} differs from #{55ffff}regular lava#{reset} not only in appearance. It "melts" any non-explosion-resistant blocks, so the volcano can extend underground.

#{ffaa00}Basaltic ores#{reset} (#{ffaa00}asbestos#{reset}, #{ffaa00}sulfur#{reset}, #{ffaa00}fluorite#{reset}, #{ffaa00}molysite#{reset}) form when the #{55ffff}lava#{reset} cools, each with a 0.5% chance.

#{ffaa00}Volcanic gem ore#{reset} spawns with a 5% chance if the following conditions are met:
- All 6 blocks around the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset} are #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{55ffff}lava#{reset};
- The block 10 blocks above the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset} is #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} or #{55ffff}lava#{reset};
- There are fewer than 3 #{55ffff}lava#{reset} blocks around the cooling #{55ffff}lava#{reset}.

The #{ffaa00}ore#{reset} also forms after #{55ffff}volcanic lava#{reset} contacts #{ffaa00}diamond ore#{reset}.
This means #{ffaa00}volcanic gems#{reset} most often appear near the #{00aaaa}core#{reset} or #{00aaaa}crater#{reset} of the volcano.

#{00aaaa}Forming a Radioactive Volcano#{reset}
If the #{00aaaa}volcanic core#{reset} is exposed to radioactive fallout (e.g., after a nearby nuclear explosion) for some time, the #{00aaaa}core#{reset} will begin generating new #{55ffff}volcanic radioactive lava#{reset} (yellow in color), ultimately leading to the formation of a so-called #{00aaaa}radioactive volcano#{reset}. Such a volcano will consist not of #{ffaa00}basalt#{reset} but of various types of #{ffaa00}quenched sellaphite blocks#{reset} and #{ffaa00}sellaphite ores#{reset}. The #{55ffff}lava#{reset} will convert #{ffaa00}diamond ores#{reset} into #{ffaa00}radioactive gem ore#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.66817.name: Occasionally Heavy Boots
ntnhcore.quest.66817.desc: Temporarily increases gravity on low gravity worlds when holding crouch.
ntnhcore.quest.67073.name: Orbital Station
ntnhcore.quest.67073.desc: The #{00aaaa}Orbital Station#{reset} is a space station which is located at the orbit of #{ffff55}Earth#{reset}. #{00aaaa}Solar Panels#{reset} in combination with #{00aaaa}Air Vents#{reset} can be used to make a sustainable living environment in the station. Make sure to make airlocks to minimise air loss.
ntnhcore.quest.67329.name: Orbital Station Computer
ntnhcore.quest.67329.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Orbital Station Computer#{reset}, when having a drive inserted into it, can move the station to its destination.

#{00aaaa}Thrusters#{reset} with fuel are required to be attached to the station.
ntnhcore.quest.67585.name: Rocket Assembling and Launching
ntnhcore.quest.67585.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Vehicle Assembly Base#{reset} is a structure which is one of the most vital parts of your space-faring efforts. It'll allow you to stack your rockets and plan out each segment of your journey. Note that each rocket stage allows for one launch from a celestial body to another, so a two-stage rocket can make a round-trip between, say, the Earth and the Mun.

The #{00aaaa}Rocket Launch Pad#{reset} is the only launch pad capable of supporting the various fuel loads and complex requirements of the stacked rockets. This is the only way to fuel up a rocket too, so you'll want to make multiple stages for launching from bodies without a pad. The pad itself has a GUI that'll indicate what your rocket requires to be launched.
ntnhcore.quest.67841.name: Rocket Preparations
ntnhcore.quest.67841.desc:
Due to the expansive nature of rocket assembly, it is highly recommend that the wiki is checked out as it provides more information.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Vehicle_Assembly_Base_(NTM:_Space)[/url]

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.quest.68097.name: Rocket Transporter Pad
ntnhcore.quest.68097.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Rocket Transporter Station#{reset} is essential for sending and receiving cargo between celestial bodies.

#{00aaaa}Transport rockets#{reset}, similar to #{00aaaa}resource modules#{reset} or #{00aaaa}Gas Giant Harvesters#{reset}, automatically move various cargoes. To make the system work, you need at least one pair of linked platforms#{reset}.

The platforms have compartments for outgoing and incoming items (blue and orange, respectively)#{reset}, and they can handle liquids with #{00aaaa}dedicated buffers#{reset}.

To link platforms, Shift+Right-Click with the #{ffaa00}Rocket Transporter Connector#{reset} on one platform to save it, then Right-Click on another platform. To open the linker interface#{reset}, Right-Click on a platform with the connector: it will display information about the linked platforms' locations.

To designate one of these points as the receiving point, click the button at the beginning of the row#{reset}.

To launch the transporter rocket#{reset}, the station must be fueled with #{55ffff}liquid oxygen#{reset} and #{55ffff}hydrogen#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.68353.name: Solar Panel
ntnhcore.quest.68609.name: Space Equipment
ntnhcore.quest.68609.desc:
The #{ffaa00}PLSS#{reset} is an armor modification which will allow you to breathe in space. It will only work on airtight sealed suits.

The #{ffaa00}Heavy Boots#{reset} can be used to quickly descend down in low-gravity environments.
ntnhcore.quest.68865.name: Space Map
ntnhcore.quest.68865.desc:
Here is my own (Bufka2011) map of our Kerbol system!
[img height=300]resources:SpaceMap_by_Bufka2011.png[/img]
ntnhcore.quest.6913.name: Combination Oven
ntnhcore.quest.6913.desc: The #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset} is a unique type of furnace that transforms items into their respective product and produce liquid byproducts. It can be used to produce #{ffaa00}Coke#{reset}, #{55ffff}Wood Oil#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Aluminium#{reset} more efficiently.
ntnhcore.quest.69121.name: Stainless Steel
ntnhcore.quest.69121.desc: #{ffaa00}Stainless Steel#{reset} is an alloy made of #{ffaa00}Steel#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Nickel#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.69377.name: Stardar and Drive Processor
ntnhcore.quest.69377.desc:
The #{00aaaa}StarDar#{reset} is your base of operations for mission planning, helping you to locate and scan potential landing zones on planets, and #{ffaa00}Program Drives#{reset} that can be inserted into your rocket's astronavigational systems to make journeys to said planets.

The #{00aaaa}Drive Processor#{reset} processes drives that have been programmed by the StarDar, allowing them to be inserted into rocket navigation computers.
ntnhcore.quest.69633.name: StarDar Remote Access Console
ntnhcore.quest.69889.name: Steam Radiator
ntnhcore.quest.69889.desc: The #{00aaaa}Steam Radiator#{reset} is a steam condenser that works in the vacuum of space.
ntnhcore.quest.70145.name: Tectonic Missile
ntnhcore.quest.70145.desc: When a #{ffaa00}Tectonic Missile#{reset} hits, it creates a volcano that immediately starts to splash volcanic lava everywhere. Which is what you need to get the volcanic gem!
ntnhcore.quest.70401.name: Tekto
ntnhcore.quest.70401.desc:
A strange world, similar to #{ffff55}Earth#{reset}, where life is different because the vegetation, the only form of life there, is made of complex polymers, like rubber#{reset} and plastic#{reset}.

Tekto bedrock ore doesn’t have the non-metal variant; instead, it is replaced by the plastic variant, from which the player can obtain #{ffaa00}Polymer#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Rubber#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Semtex#{reset} and #{ffaa00}PVC#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.70657.name: Teleporter
ntnhcore.quest.70657.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Teleporter#{reset} can be used to teleport players, and entities in general, to a specific location.

Right-click a block with the #{ffaa00}Telelinker#{reset} to set the desired exit position, then shift-click the teleporter with the telelinker to configure the teleporter.

#{00aa00}The teleporter is a one way trip so it is advised that multiple are made.

Interdimensional teleportation using teleporters requires a very expensive type of fuel, so it is recommended that other teleportations methods are used, such as AE2 Spatial.
ntnhcore.quest.70913.name: The Mun is Cheese...
ntnhcore.quest.70913.desc: When a century-old joke gets out of hand... At least you can make a juicy quesadilla.
ntnhcore.quest.71169.name: Vacuum Solderer
ntnhcore.quest.71169.desc: The #{00aaaa}Vacuum Solderer#{reset} is a machine that can only function in a vacuum, and produces vacuum circuits. They can be placed into the #{00aaaa}Drive Processor#{reset} to enable it to process higher tier planetary drives.
ntnhcore.quest.71425.name: Volcanic Gem
ntnhcore.quest.71425.desc: A very valuable gemstone that is used to create a #{ffaa00}Cast Pickaxe#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Meteorite Talisman#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Black Diamond#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Composite Euphemium Plates#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Special 227mm Shells#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.7169.name: Conveyor Belt
ntnhcore.quest.7169.desc:
#{00aaaa}Conveyors#{reset} provide the simplest way of moving items around. There are multiple blocks that can interface with machines as well as items moving along conveyor belts.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Belts#{reset} are blocks used to transport items. They can pick up dropped items or items from conveyor ejectors. Conveyor inserters can take items from conveyor belts. If there are no conveyor inserters present, the item will be dropped at the end of the conveyor belt line.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Inserters#{reset} are blocks that take items from conveyor belts and outputs them into a storage space. Conveyor ejectors are the opposite, they take items from storage and place them onto conveyor belts. 

Inserters have an option to destroy surplus items if the input buffer has run full, otherwise the items that can neither be inserted in the target nor the inserter's buffer is simply dropped.

The ejector has a whitelist/blacklist system (the default mode is blacklist with no restrictions - this means that everything will go through). Right-clicking the white arrow will toggle between whitelist and blacklist. An item can be added to the blacklist/whitelist by "depositing" it into the blue inventory square - the item will not be consumed, however.

The #{00aaaa}Conveyor Splitter#{reset} is a type of conveyor belt that splits items evenly onto 2 lanes.

#{00aaaa}Conveyor Sorters#{reset} are blocks that can sort various items to a specific conveyor belt. They do not have a buffer and simple move items to connected conveyor belts based on their filter options, therefore they can sort items as quickly as they receive them.
The sorter has six outputs with five slots each, making it able to route multiple items to one belt.
ntnhcore.quest.71681.name: Dyson Anatmogenesis Terraformer
ntnhcore.quest.71681.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Dyson Anatmogenesis Terraformer#{reset} provides the most utility out of all the currently available #{00aaaa}Dyson converters#{reset}, accepting a beam from a receiver and providing a direct energy to mass conversion, producing planetary scale atmospheric gases, terraforming any planet or moon as a player sees fit.

By default it will release oxygen into an atmosphere, making it breathable once it crosses the 0.1atm threshold for breathing. A fluid identifier can be used to switch the gas emitted, and a screwdriver can switch it between emitting or extracting gases from the atmosphere.

If powered with #{ffff55}150THE/s#{reset} power from a swarm (equivalent to a swarm size of 1,024), it will take 8 hours to reach 0.1atm of pressure.
ntnhcore.quest.71937.name: Dyson Swarms
ntnhcore.quest.71937.desc:
#{00aaaa}Dyson Swarms#{reset} consist of thousands of swarm members encircling the parent star of a system, and energy production from the swarm scales based on the number of members in a swarm. These satellites do not last indefinitely however, they attenuate (decay) over time, with the chance of decay increasing as the number of swarm members increase.

#{ffaa00}Dyson Swarm Members#{reset} must be launched into solar orbit via the use of a huge centrifugal launch platform, known as the #{00aaaa}Spinlauncher#{reset}. The spinlauncher launches 4 swarm members at a time, consuming a large amount of electricity to do so.

The #{00aaaa}Dyson Receiver#{reset} is the main machine required for collecting energy from the swarm. It collimates the immense energy collected from the swarm into a immensely powerful beam. Setting up requires only a satellite ID chip that is matched to an existing swarm. The energy beam must be pointed towards a Dyson Power Converter.

The #{00aaaa}Satellite Dyson Relay#{reset} can be used to allow dyson swarms to provide power during night time.
ntnhcore.quest.72193.name: The End of Space...
ntnhcore.quest.72449.name: Balls-O-Tron
ntnhcore.quest.72449.desc: #{aa0000}Balls-O-Tron#{reset} is the second boss of #{ff55ff}NTM#{reset}. It can be summoned by interracting the mechanist's circle, found in the #{ffff55}Enargite Temple#{reset} which spawns in jungles, with a #{ffaa00}Silver Key#{reset}, made using the Maskman Coin, or from crafting the Balls-O-Tron spawn item.
ntnhcore.quest.72705.name: Chicken Nugget
ntnhcore.quest.72705.desc: The #{ffaa00}Chicken Nugget#{reset} is the best food item in the mod, completely filling up both hunger and saturation. It is made by colliding 2 raw chickens in a #{00aaaa}Particle Accelerator#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.72961.name: DFC
ntnhcore.quest.72961.desc:
The #{00aaaa}DFC#{reset} is the last reactor of the mod and as such is very expensive to craft. Apart from the DFC parts, two #{ffaa00}Catalysts#{reset} are needed for the reactor to work.

It is recommended that the wiki is checked out.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/DFC[/url]

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.quest.73217.name: Digamma Laser Crystal
ntnhcore.quest.73217.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Digamma Laser Crystal#{reset} is the fastest and final laser crystal which can be used in a SILEX.

#{00aa00}If the laser touches any block, the surrounding area will be atomized.
ntnhcore.quest.73473.name: Dineurtom amrr
ntnhcore.quest.73473.desc:
Increasus damge takn by 5x tims
Bestest armr in da wurld!!!!!!1!!1!!

Staje of da gaim - Brayn Partiklz
Protekshun levl - Funtastick
Feetchurs - Yoor Btes Chois
ntnhcore.quest.73729.name: Dineutronium
ntnhcore.quest.73729.desc: #{ffaa00}Dineutronium#{reset} is the mod's (almost) ultimate material. It's a final tier material and is a higher tier than even #{ffaa00}Euphemium#{reset}. It is very difficult to produce and it's used to make the most absurd and broken items this mod has. The only material that is more difficult to make, would be #{ffaa00}Osmiridium#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.73985.name: Dineutronium Anvil
ntnhcore.quest.73985.desc: An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T7], which unlocks additional recipes.
ntnhcore.quest.7425.name: Crucible
ntnhcore.quest.7425.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} is an important machine as it is the central component of metallurgy. It is used as a method of ore processing, alloying, and metal casting. It requires an external heat source to melt the inputs into liquids and when filled, it emits a consistent amount of soot that can cause a fair amount of pollution that cannot be mitigated. Some alloys, as mentioned before, can be made alternatively using a #{00aaaa}Blast Furnace#{reset}, however this is generally slower.

[F1] For more information.
ntnhcore.quest.74241.name: DNT Nanosuit
ntnhcore.quest.74241.desc:
The #{ffaa00}DNT Nanosuit#{reset} is final goal of the mod. By crafting this armor you have reached the end of progression.

#{aa00aa}Thanks for playing!
ntnhcore.quest.74497.name: The next dawn
ntnhcore.quest.74753.name: Euphemium
ntnhcore.quest.74753.desc: #{ffaa00}Euphemium#{reset} is a fictional material which serves as one of the mod's most endgame materials. It's extremely expensive to produce in large amounts and you will need great advancement through the mod to use it effectively.
ntnhcore.quest.75009.name: Exposure Chamber
ntnhcore.quest.75009.desc: The #{00aaaa}Exposure Chamber#{reset} is a machine in which many materials can be created by exposing ingots to certain particles, most important of which being #{ffaa00}Dineutronium#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.75265.name: FEnSU
ntnhcore.quest.75265.desc: The #{00aaaa}FenSU#{reset} is the ultimate energy storage block, being able to store 1239217#{reset}THE.
ntnhcore.quest.75521.name: Gerald the Construction Android
ntnhcore.quest.75521.desc:
#{ffaa00}Gerald the Construction Android#{reset} is the most powerful weapon in the mod. Using this has the side effect of setting the world on fire but also getting tektite, which contains #{ffaa00}Osmiridium#{reset}.

Gerald is the hardest recipe of the mod requiring hundreds of thousands of items, mainly circuit related.

Vast quantities of #{ffaa00}Bismuth#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Tantalium#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Silicon#{reset} are needed, so dont hold back on bedrock ore processing and parallelisation of many processes. If you havent already used #{ff55ff}AE2#{reset}, it is highly recommended at this stage of the game.

Launching Gerald will result in a global firestorm that will decimate all life, including all trees and grass. Make sure to keep a backup of your world before launching him.

#{00aa00}Blueprints for Gerald and the Orbital Module can be found in structures or purchased from Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.quest.75777.name: #{ff5555}#{aa0000}HOW THE FUCK?!
ntnhcore.quest.76033.name: ICF
ntnhcore.quest.76033.desc:
The #{00aaaa}ICF#{reset} reactor is a very expensive and powerful reactor, which can produce a substantial amount of energy. Apart from the multiblock itself, #{00aaaa}ICF Lasers#{reset} must be constructed for the reactor to work. #{55ffff}Stellar Flux#{reset} will be produced during its operation which is needed to craft #{ffaa00}Gerald#{reset}. Consider making use of #{55ffff}Liquid Lead#{reset} as it is a very efficient coolant for the ICF.

It is recommended that the wiki is checked out as it has built-in calculators for the laser power consumption and the amount of hot coolant it produces.

[url]https://nucleartech.wiki/wiki/Inertial_Confinement_Fusion_Reactor[/url]

#{ffce86}Legacy reference#{reset}
External wiki pages may describe another HBM version. Their structures, numbers and operating modes have not been verified against Continuum 1.20.1; compare them with the installed implementation. External site availability is not guaranteed.
ntnhcore.quest.76289.name: ICF Fuels
ntnhcore.quest.76289.desc:
