ntnhcore.quest.10497.name: Fluids
ntnhcore.quest.10497.desc:
Fluids are measured in #{ffff55}mB#{reset} (#{ffff55}milli-Buckets#{reset}) and #{ffff55}B#{reset} (#{ffff55}Buckets#{reset}).

1 bucket = 1000mB.

There are two fluid systems that are currently barely incompatible between each other - #{ffaa00}Forge Fluids#{reset}, which is the system that most of the mods are using, and #{ffaa00}NTM Fluids#{reset}, which is the fluid system that is exclusive to NTM.

The #{ffaa00}Multi Fluid Identifier#{reset} is used to select the type of NTM fluid one needs. Shift-Click while holding it to select a fluid.

Those two systems are not compatible directly, however there is a solution called #{00aaaa}Bob Fluid Translator#{reset}. This machine allows to convert NTM Fluids into Forge Fluids. Simply put an universal identifier at the top slot of the machine and then input the desired fluid.

AE2 is only compatible with Forge Fluids.
ntnhcore.quest.104961.name: Computers: port status
ntnhcore.quest.104961.desc:
#{ffce86}Two distinct platforms#{reset}
Second Dawn includes CC:Tweaked. Classic OpenComputers, Computronics and OpenSecurity are absent and their port is postponed.

Legacy NTNH OpenComputers components, commands and programs cannot automatically run on CC:Tweaked. OC Manual is not part of this pack's working path. Legacy quests are retained, but missing objectives are not replaced with artificial completion.

Controlling a particular HBM machine requires the appropriate interface and separate testing. A Lua file alone does not establish compatibility with all devices.
ntnhcore.quest.105217.name: Wireless Network Card
ntnhcore.quest.105473.name: LV1 > LV2 Lootbag Trade
ntnhcore.quest.105473.desc: Trade three LV1 lootbags to get a better one: LV2.
ntnhcore.quest.105729.name: LV2 > LV3 Lootbag Trade
ntnhcore.quest.105729.desc: Trade three LV2 lootbags to get a better one: LV3.
ntnhcore.quest.105985.name: LV3.5 > LV4 Lootbag Trade
ntnhcore.quest.105985.desc: Trade eight LV3.5 lootbags to get a better one: LV4.
ntnhcore.quest.106241.name: LV3 > LV3.5 Lootbag Trade
ntnhcore.quest.106241.desc: Trade two LV3 lootbags to get a LV3.5.
ntnhcore.quest.106497.name: LV3 > LV4 Lootbag Trade
ntnhcore.quest.106497.desc: Trade four LV3 lootbags to get a better one: LV4.
ntnhcore.quest.106753.name: Additional Fluid Tools
ntnhcore.quest.106753.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Siphon#{reset} is a tool used to extract input fluids from a machine. Right-clicking a machine with content in it's input tanks will fill any fluid barrels, universal tanks or pipettes (if the fluid amount cannot fill any of the previous options).

#{ffaa00}Pipettes#{reset} can be used to input specific amounts of fluids. Right-clicking or Shift-Right-clicking will increase or decrease the fluid amount.
ntnhcore.quest.107009.name: Brine Processing
ntnhcore.quest.107009.desc: #{55ffff}Brine#{reset}, which is found in deposits similar to oil ones on earth, can be processed to obtain materials such as #{ffaa00}Nickel#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Copper#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Sulfur#{reset}, and fluids such as #{55ffff}Hydrogen#{reset} and #{55ffff}Oxygen#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.10753.name: From Flint to Oil - USA Simulator
ntnhcore.quest.10753.desc: The #{ffaa00}Oil Reservoir Detector#{reset} will help one in the search for an #{ffff55}Oil Deposit#{reset} by pointing it out in chat. If the oil deposit is located very far away, it can be mined and moved to a stationary oil refinery.
ntnhcore.quest.11009.name: Geological Samples
ntnhcore.quest.11009.desc:
This system is highly WIP (including this very quest), so do not expect it to be perfect.

This is the simplest method of prospecting, based on visual examination of surrounding material. Right-click on any #{ffaa00}Stone#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Gravel#{reset} block with a #{ffaa00}Prospector's Eyeglass#{reset} and it will tell you if there is a substantial amount of any interesting ore nearby. Three levels of indication are reported, "Faint signs", "Signs" and "Strong signs", allowing you to home in on the source.

Taking and analyzing geological samples, on the other hand, provides similar information to the Eyeglass but in much more detail. First you will need to make a #{ffaa00}Prospecting Pick#{reset}. To take a sample, right-click on any piece of Stone or Gravel with the Prospecting Pick. A Geological Sample item will be dropped.

To analyse the sample, you will need a #{00aaaa}Geological Sample Analysis Kit#{reset} and a supply of #{ffaa00}Litmus Paper#{reset}. To use the kit, place it down somewhere and right-click it to open its GUI. Place the sample you want to analyse in the sample slot and some litmus paper in the slot beside it. Analysis will begin automatically and should finish in a few seconds, after which a report will appear below.

The report shows the place where the sample was taken and the amounts of any interesting mineral traces it contains. You can expect indications of ores within 16 blocks of the sample location, horizontally and vertically, to show up. Ores closer to the sample location will show up more strongly than ones further away.

#{00aa00}To save the analysis report for future reference, place a Writeable Book in the book slot and press the + button.

If you lose the report, you can analyse the sample again to get it back. However, a little of the sample is used up each time you analyse it, and a given sample can only be analysed 16 times before there is nothing left.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.quest.11265.name: Geological Survey
ntnhcore.quest.11265.desc:
This system is highly WIP (including this very quest), so do not expect it to be perfect.

This is an advanced mineral exploration technique for professional miners, providing very detailed information. The #{00aaaa}Geological Surveyor#{reset} machine uses a controlled explosion to send seismic waves into the ground, and by analysing the echoes that come back, builds a map of underground ore densities.

As well as the Geological Surveyor itself, you will also need the following:

1. At least 3 #{00aaaa}Geophones#{reset} placed in a suitable arrangement around the Geological Surveyor. The geophones must be within 16 blocks of the Surveyor, but no closer than 8 blocks to the Surveyor or to each other.
2. Supplies of #{ffaa00}Paper#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Ink#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Gunpowder#{reset} in the appropriate slots of the Surveyor.
3. A #{ffaa00}Button#{reset} or other means of supplying a redstone signal to the Surveyor.

The Surveyor can operate in either #{ffff55}monochrome#{reset} or #{ffff55}colour#{reset} mode, selected using the button beside the ink slots. Colour mode provides more information about types of ores, but is more expensive. #{00aa00}Monochrome mode requires only black ink, whereas colour mode requires all four colours of ink.#{reset}

When all the necessary conditions are satisfied, the Surveyor wil show "#{ffaa00}Ready#{reset}" in the GUI, and a single green light on the outside of the machine. The Surveyor is trigged by a redstone signal. The easiest way to deliver this is to put a button on the side of the machine.

Be prepared for a loud noise.#{reset} Do not be alarmed; the explosion is well contained and should not cause any damage.

Analysing the results and printing the map will take several seconds, during which time the machine will show a flashing #{55ff55}green light#{reset}. When finished, two steady green lights will appear. The map can then be collected from the output slot of the GUI.

A #{ff5555}red light#{reset} indicates an error condition; open the GUI to find out more information.

#{ff5555}Some objectives still need to be ported. Unsupported objectives are blocked; see the pack report.
ntnhcore.quest.11521.name: Graphite
ntnhcore.quest.11521.desc: #{ffaa00}Graphite#{reset} is a crystalline carbon allotrope, consisting of stacked layers of graphene. Graphite is the most stable form of carbon, and is useful in many environments. It's ability to moderate neutrons makes it indispensable for #{00aaaa}nuclear reactors#{reset} that rely on thermal neutrons to maintain criticality. It's ability to withstand high temperatures and electrical conductivity make it useful as electrodes in the #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Arc Welder#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.11777.name: Hazards
ntnhcore.quest.11777.desc:
This mod adds several environmental hazards that will kill you if ignored.

#{ffaa00}Radiation#{reset} is measured in RAD. Effects begin at #{ffff55}200 RAD#{reset} and worsen steadily - instant death occurs at #{ff5555}1000 RAD#{reset}. Use a #{ffaa00}Geiger Counter#{reset} to monitor your dose. Radiation-resistant armor and #{ffaa00}Rad-X#{reset} reduce incoming RAD; a #{00aaaa}Player Decontaminator#{reset} or #{ffaa00}Antirads#{reset} remove accumulated dose.

Mesothelioma#{reset} develops from asbestos exposure. Items tagged #{ff5555}[Contains Asbestos]#{reset} and certain blocks like Chrysotile release asbestos particles. Progresses to death if untreated.

Black Lung#{reset} develops from coal dust exposure. Mining coal ore and carrying items tagged #{ff5555}[Coal Dust]#{reset} are the main sources. Also fatal.

A gas mask protects against both mesothelioma and black lung simultaneously. Both diseases are cured by #{ffaa00}SIOX Cancer Medication#{reset} or, early-game, #{ffaa00}Herbal Paste#{reset} - the latter being weaker and carrying side effects.
ntnhcore.quest.12033.name: Hazmat Suits
ntnhcore.quest.12033.desc:
#{ffaa00}Hazmat Suits#{reset} provide protection against many hazards, mainly radiation. #{ffaa00}Hazmat Cloth#{reset} can be further strengthened to create more resistant hazmat suits.

To provide additional protection against environmental dangers, a #{ffaa00}Gas Mask Filter#{reset} is needed, which can be equiped by right-clicking while holding it.
ntnhcore.quest.12289.name: Heating Oven/Firebox
ntnhcore.quest.12289.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Firebox#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Heating Oven#{reset} are machines capable of producing heat from solid fuels for any machines that require heat to operate.

Heat is measured in #{ffff55}TU#{reset} (#{ffff55}Thermal Units#{reset}).

Both machines are similar in operation. In order for them to transfer heat, another machine for receiving the heat must be placed on top, such that the copper heat plate on the receiving machine sits on top of the copper heat plate of the heat producing machine.

Once constructed, these machines can be filled with solid fuel, which will burn until either the fuel runs out, or the heat buffer is filled. No fuel will be consumed if its buffer is full - as such, both machines are fairly efficient at conserving fuel.

The primary difference in these two machines lie in their speed: the firebox burns fuel much slower at full efficiency, whilst the heating oven produces five time the heat (but eight times faster). Despite its inefficiency, the heating oven is often preferred for its much higher heat outputs and heat capacity. However, it cannot heat a stirling engine, as its base output (500 TU/t) will automatically over-speed the engine; the heavy stirling engine does not have this issue.

Additionally, the heating oven can receive heat from other heat producing machines placed underneath it: multiple can be stacked for heat-hungry machines like the crucible. The heat received, however, is halved when transferring to the machine above.
ntnhcore.quest.12545.name: HE to RF Converter
ntnhcore.quest.12545.desc: The #{00aaaa}HE to RF Converter#{reset} will convert energy produced by NTM machines into usuable power for both the #{ff55ff}Matter Energy Network#{reset} and #{ff55ff}OpenComputers#{reset}. It has a very large internal energy buffer, so it is recommended that a Diode is used to limit throughput.
ntnhcore.quest.1281.name: Ammo Press and Guns
ntnhcore.quest.1281.desc:
With casting available through the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}, many gun parts can now be created such as #{ffaa00}Barrels#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Grips#{reset}. An #{00aaaa}Ammo Press#{reset} is used to create the various ammunitions guns use.

A #{00aaaa}Weapon Modification Table#{reset} can be used to install weapon mods, such as #{ffaa00}Silencers#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Scopes#{reset}.

The #{ffaa00}Bullet Casing Bag#{reset} will retrieve some of the casings when guns are fired.
ntnhcore.quest.12801.name: High-Speed Steel
ntnhcore.quest.12801.desc: High-speed steel#{reset} is an advanced and specialized form of standard steel. It used in many recipes, such as the #{00aaaa}Oil Derrick#{reset} and the #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.13057.name: Highway To Hell
ntnhcore.quest.13057.desc:
#{ffaa00}The Nether#{reset} is #{ff5555}ACTUALLY HOT#{reset} causing your skin to burn.

#{ffaa00}Fire Proximity Armor Set#{reset} is essential for your first Nerther trip, as it protects you from burning fire.
ntnhcore.quest.13313.name: Industrial Hemp & Mustard Willow
ntnhcore.quest.13313.desc:
Walking around the world, you can find a #{ffaa00}Mustard Willow#{reset} on dead or #{ffaa00}Oily Dirt#{reset}. The willow itself will not be needed anytime soon, but it is better to collect it and the soil underneath it.

#{ffaa00}Industrial Hemp#{reset} is used to craft ropes, strings and biomass.
ntnhcore.quest.13569.name: Industrial Mixer
ntnhcore.quest.13569.desc: The #{00aaaa}Industrial Mixer#{reset} is a machine that is used to mix a fluid with an item and/or another fluid. It can be used instead of a #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset} for some recipes.
ntnhcore.quest.13825.name: Infinite Water Sources
ntnhcore.quest.13825.desc:
Tired of using buckets to give #{55ffff}Water#{reset} to your machines? Try using water pumps or infinite water tanks!

#{ffaa00}Infinite Water Tank#{reset} will give #{ffff55}50mb/t

#{ffaa00}Enhanced Infinite Water Tank#{reset} will give #{ffff55}500mb/t

#{ffaa00}Steam-Powered Groundwater Pump#{reset} will give #{ffff55}1000mb/t#{reset} but requires #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} to operate (which is obvious).
ntnhcore.quest.14081.name: Second Dawn: Known Issues
ntnhcore.quest.14337.name: Long Distance Energy Transportation
ntnhcore.quest.14337.desc:
For greater distances, and improved aesthetics, a new distribution node is available, the #{00aaaa}Large Electricity Pylon#{reset}.

#{00aaaa}Substations#{reset} are needed to step up/down the voltage that the line carries.

These Pylons can prove useful as favorable #{ffff55}Bedrock Ore#{reset} or #{ffff55}Oil deposits#{reset} may be located far away from the main base.
ntnhcore.quest.14593.name: Machine Upgrade Template
ntnhcore.quest.14593.desc: The #{ffaa00}Machine Upgrade Template#{reset} is the baseline for all machine upgrades. Machine upgrades are not only used to increase the efficiency of machines but also to unlock new functions.
ntnhcore.quest.14849.name: Mining Charge
ntnhcore.quest.14849.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Mining Charge#{reset} is an explosive made with the express purpose of mining, as such it's commonly used to mine depth ores, since it doesn't destroy drops, before getting a pickaxe that can do the same. Mining Charges are a great way of obtaining #{ffaa00}Zirconium#{reset} from depth ores for nuclear fuel rods.

It has an explosion radius of about 3 blocks and explodes instantly upon being powered by redstone, while exploding it does no damage to entities.

There are two other variants of this, being the #{00aaaa}Timed Mining Charge#{reset} and the #{55ffff}#{00aaaa}Semtex Mining Charge#{reset}, they are both timed explosives with the semtex one being stronger than the regular one and having #{ffff55}Fortune 3#{reset}, meanwhile the timed mining charge does not seem to have enhanced capabilities, other than being timed and thus more convinient to use.
ntnhcore.quest.15105.name: Nailed It!
ntnhcore.quest.15105.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} is a tool from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} used to crush blocks down into finer forms. Its primary role is producing the materials needed for the #{00aaaa}Sieve#{reset}: cobblestone is crushed into gravel, gravel into sand, and sand into dust, each of which can be sieved for different resources.

To use it, simply break a target block with the #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} as you would with a pickaxe. Hammers come in the standard tool tiers -
wood through diamond - and differ only in durability. They can be enchanted, though the available enchantments differ from those on a pickaxe.

Ores can also be hammered down through a multi-step crushing chain. Each step has a small chance to yield bonus
material, making the #{ffaa00}Hammer#{reset} a basic form of ore multiplication before dedicated processing machines are available.

#{00aa00}Hammering can be automated with machines that simulate block breaking, such as the Auto Hammer from #{ff55ff}Ex Compressum#{reset}#{00aa00}.
#{00aa00}Check JEI for the full crushing chain of any block.
ntnhcore.quest.1537.name: Analog Circuit Board
ntnhcore.quest.1537.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Analog Circuit#{reset} is the first true circuit board used in crafting certain essential machines and tools such as the #{ffaa00}Oil Deposit Detector#{reset}, the #{00aaaa}Chemical Plant#{reset}, and the #{00aaaa}Electric Arc Furnace#{reset}.

#{00aa00}A cheaper recipe for Capacitors will be available if a Shredder is owned.
ntnhcore.quest.15361.name: Preparation before speed
ntnhcore.quest.15617.name: HUD, maps and performance
ntnhcore.quest.15873.name: Oily Sand
ntnhcore.quest.15873.desc:
#{ffaa00}Oily Sand#{reset} is a surface-level block that generates among normal sand, typically in deserts. It acts as a marker for #{55ffff}Bedrock Oil#{reset} deposits directly beneath it - if you find it, there is oil underground.

It can be ground in a #{00aaaa}Grinder#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Oil Waste#{reset}, which can then be processed to obtain #{ffaa00}Arsenic#{reset} - a really important mid-game material.
ntnhcore.quest.16129.name: Ores and world generation
ntnhcore.quest.16129.desc:
#{ffce86}Use version-specific information#{reset}
Second Dawn uses installed mods' generation with selected adaptations of HBM ores and legacy progression. Exact legacy vein geometry and full planetary equivalence with NTNH 1.7.10 are not claimed.

Legacy Custom Ore Generation is not installed, so disabling it is not an applicable instruction. Do not randomly edit hbm.cfg from an old table. Mining heights and tables for 1.7.10 cannot automatically be applied to 1.20.1.

For suspicious floating platforms, clipped structures or square ore masses, record dimension, coordinates, seed, pack version and a screenshot. Test fixes on a world copy; generation updates do not automatically rewrite old chunks.
ntnhcore.quest.16385.name: Packing Tape
ntnhcore.quest.16385.desc: The #{ffaa00}Packing Tape#{reset} allows one to break and move drawers without all the items falling on the floor.
ntnhcore.quest.16641.name: Pipe Anchors
ntnhcore.quest.16641.desc: #{00aaaa}Pipe Anchors#{reset} are non solid fluid ducts which can be used instead of normal ducts.
ntnhcore.quest.16897.name: Player Decontaminator
ntnhcore.quest.16897.desc: The #{00aaaa}Player Decontaminator#{reset} will remove Rads received while standing on it. It can be very cost efficient, as other methods such as #{ffaa00}RadAways#{reset} require constant replenishment.
ntnhcore.quest.17153.name: Pneumatic Pipes
ntnhcore.quest.17153.desc:
#{00aaaa}Pneumatic Pipes#{reset} are an instant form of item transportation which can cover large distances. The pipes must have a compressed gas inside them to work.

A #{ffaa00}Screwdriver#{reset} is needed to create a connection, and right clicking on the connection with a fluid id will set the gasseous fluid it will use.
ntnhcore.quest.17409.name: Pollution and Smokestack
ntnhcore.quest.17409.desc:
#{ffaa00}Pollution#{reset} is a mechanic affecting several machines related to industrialization. It must be properly mitigated, lest suffer the consequences of a polluted world. There are 3 subtypes of pollution - soot, poison and heavy metal.

#{ffaa00}Soot#{reset} is most common, produced by fossil fuel burning and some other sources. It increases generic mob health and strength. At high enough levels, it becomes visible as smog.

#{ffaa00}Poison#{reset} harms unprotected entities at high enough levels, and is produced exclusively as the consequence from spilling fluids such as CO2 or various oil products.

#{ffaa00}Heavy metal#{reset} comes from the combustion of leaded fuels. It also increases mob strength, but also harms them at high enough levels.

It can also be harmful to entities and players if they aren't wearing gas protection.

Compatible machines can be connected to special exhaust pipes, which are effectively specialized box-ducts, to output to a #{ffaa00}Smokestack#{reset} to reduce the amount of pollution.

The #{00aaaa}Smokestack#{reset} is used to reduce pollution made from machines. #{00aaaa}Exhaust Pipes#{reset}, made in anvils, can be used to transport the fumes to the Smokestack. The #{00aaaa}Industrial Smokestack#{reset} is needed to produce #{ffaa00}Fine Soot#{reset}, required for making #{ffaa00}Fullerite#{reset} in the late game.

An #{00aaaa}Ashpit#{reset} can be installed beneath the Smokestack which will collect #{ffaa00}Ash#{reset}, that can be used as a cheap black dye alternative as well as in the creation of #{ffaa00}Industrial Fertilizer#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.17665.name: Pollution Detector
ntnhcore.quest.17665.desc: The #{ffaa00}Pollution Detector#{reset} will monitor and show the levels of pollution present in the environment. High levels of pollution will decrease the visibility, give debuffs to the player and buff mobs, including skeletons spawning with firearms.
ntnhcore.quest.1793.name: Anvil
ntnhcore.quest.1793.desc: #{00aaaa}Anvils#{reset} are a tiered crafting station that allows for the creation of various machines, structures, and items in some cases. There are multiple tiers of anvils with greater anvil tier primarily corresponding to a greater quantity of recipes being available.
ntnhcore.quest.17921.name: Primitive Crucible
ntnhcore.quest.17921.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} is a block from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} used to melt solid blocks down into fluids. It is crafted first as an #{ffaa00}Unfired Crucible#{reset} from #{ffaa00}Porcelain Clay#{reset}, then fired in a furnace to produce a usable #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset}.

To operate it, place the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} above a heat source and right-click it with an eligible block to load it. The block will slowly melt into fluid over time. The speed of melting depends entirely on the heat source below - stronger heat sources melt faster. Burning #{ffaa00}Netherrack#{reset} is among the most efficient vanilla options.

The primary output is #{55ffff}lava#{reset}, produced by melting cobblestone, stone, and similar blocks. The #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} can hold fluids indefinitely, making it a cheap fluid storage vessel in a pinch. Drain it using fluid pipes connected to its side or bottom.

#{00aa00}A bank of Crucibles over burning Netherrack is a reliable early lava farm.
ntnhcore.quest.18177.name: Radial Performance Engine
ntnhcore.quest.18177.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Radial Performance Engine#{reset} is a combustion generator that converts liquid fuels into electrical power. It requires a minimum of #{ffff55}3#{reset} #{ffaa00}Combustion Engine Pistons#{reset} to run, with up to #{ffff55}9#{reset} installed in its piston slots. Additional pistons increase both power output and fuel consumption linearly.

The engine accepts fuels of varying grades at different efficiency rates. #{55ffff}Heating Oil#{reset} and #{55ffff}Industrial Oil#{reset} burn at #{ffff55}75%#{reset} efficiency, #{55ffff}Petroil#{reset} at #{ffff55}50%#{reset}, and #{55ffff}Diesel#{reset} and #{55ffff}Gasoline#{reset} at #{ffff55}25%#{reset}. Aviation fuels and gaseous fuels are not compatible. Power is output from the bottom face, and the engine stores up to #{ffff55}250 kHE#{reset} internally, or #{ffff55}2.5 MHE#{reset} when running #{55ffff}NITAN#{reset}.

However, the engine is most efficient with the heaviest, least-refined feedstocks. Lighter refined fuels produce less power per mB despite their higher grade.

#{00aa00}The listed efficiency is a multiplier on each fuel's base combustion energy. Higher-grade fuels may have higher base energy, so check the HE/t display in the GUI before settling on a fuel.
ntnhcore.quest.18433.name: Recycling
ntnhcore.quest.18433.desc: Now, as you have a better anvil, you can start #{ffff55}recycling#{reset} some stuff you may found in dungeons.
ntnhcore.quest.18689.name: Rotary Furnace
ntnhcore.quest.18689.desc: The #{00aaaa}Rotary Furnace#{reset} is a large furnace which is powered by both #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} and #{ffaa00}#{reset}solid fuel. #{reset}It outputs molten material which can be cast similarly to the outputs of the #{00aaaa}Crucible#{reset} and #{00aaaa}Arc Furnace#{reset}. The Rotary Furnace is the only machine that can produce #{ffaa00}Saturnite#{reset} and #{ffaa00}Weapon Steel#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.18945.name: Settings Tool
ntnhcore.quest.18945.desc: The #{ffaa00}Settings Tool#{reset} is used to copy settings of machines. It is especially useful when making large refineries.
ntnhcore.quest.19201.name: Shredder
ntnhcore.quest.19201.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Shredder#{reset} is a machine that shreds resourses into their powder form, or in many cases, their crafting materials. It can also be used to double ores.

#{00aa00}Shredder blades are required in order for the machine to work.
ntnhcore.quest.19457.name: Sieving
ntnhcore.quest.19457.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Sieve#{reset} filters gravel, dirt, stone, and other blocks to yield useful material fragments - including iron, copper, lead, and more.

Use #{00aaaa}Heavy Sieve#{reset} with #{ffaa00}Compressed Blocks#{reset} to get more fragments.

#{00aa00}Use JEI to list all possible drops.
ntnhcore.quest.19713.name: Silkworm
ntnhcore.quest.19713.desc:
#{ffaa00}Silkworms#{reset} are items from #{ff55ff}Ex Deorum#{reset} and the primary way to produce #{ffaa00}String#{reset} on resource-limited maps. They cannot be crafted - the only way to obtain one is as a rare drop when breaking leaves with a #{ffaa00}Crook#{reset}.

To use a #{ffaa00}Silkworm#{reset}, right-click it onto any leaves block. The leaves will slowly become infested, turning white over time, and the infestation will spread on its own to adjacent leaves. Fully white leaves produce more #{ffaa00}String#{reset} than partially infested ones, so it is worth waiting.

Once the leaves are fully infested, break them with a #{ffaa00}Crook#{reset} or your fist to collect #{ffaa00}String#{reset} and additional #{ffaa00}Silkworms#{reset}, keeping the process renewable. Note that infested leaves do not drop saplings or apples, so keep spare saplings set aside before
infesting a tree.

#{00aa00}Silkworms can also be composted in a Barrel if you have a surplus.
ntnhcore.quest.19969.name: Solar Tower Boiler
ntnhcore.quest.19969.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Solar Tower Boiler#{reset} is an earlygame machine that can use sunlight from heliostat mirrors to boil water and therefore turn it into steam.

The Solar Tower Boiler gets heat from heliostat mirrors pointed at it. Aiming a mirror at the boiler can be done using the mirror adjustment tool, right-click on the boiler will save its position to the tool, and subsequently clicking on mirrors will aim them at the linked boiler. The maximum range for mirrors is 25 blocks, mirror efficiency does not degrade with range. A boiler consumes 1mB of water for every 12.5 mirrors each tick at full sunlight level, and 100mB of steam per mB of water consumed. However, the water consumption rate is rounded down to the millibucket. Thus it takes 13 mirrors to raise your first 100mB/t of steam, 12 mirrors for the next hundred, then 13, 12, and so on.

As the heat provided by each mirror is based on sunlight, mirrors with solid blocks above them will not work, and the amount of heat diminishes with the amount of light in the evening until it produces no heat at night.

The solar tower boiler can only produce regular steam, and thus the liquid type cannot be changed using fluid identifiers.
ntnhcore.quest.20225.name: Soldering Station
ntnhcore.quest.20225.desc: The #{00aaaa}Soldering Station#{reset} is the machine in which #{ffaa00}#{reset}circuit components#{reset} can be combined#{ffaa00}#{reset} into #{ffaa00}Circuits#{reset} and where #{ffaa00}Machine Upgrades#{reset} can be created.
ntnhcore.quest.2049.name: Arc Welder
ntnhcore.quest.2049.desc: The #{00aaaa}Arc Welder#{reset} is a machine needed for the creation of many components, such as #{ffaa00}Welded Plates#{reset}, #{ffaa00}Missile Parts#{reset} and more. Some Recipes will require a fluid inserted into the welder to work.
ntnhcore.quest.20481.name: Steam Engine
ntnhcore.quest.20481.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Steam Engine#{reset} is an early game method of turning #{55ffff}Steam#{reset} into energy. It requires an external source to provide steam and a way to dump or reprocess the #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset} it produces. 

The Steam Engine has an energy efficiency of #{ffff55}85%#{reset}, making it better than the #{00aaaa}Stirling Engine#{reset}. However, it still has a throughput limit as it can only hold up to 2000 mB of steam. Its maximum processing rate is 2000 mB/t, producing a considerable #{ffff55}3400 HE/t#{reset} or #{ffff55}68 kHE/s#{reset}. It is therefore the best generator available before #{00aaaa}Steam Turbines#{reset}.

A boiler being heated up by a heating oven using coal will produce #{ffff55}17kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.20737.name: Steel Anvil
ntnhcore.quest.20737.desc: An upgraded version of the #{00aaaa}Anvil#{reset}, [T2], which unlocks additional recipes.
ntnhcore.quest.20993.name: Steel Furnace
ntnhcore.quest.20993.desc: The #{00aaaa}Steel Furnace#{reset}, unlike the other furnaces, runs off of #{ffff55}TU#{reset}. It can also process up to 3 items at a time, but each slot consumes more TU, which makes it slow without a strong heat source. It also has a bonus output for ores and wood, where every smelted item gives #{ffff55}25%#{reset} to the bonus output meter, which means every 4 items give an extra 5th item for free (#{ffff55}+15 items from a single stack#{reset}).
ntnhcore.quest.21249.name: Stirling Engine
ntnhcore.quest.21249.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Stirling Engine#{reset} uses heat from a #{00aaaa}Heating Oven#{reset} or a #{00aaaa}#{reset}#{00aaaa}Firebox#{reset} to produce power. If a Heating Oven is used to heat a Stirling engine, it will likely over-speed and damage it, sending the main gear flying. The heavy Stirling engine does not have this issue.

A firebox running on coal with a stirling engine produces #{ffff55}2kHE/s#{reset}, while a heating oven with a heavy stirling engine produces #{ffff55}10kHE/s#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.21505.name: Stirling Sawmill
ntnhcore.quest.21505.desc: The #{00aaaa}Stirling Sawmill#{reset} uses heat to cut wooden related items, producing #{ffaa00}Sawdust#{reset} in the process. Sawdust can be used to obtain #{ffaa00}Paper#{reset}, and if further processed, can be turned into #{ffaa00}Charcoal#{reset} in a #{00aaaa}Combination Oven#{reset}.
ntnhcore.quest.21761.name: Stone Age: first steps
ntnhcore.quest.22017.name: Storage Drawer Keys
ntnhcore.quest.22017.desc:
#{ff55ff}Storage Drawer Keys#{reset} can be used to modify Drawers in many ways.

The #{ff55ff}Drawer Key locks drawers#{reset}, so no new item types can be inserted into the drawer when its empty.

The #{ff55ff}Concealment Key#{reset} hides the item icon of drawers.

The #{ff55ff}Quantify Key#{reset} shows the item quantities of drawers.

The #{ff55ff}Personal Key#{reset} protects drawers from other players (outside of claims).
ntnhcore.quest.22273.name: Storage Drawers
ntnhcore.quest.22273.desc:
Storage Drawers#{reset} are an easy and cheap way of storing large amounts of items. They can be further upgraded to increase storage capacity as well as other abilities, such as voiding. They can also be #{ff55ff}Chiseled#{reset} to change their wood type.

#{00aa00}Many drawers may cause lag.
ntnhcore.quest.22529.name: Strand Caster
ntnhcore.quest.22529.desc: The #{00aaaa}Strand Caster#{reset} is a large basin that can cast items in batches of 9. It also requires #{55ffff}Water#{reset} in order to cast, where it makes #{55ffff}Low-Pressure Steam#{reset} that can be turned back into water.
ntnhcore.quest.22785.name: Strawberry Ice Cream
ntnhcore.quest.22785.desc: Imagine using the same chemical plant for sulfuric acid AND strawberry ice cream production...
ntnhcore.quest.2305.name: Assembly Machine
ntnhcore.quest.2305.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Assembly Machine#{reset} is used in every stage of the game, with it being used to manufacture practically every other complex machine. Recipes for it can be chosen inside the GUI.

#{00aa00}Some unique recipes require blueprints, that can be found in dungeons and/or bought from Bobmazon.
ntnhcore.quest.23041.name: Next: industry
ntnhcore.quest.23297.name: Trench Mask
ntnhcore.quest.23297.desc:
The #{ffaa00}Trench Mask#{reset} is a basic mask that will protect the user from some dangerous airborne particles while mining. To craft one you must first obtain #{ffaa00}Cloth#{reset} and then piss on it by right clicking while holding it.

#{00aa00}String can be easily obtained by harvesting Hemp, found in the wild.

#{reset}I hate to say it, but you are basically sniffing your own piss...
ntnhcore.quest.23553.name: Wood-Burning Generator
ntnhcore.quest.23553.desc:
The #{00aaaa}Wood-Burning Generator#{reset} is basic method of producing energy by burning wood. It can run on any burnable items but provides burn time bonuses to logs and wood. It can also run on any flammable fuel by clicking on the arrow below the on/off switch, but it is considerably more inefficient than other fluid burning generators.

Burning logs in the generator produces #{ffff55}2kHE/s.#{reset}
ntnhcore.quest.23809.name: You WILL eat ze bugs!
ntnhcore.quest.23809.desc:
Congratulations. You have done it. You have actually done it.

While the rest of the world clung desperately to their beef and their bread, you - yes, YOU - reached into your inventory, pulled out a #{ffaa00}Silkworm#{reset}, and thought: "yes. This is food now." Klaus is proud. Klaus is, in fact, emotional. Somewhere in a Swiss
chalet, a single tear rolls down his turtleneck. You will own nothing. You will have no hunger bar. Und you will be happy.
ntnhcore.quest.24065.name: Armor Modifications
ntnhcore.quest.24065.desc: The #{00aaaa}Armor Modification Table#{reset} allows for armor modifications to be inserted in armor, giving either buffs, new abilities or extra resistance.
ntnhcore.quest.24321.name: Compressor
ntnhcore.quest.24321.desc: The #{00aaaa}Compressor#{reset} is a specialized multiblock machine for compressing fluids. It can perform this operation on any fluid to increase its pressure, for use in other machines. Some of these fluids are compressed into different fluids entirely as special recipes for this machine.
ntnhcore.quest.24577.name: Glyphids
ntnhcore.quest.24577.desc:
#{ffaa00}Glyphids#{reset} are large insects that have many different types. They primarily spawn with naturally generated #{ffaa00}#{reset}hives#{reset} structures. All of the types are armored and they take less damage than against normal mobs. Glyphids are normally attracted to pollution created by the player, and usually have to be dealt with by the player.

#{ffaa00}#{reset}#{ffaa00}Hives#{reset} can spawn naturally in all non-ocean biomes and can also be created by glyphid scouts. They contain several glyphid egg blocks and some low-tier loot inside, lying on top of eggs. glyphid egg blocks spawn glyphids and drop glyphid eggs upon destruction.

Glyphids now periodically retarget the closest player every 5 seconds if their current target is farther. 1/3 of glyphids do not have this behavior to prevent infinite trapping.

#{00aa00}It is recommended that all hives are destroyed as soon as possible as to prevent their spread later on.
